We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the German market.

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen.

This role will assess Axle’s participation in German markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace.

You speak German and fluent English. Other European languages are also an asset.

What you will be doing

  • Owning Axle’s commercial results in the German market: pipeline, revenue and partner success

  • Winning new customers end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, and setting partners up to generate meaningful revenue

  • Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing, customer segmentation and launch strategy

  • Building the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships. You’ll be on the phone (and on the ground) with utilities/retailers, potential clients and grid operators, creating and disproving hypotheses as quickly as possible

  • Continuing to sharpen our view of where the value is and which markets and business models are accessible to us

  • Building lasting relationships with grid operators and the regulator, so that Axle is well positioned as the market evolves

  • Acting as the conduit between partners and engineering, creating fast, structured feedback loops that turn field insights into product improvements

As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, ramp up commercial value, and accelerate us into new markets.

You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments.

This is an opportunity to repeatedly deliver first-of-a-kind projects across the world, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of global electrification.

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

You’ll be based in the Germany. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Interview process

  1. Initial interview

  2. Take-home exercise

  3. Final interview (in-person)

  4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

descriptionHtml:
Einleitung

Wir suchen neue Kolleg:innen! Migrando ist ein Legal-Tech-Unternehmen aus Cottbus. Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, den komplizierten und langwierigen Weg zur Einbürgerung effizienter und kundenfreundlicher zu gestalten. Mit unserer Expertise im Ausländerrecht und einem starken Team aus über 60 Kolleg:innen begleiten wir tausende Mandant:innen erfolgreich auf dem Weg zum deutschen Pass. Alle unsere Stellen sind Festanstellungen bei uns vor Ort in Cottbus.

Am besten verschaffst du dir gleich selbst einen Eindruck auf unserer Karriereseite. Denn wir können hier schreiben, was wir wollen, am Ende bleibt es eine langweilige Einleitung.

Wir bieten Dir

Keine starren Prozesse, kein Mikromanagement. Bei uns entscheidest du, wie du arbeitest, mit Tools, die du selbst mitgestalten darfst, und Kolleg:innen, die mitdenken. Wir entwickeln ständig neue Systeme, um unsere Arbeit zu optimieren, statt nur Tickets zu schließen. Und falls doch mal was brennt: Wir löschen gemeinsam.

  • Echte Eigenverantwortung und kurze Wege
    Du bist nicht eine:r von vielen in einer langen Zuständigkeitskette. Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich in deinem Bereich, in einem überschaubaren Team, mit kurzem Draht zu allen Abteilungen und zur Geschäftsführung, ohne drei Hierarchieebenen dazwischen. Wenn du eine Idee hast, wie ein Prozess besser laufen oder ein Tool sinnvoller eingesetzt werden kann, wirst du gehört.
  • High-End-Hardware nach Wahl
    Egal ob MacBook oder Windows-Tower: Du bekommst die Maschine, auf der du am besten performst, dazu 4K-Monitore, ein hochwertiges Headset und einen ergonomischen Arbeitsplatz mit höhenverstellbarem Tisch.
  • Musik bei der Arbeit
    Bei uns wird nicht mit der Stirn gerunzelt, wenn du dir Kopfhörer aufsetzt. Wenn es dir hilft (und niemanden stört), kannst du auch gern Heavy Metal über eine Soundanlage an deinem Schreibtisch pumpen.
  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit
    Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf das Leben von Menschen. Du unterstützt sie dabei, in Deutschland anzukommen, Sicherheit zu finden und ein neues Kapitel aufzuschlagen. Das ist keine trockene Büroarbeit, sondern Arbeit mit echter Bedeutung.
  • Vertrauensarbeitszeit und flexible Teilzeit
    Keine Kernzeiten, keine vorgeschriebenen Zeitfenster. Ob 4-Tage-Woche, 30 Stunden oder ein individuelles Modell: Dein Job soll zu deinem Leben passen, nicht andersherum.
  • Homeoffice nach der Einarbeitung
    Grundsätzlich arbeiten wir im Büro, weil Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort für uns wichtig sind. Nach deiner Einarbeitung ist gelegentliches Homeoffice aber kein Problem, auch spontan.
  • Spontan frei, wenn das Leben dazwischenkommt
    Kranke Kinder, Elternabend, kurzfristiger Arzttermin oder einfach mal eine Auszeit: Wir planen unsere Teams so, dass auch spontane freie Tage möglich sind, ganz ohne Stress oder schlechtes Gewissen. Familie und Gesundheit haben bei uns Vorrang.
  • Modernes Altbau-Büro mit Fitnessraum
    Hohe Decken, viel Tageslicht, Pflanzen und ein Innenhof für die Pause zwischendurch, mitten im Herzen von Cottbus. Unser eigener Fitnessraum im Haus steht dir kostenlos und jederzeit zur Verfügung. Einen Einblick in unsere Räume bekommst du auf unserer Website.
  • Team-Events und Feel-Good-Angebote
    Sommerfest am See, Weihnachtsfeier, Halloween-Sause, gemeinsame Lunches oder Afterwork-Dinner: Wir feiern gern. Erscheinen ist keine Pflicht, und früher gehen ist auch kein Problem. Zwischendurch sorgt unsere Feel-Good-Managerin für kleine Auszeiten, von Nacken- und Schultermassagen bis zu kurzen Entspannungs-Sessions.

Mögliche Aufgabenbereiche

Als IT-Systemadministrator (w/m/d) planst, betreust und entwickelst du Systeme, die unser Unternehmen voranbringen. Du kümmerst dich um Server, Netzwerke und Sicherheit und hast dabei alle Freiheiten, Prozesse smarter zu machen.

  • Server-Verwaltung & Pflege
    Du betreust unsere internen Server, kümmerst dich um Updates und stellst sicher, dass alle Systeme stabil laufen.
  • Netzwerkadministration
    Du überwachst und konfigurierst Router, Switches, Firewalls und VPNs.
  • Datensicherung & Wiederherstellung
    Du planst, überprüfst und testest Backups regelmäßig und stellst sicher, dass im Ernstfall keine Daten verloren gehen.
  • Systemmigrationen
    Du planst und begleitest den Umstieg auf neue Systeme, ob Update, neue Software oder neue Hardware.
  • Schnittstellen & Automatisierungen
    Du verbindest Systeme über APIs oder Tools wie n8n. So machst du Prozesse effizienter und reduzierst Klickarbeit und Fehler auf ein Minimum.
  • Domains & Bereitstellung interner Tools
    Du behältst den Überblick über unsere aktiven Domains und stellst interne Tools lokal oder online genau den richtigen Teams sicher und performant zur Verfügung.
  • Technischer Support im Alltag
    Du bist eine der ersten Anlaufstellen bei IT-Fragen und hilfst Kolleg:innen weiter, per Chat oder vor Ort.
  • Einrichtung neuer Arbeitsplätze
    Du richtest neue PCs, Notebooks und Monitore ein und kümmerst dich um Softwareinstallationen, Zugänge und Netzwerkeinstellungen.
  • Neue Technologien evaluieren
    Du testest neue Tools, prüfst ihre Praxistauglichkeit und empfiehlst, was uns wirklich weiterbringt.
  • Abstimmung mit Dienstleistern
    Du betreust externe Anbieter, Partner oder Remote-Entwickler:innen und stimmst deine Arbeit mit ihnen ab.

Dein Profil

Kein Zertifikat der Welt ersetzt echte Erfahrung in der Praxis. Genau die suchen wir. Egal ob du sie mit oder ohne Ausbildung gesammelt hast: Uns interessiert, was du wirklich kannst, welche Systeme du schon verantwortet hast und was du noch erreichen willst. Direkte Kommunikation, Neugier und Spaß an der Arbeit sind uns wichtiger als jeder Abschluss. Und wir suchen jemanden, der bereit ist, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

  • Praktische Erfahrung in der IT-Administration
    Du hast bereits IT-Systeme im laufenden Betrieb betreut, ob in einem Unternehmen oder für Kund:innen, und weißt, was es heißt, wenn morgens etwas nicht läuft und alle darauf warten.
  • Festanstellung vor Ort in Cottbus
    Du möchtest fest bei uns angestellt sein und im Team vor Ort in Cottbus arbeiten. Für Freelance-Aufträge oder reine Remote-Stellen sind wir leider nicht die richtige Adresse.
  • Netzwerke & Sicherheit
    Lokale Netzwerke, Router, Switches, Firewalls und VPNs: Du hast sie schon eingerichtet und betreut und weißt, wie man ein Firmennetzwerk sicher aufstellt.
  • Server, Cloud & Systemarchitektur
    Du verstehst, wie lokale Server, Cloud-Server und Serverlandschaften zusammenspielen, und hast Erfahrung mit Docker und Datenbanken (z. B. Supabase) oder vergleichbaren Plattformen.
  • Plattform-Know-how
    Google Workspace, Windows und macOS sind für dich Alltag, nicht Neuland.
  • Backups & Datenschutz
    Du hast einen Plan von Backup-Strategien und weißt, wie man mit personenbezogenen Daten umgeht, von der Speicherung über die Verarbeitung bis zur Löschung.
  • APIs & Automatisierung
    Du weißt, wie man einen authentifizierten API-Call macht, und hast Lust, Abläufe mit Tools wie n8n zu automatisieren.
  • Nachhaltige Lösungen
    Du findest lieber eine saubere Lösung als einen schnellen Workaround.
  • Offenheit für Neues
    Du hast Lust, regelmäßig Neues zu lernen, ob Tools, Trends oder Technologien.
  • Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe
    Eigentlich wollen wir hier nichts Generisches schreiben, aber dieser Punkt ist uns wichtig: Gute Zusammenarbeit zählt für uns genauso viel wie Erfahrung. Jemand, mit dem die Zusammenarbeit angenehm und reibungslos läuft, ist im Alltag oft wertvoller als jemand mit noch mehr Know-how, mit dem die Kommunikation aber schleppend ist.
  • Deutsch oder Englisch
    Du sprichst Deutsch oder Englisch, am besten beides (ca. B2-Niveau). Keine Sorge, einen Nachweis brauchen wir nicht.
  • Nice to have: CRM-Erfahrung
    Wenn du zusätzlich schon mit CRM-Systemen wie HubSpot gearbeitet hast, umso besser.

title: Junior Account Executive SMB | DACH Market (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Bei Superchat gestalten wir neu, wie Unternehmen mit ihren Kund:innen kommunizieren. KI wird dabei immer mehr zum Motor dieser Kommunikation. Integrationen sind das, was diesem Motor echte Power gibt: die Daten, Tools und Systeme, die aus einem cleveren AI-Agenten einen machen, der Prozesse wirklich automatisiert und Probleme löst.

Gegründet im Jahr 2020, ist Superchat heute die Plattform für über 10.000 Unternehmen weltweit - von bekannten Marken wie Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone und GASAG bis hin zu kleinen Unternehmen, Zahnarztpraxen und Solo-Founder:innen, die professioneller auftreten möchten.

Inzwischen laufen täglich Millionen von Nachrichten über Superchat.

Gestartet sind wir als Unified Inbox – ein zentraler Ort für alle Kommunikationskanäle wie WhatsApp, E-Mail, SMS oder Instagram. Mit dem Aufstieg von ChatGPT begann unser nächstes Kapitel: AI Agents, die über Chat, E-Mail und Voice in einer Qualität kommunizieren, die mit den besten menschlichen Teams mithalten kann.

Heute sind wir ein Team von rund 100 Mitarbeitenden, arbeiten profitabel und haben insgesamt 18 Millionen Euro Funding eingesammelt (unsere letzte Finanzierungsrunde liegt bereits 4,5 Jahre zurück – seitdem wachsen wir aus eigener Kraft weiter).

Unser Hauptsitz ist in Berlin.

In dieser Rolle bist du verantwortlich für den gesamten Sales-Zyklus im DACH-Markt. Du bearbeitest warme Inbound-Anfragen und akquirierst gleichzeitig eigenständig neue Leads, vereinbarst und führst Demo-Termine durch und begleitest den gesamten Prozess bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Darüber hinaus unterstützt du bei der technischen Implementierung, um sicherzustellen, dass neue Kund:innen erfolgreich starten.

Who We Want

Recent Graduate with an Interest in B2B Sales.
Du hast dein Studium (z.B. BWL, Kommunikation, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar) kürzlich abgeschlossen und bringst Interesse am B2B-Vertrieb mit.

Strong communicator.
Du sprichst muttersprachliches Deutsch und verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.

Self-Confident.
Du glaubst an deine Fähigkeit, ein Gespräch zu führen und abzuschließen, ohne dabei arrogant zu wirken.

Self-Starter.
Du baust dir deine eigene Pipeline auf, statt auf eingehende Leads zu warten, und nutzt eine ruhige Woche, um noch aktiver zu prospektieren.

Coachable.
Du nimmst direktes Feedback an, ohne defensiv zu werden, und wendest es sichtbar im nächsten Gespräch an.

Resilient.
Du erholst dich schnell von einem verlorenen Deal oder einer schwierigen Woche und hältst deine Aktivität konstant hoch.

Fast Learner.
Du arbeitest dich schnell in ein technisches Produkt ein und kannst es Kund:innen verständlich erklären.

Structured.
Du hältst deine Pipeline sauber und deine CRM-Notizen zuverlässig, ohne dass man dir hinterherlaufen muss.

Who We Don’t Want

Relies on leads being handed over.
Du bist darauf angewiesen, dass Leads dir zugeteilt werden, und kannst oder willst nicht selbst aktiv Kund:innen akquirieren.

Gets defensive with feedback.
Du reagierst bei direktem Feedback defensiv, statt es anzunehmen und dich weiterzuentwickeln.

Weak written communication.
Du drückst dich schriftlich nicht klar und professionell aus.

In it for the paycheck alone.
Du jagst nur dem Gehalt hinterher und bringst kein echtes Interesse am Handwerk des Verkaufens mit.

Your Day To Day

Pipeline & Outbound (ca. 20%)

  • Neben eingehenden Leads baust du dir eigene Pipeline auf: Per Telefon, LinkedIn und E-Mail sprichst du Unternehmen im DACH-Raum an, für die Superchat einen echten Unterschied macht
  • Du entscheidest mit, welche Branchen und Accounts sich lohnen, und findest heraus, welche Ansprache funktioniert

Discovery & Demos (ca. 60%)

  • Im Erstgespräch findest du heraus, wo es in der Kundenkommunikation hakt, zum Beispiel bei unbeantworteten WhatsApp-Nachrichten, überlasteten Teams oder verstreuten Kanälen
  • In der Demo zeigst du nicht jedes Feature, sondern genau das, was das Problem deines Gegenübers löst

Closing & Forecast (ca. 20%)

  • Du verhandelst, räumst Einwände aus und bringst deine Deals selbstständig zum Abschluss
  • Deal-Stages und nächste Schritte pflegst du sauber in HubSpot, sodass du jederzeit weißt, wo deine Zahl steht
  • Was du in Kundengesprächen hörst, gibst du an Marketing und Produkt weiter

Stakeholders

Kund:innen: deine wichtigste Ansprechgruppe im täglichen Austausch - von der ersten Ansprache über Demos bis zum Abschluss
Sales Team: für gemeinsames Training, Knowledge-Sharing und den Austausch von Best Practices im Sales-Zyklus
Customer Success Team: für die Übergabe nach erfolgreichem Abschluss und einen reibungslosen Start ins Onboarding

Why People Choose Us

  • Wir glauben an Zusammenarbeit vor Ort: Wir sind gerne gemeinsam im Berliner Office. Genau dort entstehen die besten Ideen, Entscheidungen werden schneller getroffen, wir lernen voneinander und wachsen als Team enger zusammen. Etwas Flexibilität für Remote Work bieten wir, aber unser Default und unsere Energie liegen im gemeinsamen Office-Alltag
  • Wir sind ein internationales Team mit unterschiedlichsten kulturellen Hintergründen und Sprachen - Offenheit, gegenseitiger Respekt und der Austausch verschiedener Perspektiven prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit
  • Wir schätzen Ambition und Motivation - wir suchen Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Initiative zeigen und Lust haben, sich schnell weiterzuentwickeln
  • Wir arbeiten mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und einer starken Lernmentalität - Fragen stellen, neugierig bleiben und sich kontinuierlich verbessern gehört bei uns dazu
  • Wir legen Wert auf Humbleness und Teamgeist - no Ego, offenes Feedback und die Bereitschaft voneinander zu lernen sind uns wichtiger als Titel

Benefits & culture

  • Du hast die Wahl zwischen einer Urban Sports Club/John Reed Mitgliedschaft oder Fahrkarten/Dance-Abo

  • Jährliches Budget für persönliche Weiterbildung in Höhe von 500 € für zum Beispiel Konferenzen, Kurse, Bücher, Karrierecoach usw.

  • Schönes Büro im Herzen von Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) mit kostenlosen Snacks, Getränken und bester Ausstattung

We want to build a community, not just a company.

Uns ist wichtig, ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem Menschen wirklich gerne Zeit miteinander verbringen - egal ob beim HYROX-Training, Golfen, Beer-Pong-Turnieren, Running Clubs, Warhammer, gemeinsamen Wochenendaktivitäten oder welcher Community auch immer du hier aufbauen möchtest!

title: Junior Mechanical Engineer - CAD
descriptionHtml:
About us

We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies.

Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, we fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability.

We are well-capitalized and now assembling our team.

Our Locations: Vesoma has two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure.

Your mission

As a Junior Mechanical Engineer, you enter as a member of the early team building the physical body of our humanoid - an industrial-grade machine built for the highest levels of reliability and performance. You will work directly with our senior engineers to turn concepts into detailed CAD, back them up with calculations and simulation, and get parts built and tested. You learn fast, and you take pride in getting the basics right from day one.

Your profile

Key responsibilities

  • Detailed Design & CAD: Build and maintain CAD models, assemblies and production drawings from senior engineers' concepts - structural parts, brackets, housings and actuator components.

  • Engineering Calculations: Carry out bearing, fastener and strength calculations, document your assumptions clearly and review them with the team.

  • Simulation Support: Set up and run FEA studies (static, modal, thermal) and prepare the results for design reviews.

  • Prototyping & Testing: Prepare parts for manufacture (drawings, tolerances, BOMs), coordinate with the workshop and suppliers, and assemble and test prototypes - feeding what you learn straight back into the design.

  • DFM/DFA in Practice: Apply the team's DFM/DFA standards in your daily work and flag manufacturing or assembly issues early.

  • Documentation: Keep CAD data, BOMs, release status and design notes clean and up to date so the team can move fast.

  • Cross-Functional Support: Work with the AI, Controls and Software teams on integration details such as sensor mounts, cable routing and mass properties.

Who we are looking for
We seek builders ready to move beyond demos to real-world deployment - early-career engineers who value precision and reliability as much as innovation.

  • Experience: 2+ years of professional experience and a degree (BSc/MSc) in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, aerospace or a related field. Internships, working student roles, a hardware-focused thesis or student teams (e.g. Formula Student, robotics competitions) count.

  • Core Skills: Solid 3D CAD skills including clean production drawings and GD&T basics, and a strong grounding in machine elements and strength of materials (bearings, fasteners, stress analysis, load paths). Also expected:  

  • First hands-on FEA experience and the habit of sanity-checking results by hand.  

  • Working knowledge of common manufacturing processes (CNC machining, sheet metal, additive manufacturing, injection moulding) and how they shape a design. 

  • Comfortable in the workshop - assembling prototypes, measuring parts, 3D printing and basic machining.  

  • A basic understanding of kinematics and actuators is a plus.

  • Mindset: You balance the agility of a startup with the professional rigor required for a global industrial player. You are curious, take feedback well and own your work end to end - and you understand that a robot in the real world faces forces and failures that don't exist in a simulation.

Why us?

  • The Team: Work alongside leadership with a proven track record of building unicorn-scale companies and defining global robotics standards.

  • Smart Strategy: We operate as disciplined fast followers. Capital is timed to the deployment inflection point, avoiding early-mover dead ends to scale fast on proven foundations.

  • Resources: We are substantially internally funded and attract top-tier investors to avoid any capital constraints for our mission.

  • Historic Opportunity: Join at the dawn of a new industry comparable to the rise of the automobile. Help shape the European champion in this trillion-dollar market.

We are an equal opportunity employer.

title: Langfuse - Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
Why Design at Langfuse

Your work will shape how engineers build with AI.

Langfuse is often the primary interface engineers use to debug, evaluate, and improve their LLM applications. The designs you ship will be used for hours each day by thousands of developers and non-developers. They'll tell you about it in GitHub issues, on X, and in our community Slack channels. Everything we build is open source (MIT-licensed) and immediately visible.

The design challenges here are genuinely hard. You're designing for technical users and business users alike who care about information density, speed, and precision. Traces contain dozens of nested LLM calls with massive prompts and completions. Users need to set up evaluators, manage prompt versions, configure integrations, and build monitoring dashboards before they even start analyzing results. You need to make both the setup and the daily use feel intuitive and easy.

You will also have direct exposure to how cutting-edge LLM applications are built. Deeply understanding the problems our users solve will make you a better designer and along the way makes you an expert on LLM engineering yourself.

You will grow at Langfuse by

  • Owning our product design end-to-end. You'll be the first dedicated designer at Langfuse. Today, our engineers design as they build, which has gotten us far, but we need someone who can elevate the entire experience. You'll own the design system, and visual language across the product. You'll set the standard for how Langfuse looks and feels.

  • Making data-dense interfaces intuitive. Langfuse surfaces traces, scores, costs, latencies, token counts, prompt versions, and evaluation results. You'll figure out how to present complex, nested data in ways that help engineers find what they need fast.

  • Simplifying complex workflows. Our users run evaluations across datasets, compare experiment results, manage prompt versions, and set up monitoring. You'll map these workflows, identify friction, and design flows that feel obvious in hindsight.

  • Collaborating directly with product engineers. You'll pair with engineers, whiteboard solutions together, and ship designs that work within our existing component system (shadcn/ui, Tailwind). You'll create reusable, consistent UI patterns that the whole team can build with.

  • Shipping design straight to code. You'll use AI coding tools to implement smaller design fixes, build components for the design system, and polish UI details yourself. We are not looking for a perfect engineer here but for someone who can help themselvesherself.

What we're looking for

  • Experience in designing complex web applications, incl. a portfolio showcasing product work that users loved

  • Take ownership of our UI/UX made for developers

  • You want to talk to users

  • Hard worker and thrive working in a small and accountable team

  • Good understanding of best in class UI/UX

  • Excited about open source software and dev tools

Bonus points:

  • You can ship frontend code (we use Next.js, Tailwind, shadcn/ui)

  • ML/AI experience or familiarity with the LLM tooling ecosystem

  • Former founder or early startup experience

  • Contributions to open source projects or design systems

  • Side projects that show craft and taste

No candidate checks all boxes. If you feel you are a good fit for this role, please go ahead and apply.

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

title: Lead Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

What we're looking for

We’re looking for our first Lead Account Manager to join Omnea’s customer team. You’ll be excited to own expansion quotas and renewal outcomes for our rapidly scaling customer base, to build a function and to have a massively accelerated career trajectory.

You will own the relationship with our customers throughout the entire customer lifecycle, playing a crucial role in managing our largest and most strategic customers. Your key focus will be to ensure customers get meaningful value from Omnea from the earliest stages & beyond, and through your expertise and the building of deep & long-term relationships with our champions, you will drive renewals, expansion and upsell opportunities. You’ll become a trusted advisor & partner to our customers & stakeholders at all levels (from the procurement managers up to the CFOs) and be the voice of the customer internally, working closely with teams across the business (both technical and commercial) to help ensure we are truly operating with customer-centricity at our core.

You’ll be joining us at an incredibly exciting time, just as things are starting to take off! We're a Series A company having raised $25m from Accel, Point Nine, First Round, and 50+ renowned founders and industry experts. We’ve built an incredible & passionate team — every member was a top performer at their previous business - and our CEO, CCO & CFO went on a similar journey with Tessian, going from $0-30m ARR / $8-$500m valuation, and from pre-seed to Series C (Sequoia, Accel, etc.).

We've spent the past 18 months building & deploying our platform to many of the greatest tech companies out there (Lookout, McAfee, Onfido, Typeform, Proofpoint, etc.), all whilst managing to stay lean & operate efficiently.

Now we’re ready to scale. We are looking for our first Account Management Lead to help make Omnea one of Europe’s leading tech businesses: come build with us!

What Can You Expect?

You’ll do whatever it takes to support & champion our customers in their journey with Omnea. There’ll be a constant mix of strategic work (advising customers on company-wide transformation projects, refining our account management playbooks & processes, etc.) and operational work (driving upsell & expansion conversion, managing enterprise onboarding & deployments with your dedicated Solutions & Implementation Lead, etc.). And you’ll consistently be building meaningful relationships with customers, becoming their go-to person for all things Omnea.

  • You’ll focus on delivering long-term customer value in every interaction and build lasting relationships through consistent engagement with our customers - from the end users (Procurement/Finance/Ops ICs) through to the senior management of the companies (CFOs/CIOs/COOs) - resulting in deep trust, strong champions and reference points for all future customers.

  • You’ll be a trusted & strategic advisor to our customers, ensuring they are successful by partnering with key champions & executive sponsors to develop & execute a mutually agreed-upon success plan covering their entire lifecycle. You’ll act as their product expert, from advising on best-in-class configuration of the platform to sharing learnings from or introductions to similar customers.

  • You’ll own the retention and churn outcomes:

    • You’ll proactively drive towards renewal conversations and identity & close opportunities for multi-year contract extensions.

    • You’ll lead efforts to mitigate customer concerns, reduce churn, and enhance overall customer satisfaction and retention, focusing on both proactive and reactive strategies.

  • You’ll own Net Revenue Retention targets, identifying & closing expansion opportunities. You’ll proactively nurture customer accounts, deepening their understanding of product vision, value proposition and features.

  • You’ll identify advocates and expand our customer community to accelerate our GTM motion. You’ll develop and implement proactive initiatives to increase customer adoption and engagement: co-hosting Omnea roundtables with Sales, writing customer newsletters/blog posts/thought leadership etc. with Marketing. You’ll become well-known in this space.

  • You’ll form a pod with a Solutions & Implementation Lead to ensure you are well supported in expanding the accounts. Bring in our Technical Solutions Experts if you need support and the customer wants to go deeper.

  • You’ll partner with teams across the company - Product, Marketing, Sales - to integrate and align our retention & expansion strategies, translating customer insights into actionable feedback and help strategically guide the direction of the product based on the voice of the customer feedback. You’ll leverage these relationships to achieve success for your customers.

As we scale our Customer function, you’ll have an outsized impact on the business, working with our most strategic customers and defining our Customer Account Management & Success playbooks from the earliest stages. The future scope of this role will be defined by the person who takes on the challenge and ultimately, it is hoped that this person will become a future leader at Omnea.

About You

TL;DR: you’re ambitious & hard-working, and you’re as comfortable handling technical product demos as you are communicating to Execs about the success of a project. You make up for any potential lack of experience with hunger and a constant growth mindset. You are someone who will succeed at whatever you put your mind to. You’re intelligent & can work stuff out from first principles. You derive energy from building meaningful relationships, building a community & network around you, and being a true advocate and champion of our customers.

  • You have 5-7 years of experience succeeding in a B2B SaaS commercial role (i.e. you know you can sell! And can manage the longer-term success of customer accounts). You will have consistently performed at the top of your team‍ and are well-known/have a demonstrable history of having the happiest and most successful customers.

  • You’re entrepreneurial and want to be part of building a business. You want to rise faster or earn more than would be possible in any ‘normal’ career and you’re happy to roll up your sleeves and do whatever’s required. FYI, we've signed up to the Future Founder Promise.

  • You’ve got a track record of exceptional performance, whether it’s in academia, work, sport, a sales team, or whatever else you’ve put your mind to.

  • You have strong commercial intuition and have the gravitas to sell to senior leadership (eg. CFOs, CIOs). You can proactively recognise expansion opportunities and mitigate issues that could affect revenue retention.

  • You’re an outstanding communicator; verbal, written, and when presenting. You’re exceptionally articulate, concise and clear in all forms of communication and have the ability to build rapport, influence people & drive change, whether it’s with a distinguished exec, technical expert or a junior operator. You build ultimate trust with customer stakeholders.

  • You’re intelligent and have the capacity to rapidly understand our product inside and out, without the crutch of relying on sales engineers. You can simplify complex problems and translate them into next steps, product configuration or new feature requests.

  • You’re outcomes-focused, and balance the ability to think strategically with a heavy bias to action, always focused on “so what’s the next step?”.

  • You are proactive & crave accountability, proactively pushing initiatives forward and making the best use of the resources available to you.

  • You’re able to ruthlessly prioritise, are highly organised and focused on outputs > inputs. You are efficient & autonomous and don’t compromise on quality.

  • You’re ambitious, competitive, and care lots about your career. You are probably happiest when working really hard and solving challenging problems/winning deals. You know this requires dedication & some sacrifice but you think it’s worth it.

  • You’re just a really good human. You’re empathetic and reliable. You build trust with people you work with and are highly collaborative. You have minimal ego, seek feedback to continuously hone your craft and try to bring out the best in everyone around you.

Wir bei Gridty entwickeln eine KI-Plattform, die Unternehmen dabei unterstützt, ihren Energieverbrauch intelligent zu analysieren und nachhaltig zu reduzieren. ⚡️

Unsere Software verbindet Energiedaten aus vielen Standorten und technischen Anlagen, erkennt automatisch Anomalien und Ineffizienzen und unterstützt Energie- und Nachhaltigkeitsteams mit KI-Agenten bei der Analyse und Optimierung ihres Betriebs.

Unser Fokus liegt insbesondere auf Unternehmen mit vielen Standorten – etwa im Einzelhandel, in der Logistik und anderen energieintensiven Branchen.

Wer sind wir?

Wir sind ein dynamisches Energie- und KI-Startup aus Köln und gerade in einer spannenden Wachstumsphase.

Unsere Plattform ist live und bei ersten Kunden im Einsatz. Jetzt wollen wir den nächsten Schritt gehen: mehr Standorte, mehr Datenquellen, bessere automatisierte Analysen und eine Plattform, die mit unseren Kunden skalieren kann.

Dafür suchen wir einen Senior Software Engineer & Platform Lead (m/w/d), der Lust hat, früh Verantwortung zu übernehmen und unsere technische Plattform entscheidend mitzugestalten. 🚀

Unser Stack

Unter anderem arbeiten wir aktuell mit:

Python · FastAPI · React · TypeScript · PostgreSQL / Timeseries · Google Cloud · Docker · LLMs / AI Agents

Du musst nicht jedes einzelne Tool davon bereits beherrschen.

Wo arbeiten wir?

Gridty hat seinen Sitz in Köln. Wir arbeiten hybrid und treffen uns regelmäßig persönlich als Team.

Daher wäre es ideal, wenn du aus Köln oder der weiteren Region kommst bzw. regelmäßig vor Ort sein kannst. Gleichzeitig ist uns wichtiger, die richtige Person zu finden, als jeden Tag gemeinsam im selben Büro zu sitzen. 💻

Wie läuft unser Bewerbungsprozess?

  1. Kurzes Kennenlernen per Google Meet – ca. 15–30 Minuten

  3. Persönliches Kennenlernen in Köln

Interesse?

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Aufgaben

Du übernimmst eine zentrale technische Rolle bei Gridty und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns unsere Plattform weiter.

Konkret bedeutet das unter anderem:

  • Technische Ownership für zentrale Teile unserer Plattform und Software-Architektur

  • Weiterentwicklung unserer Cloud-Infrastruktur, Deployments und CI/CD-Prozesse

  • Monitoring, Security und Performance-Optimierung unserer Plattform

  • Mitgestaltung unserer technischen Roadmap und zukünftigen Architektur

Und vor allem: Du bekommst viel Gestaltungsspielraum und Verantwortung.

Wir sind ein kleines Team – gute Ideen verschwinden bei uns nicht in fünf Abstimmungsebenen, sondern können direkt Teil des Produkts werden.

Wer bist du?

Du…

  • hast Lust, an einem Produkt mit echtem Impact auf Energieverbrauch und CO₂-Emissionen zu arbeiten.

Lead Solution & Enterprise Architect

Shape complex technology solutions and help redefine the future of financial services.

Lead the design of complex, resilient technology solutions that help financial services organisations modernise their platforms, address architectural challenges and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

At Capco, you will play a pivotal role in delivering some of our clients’ most complex and high-profile transformation programmes, drawing on your expertise in solution architecture and technology transformation.

You will move between hands-on solution design, collaborating closely with engineers, and articulating compelling technology visions to senior stakeholders. You will bring sound technical judgement, constructive challenge and a clear understanding of client objectives to architectural decisions, ensuring that solutions are secure, maintainable and aligned with business priorities.

You will work across business, data, application and technology domains, guide cross-functional teams and support the development of colleagues. You will also have opportunities to contribute to enterprise architecture strategy and technology roadmaps, alongside supporting the growth of our Technology & Engineering Practice through community leadership, delivery excellence and business development.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the design and delivery of complex, scalable, secure and resilient solutions across legacy and cloud environments, applying modern distributed architecture patterns and engineering principles.

  • Translate business objectives into practical technology solutions, evaluating architectural options, managing technical trade-offs and ensuring designs deliver measurable value, reliability and long-term maintainability.

  • Lead cross-functional architecture and engineering teams, promoting collaboration, delivery excellence, continuous learning and the development of colleagues.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, communicate compelling architecture visions and influence strategic decisions while contributing to business development and commercial opportunities.

  • Explore and apply approved AI tools, automation and AI-enabled workflows to strengthen architecture analysis, design documentation and delivery efficiency, ensuring appropriate human review, security controls, responsible AI governance and clear escalation pathways.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience leading complex solution architecture initiatives, translating business and technology requirements into practical, high-quality solutions.

  • Strong architectural judgement, with the ability to evaluate options, challenge assumptions constructively and balance delivery priorities with security, reliability and maintainability.

  • Ability to build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, communicate complex technical concepts clearly and influence decisions across business and technology teams.

  • Experience guiding multidisciplinary technical teams, encouraging engineering excellence, collaboration, knowledge sharing and effective problem-solving.

  • Commercial awareness and a client-focused mindset, with the ability to understand business objectives, identify opportunities for improvement and deliver meaningful outcomes.

Technical Skills & Experience

Essential requirements

  • Strong solution architecture experience across legacy and cloud environments, including practical experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Google Cloud or Microsoft Azure.

  • Experience applying modern distributed architecture patterns, including microservices, event-driven, containerised, serverless and zero-trust architectures.

  • Working knowledge of recognised architecture frameworks and methods, including TOGAF, Zachman, Domain-driven Design or NIST.

  • Experience working within Agile and DevOps delivery environments, collaborating closely with engineering teams to support effective solution implementation.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience shaping enterprise architecture strategies, technology roadmaps and governance frameworks across complex organisations.

  • Experience designing greenfield architectures, cloud-first enterprises or establishing and maturing enterprise architecture functions within agile delivery environments.

  • Senior-level consulting experience, ideally within financial services or other regulated industries with complex compliance, risk and security requirements.

  • Experience leading pre-sales activities, proposals or bids, including commercial ownership and client engagement.

  • Awareness of emerging AI capabilities, including Generative AI and Agentic AI, and their potential application to enterprise architecture and engineering productivity; relevant professional certifications in architecture frameworks or cloud technologies are also welcomed.

Why Join Capco

  • Deliver high-impact technology solutions for Tier 1 financial institutions.

  • Work in a collaborative, flat and entrepreneurial consulting culture.

  • Access continuous learning, training and industry certifications.

  • Be part of a team shaping the future of digital financial services.

  • Help shape the future of digital transformation across financial services and energy.

Benefits

  • Core Benefits: Discretionary bonus, competitive pension, health insurance, life insurance and critical illness cover.

title: Legal
descriptionHtml:
About Nomos

Europe pays more than twice as much for electricity as the US or Asia. To reach competitive price levels, Europe has to lean on solar and deliver the flexibility that makes this feasible. Nomos is building a full-stack power company to unlock that flexibility by connecting millions of homes to Europe’s energy markets.

At Nomos, we care about our craft and take full responsibility for what we build. We hire for spikes, not an absence of weaknesses, and look for exceptional ability backed by a record of achievement. This has brought together IMO and IOI medalists, former founders and Olympic athletes in a team whose individual strengths reinforce one another.

 

What you’ll do

Nomos operates in a heavily regulated industry and we take that responsibility seriously. You will build and lead our legal function as we develop new products, enter partnerships, and grow the company.

  • Lead negotiations and own our contracts with partners, grid operators, and service providers.

  • Own regulatory compliance and consumer protection, anticipating changes that affect our products and plans.

  • Manage legal work across financing rounds, employment, and technology, coordinating specialist counsel where needed.

 

Exciting challenges

  • Build the function from scratch. Decide which work to bring in-house, where we need external counsel, and what we can standardise or automate. Build the contracts and processes we will rely on as Nomos grows.

  • Follow the consequences through the business. A new product can change our obligations to households, our agreements with partners, and the way our software needs to work. Understand those connections and work through them before we commit.

 

Who you are

  • You can defend your judgement. You hold a state exam or equivalent qualification and have handled complex legal work in energy, another regulated industry, or a company that grew fast. You can explain your recommendation and the reasoning behind it.

  • You read what others skim. You check definitions, cross-references, and exceptions. You spot where a small change in wording creates a different obligation and follow it through to what it means in practice.

  • German and English, both fluent. You can negotiate and draft precise legal documents in either language.

 

Why join us?

As an early member of Nomos, you’ll help shape the company and share in its financial upside. Backed by Index Ventures, we’re building a European category leader in one of the world’s largest industries, making electricity affordable and Europe more competitive.

Building a power company from scratch brings complex, rewarding challenges and the chance to solve Europe’s energy crisis for the long term. You’ll learn from people with exceptional depth in their fields, challenge each other’s thinking and take responsibility from the start.

title: Major Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today’s threats and prepare for a quantum-safe future at www.digicert.com

Job summary

As a Major Account Executive, you will be responsible for driving profitable revenue growth across a defined portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts and high-potential prospects in Central Europe.

You will own the full sales cycle, from identifying and developing new business opportunities to expanding existing customer relationships and closing complex, high-value enterprise agreements. By combining a consultative, value-based sales approach with a strong understanding of cybersecurity and digital trust, you will position DigiCert as a strategic partner to senior business and technology leaders.

You will build trusted relationships with C-level executives, including CIOs, CISOs and CTOs, as well as IT infrastructure, security, architecture, and procurement stakeholders. Working closely with Sales Engineering, Sales Development, Marketing, Partner Sales, Customer Success, and executive leadership, you will develop account strategies that generate sustainable growth and long-term customer value.

This is a quota-carrying role for an entrepreneurial, results-oriented enterprise sales professional who thrives in complex customer environments and takes full ownership of commercial outcomes.

What you will do

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Account Development & New Business Acquisition

  • Develop and execute strategic account plans for assigned enterprise accounts and high-potential prospects.
  • Identify, qualify, and close new-logo opportunities while driving upsell and cross-sell growth within existing customers.
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline through proactive prospecting, targeted outreach, executive engagement, and collaboration with Sales Development and partners.
  • Map customer organizations, identify business sponsors and decision-makers, and develop relationships across multiple functions and buying personas.
  • Establish DigiCert as a strategic partner for digital trust, cybersecurity, and enterprise security transformation.

Consultative & Value-Based Selling

  • Understand customer business priorities, security challenges, operational requirements, and regulatory obligations.
  • Translate complex technical capabilities into clear business outcomes, including risk reduction, operational efficiency, cost optimization, automation, and compliance.
  • Position DigiCert's portfolio across PKI, Certificate Lifecycle Management, TLS/SSL, enterprise identity, software and device trust, DNS security, and emerging digital trust requirements.
  • Develop compelling value propositions and business cases tailored to each customer's strategic objectives.
  • Engage customers on relevant industry developments, including shortening certificate lifetimes, cryptographic agility, post-quantum cryptography, and the growing importance of machine and AI identities.

Enterprise Sales Execution & Deal Management

  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from initial qualification through negotiation, contracting, and close.
  • Develop and execute opportunity strategies, including stakeholder mapping, decision criteria, competitive positioning, commercial strategy, and closing plans.
  • Apply structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC or MEDDIC to qualify opportunities, identify risks, and improve conversion rates.
  • Negotiate commercial agreements that deliver sustainable revenue growth and long-term customer value.
  • Coordinate internal resources effectively to remove obstacles, accelerate sales cycles, and maximize win rates.

Executive Engagement & Customer Relationships

  • Build trusted relationships with senior executives and key decision-makers across IT, cybersecurity, infrastructure, procurement, and business leadership.
  • Lead executive-level discussions focused on business priorities, digital trust strategy, security transformation, and long-term technology roadmaps.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of customer satisfaction, competitive developments, and potential retention or expansion risks.
  • Ensure customer commitments are coordinated with the appropriate technical, implementation, and post-sales teams.
  • Represent DigiCert with professionalism and credibility at executive meetings, customer workshops, and industry events.

Partner & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with strategic partners, including system integrators, managed service providers, and technology resellers, to identify and develop joint opportunities.
  • Build effective relationships with Sales Engineering, Sales Development, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partner Sales to maximize account penetration and revenue potential.
  • Leverage partner capabilities and executive sponsorship to accelerate market access and enterprise deal execution.
  • Share market intelligence, customer feedback, and competitive insights to strengthen DigiCert's regional go-to-market strategy.

Pipeline Management, Forecasting & Performance

  • Own the assigned revenue target and consistently deliver against bookings and new-business objectives.
  • Maintain sufficient qualified pipeline coverage through disciplined prospecting and opportunity development.
  • Deliver accurate, timely, and transparent forecasts, supported by clear evidence of customer engagement and next steps.
  • Maintain high-quality opportunity data, account plans, activity records, and sales forecasts in Salesforce.
  • Proactively identify risks, develop mitigation plans, and communicate deal progress and resource requirements to sales leadership.

What you will have

Experience & Track Record

  • At least 7+ years of successful, quota-carrying sales experience in enterprise software, technology, cybersecurity, or a related B2B technology environment.
  • A proven track record of acquiring new enterprise customers and expanding strategic accounts.
  • Demonstrated success managing complex, consultative sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and senior decision-makers.
  • Experience selling subscription-based solutions, enterprise software, managed services, or other multi-year commercial agreements.
  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to manage negotiations, build business cases, and close high-value opportunities.
  • Experience with structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC or MEDDIC is strongly preferred.

Skills & Competencies

  • Executive presence: Ability to establish credibility and build lasting relationships with C-level stakeholders.
  • Consultative selling: Strong discovery, listening, questioning, and value-articulation skills.
  • Strategic thinking: Ability to translate customer business objectives into actionable account and opportunity strategies.
  • Sales discipline: Strong pipeline management, forecasting accuracy, prioritization, and execution.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset: Self-motivated, proactive, resilient, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, growth-oriented environment.
  • Collaboration: Ability to mobilize cross-functional teams and leverage internal and external resources effectively.
  • Technical curiosity: Willingness to develop a strong understanding of cybersecurity, PKI, digital identities, certificate automation, and digital trust technologies.

Education & Languages

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • Professional fluency in German and English.
  • Additional European languages are an advantage.
  • Willingness to travel regularly within the assigned territory.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means building a sustainable, high-quality enterprise business through new customer acquisition, strategic account expansion, and disciplined execution.

Key indicators of success include:

  • Consistent achievement of annual bookings and revenue targets.
  • Strong pipeline coverage and accurate forecasting.
  • Successful acquisition of new strategic enterprise customers.
  • Measurable upsell and cross-sell growth within existing accounts.
  • High-quality executive relationships and a strong understanding of customer business priorities.
  • Effective collaboration with partners and internal teams.
  • Strong customer satisfaction, long-term account development, and sustainable commercial outcomes.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, including uncapped commission (role-dependent) 
  • Achievers Club awards and performance-based incentives 
  • Pension and retirement benefits (location dependent) 
  • Life insurance and income protection coverage 
  • Comprehensive health and wellness support, including medical coverage (where applicable), gym reimbursement, and mental wellbeing resources 
  • Employee Assistance Program with 24/7 confidential support for employees and their families 
  • Generous paid time off, including holidays and additional leave options 
  • Family-friendly leave policies, including maternity, paternity, and other supportive leave programs 
  • Education assistance and professional development opportunities 
  • Access to LinkedIn Learning and continuous learning resources 
  • Employee referral bonus program and additional company perks and discounts 
  • Internal rewards and recognition platform (Motivosity) to celebrate and acknowledge project wins, milestone achievements, and the outstanding contributions of our colleagues
  • Business travel insurance and global employee support programs 

To protect candidate information and maintain a secure hiring process, all applications must be submitted through our careers portal. Resumes or CVs sent directly via email will not be reviewed or considered.

We are committed to fair and transparent pay practices and comply with all applicable pay transparency requirements. If you would like more information about compensation or benefits, we are happy to provide additional details during the hiring process.

title: Manager Service Operations & AI
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij een ervaren IT Operations Manager die niet alleen een supportorganisatie kan aansturen, maar ook kansen ziet om dienstverlening slimmer en efficiënter te maken met AI? Dan hebben wij een interessante uitdaging voor je.

Voor Fivespark, een ambitieuze Managed Service Provider in Amstelveen, zoeken wij een Manager Service Operations & AI. In deze veelzijdige functie combineer je operationeel leiderschap met procesverbetering, automatisering en de verdere ontwikkeling van een eigen AI-agent.

Je krijgt de verantwoordelijkheid over een team van 12 supportprofessionals én speelt een belangrijke rol in de transformatie naar een steeds verder geautomatiseerde IT-dienstverlening.

Over Fivespark

Fivespark is een innovatieve Managed Service Provider die bedrijven en overheden ondersteunt met moderne IT-oplossingen.

De organisatie werkt aan de Managed Service Provider van de toekomst, waarin automatisering, kunstmatige intelligentie en datagedreven processen een steeds grotere rol spelen.

Een belangrijk onderdeel hiervan is Sparkle, een intern ontwikkelde AI-agent die nu al ondersteunt bij ticketregistratie, triage, klantvragen en routering. De ambitie is om Sparkle verder te ontwikkelen tot een volwaardige digitale collega die steeds meer operationele processen zelfstandig en betrouwbaar kan uitvoeren.

De organisatie kenmerkt zich door korte lijnen, een informele werksfeer en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en verantwoordelijkheid.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Manager Service Operations & AI ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing en verdere professionalisering van de tweedelijns supportorganisatie. Tegelijkertijd speel je een centrale rol in het ontwikkelen en implementeren van AI en automatisering.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan uit vier belangrijke onderdelen.

Leidinggeven aan de supportorganisatie

  • Je geeft leiding aan een team van 12 tweedelijns supportmedewerkers.

  • Je coacht en ontwikkelt medewerkers en zorgt voor duidelijke prioriteiten, structuur en samenwerking.

  • Je bewaakt de kwaliteit, capaciteit, continuïteit en prestaties van de dienstverlening.

  • Je signaleert knelpunten en vertaalt deze naar concrete verbeteracties.

Doorontwikkelen van AI-agent Sparkle

  • Je bent functioneel eigenaar van Sparkle en bepaalt mede de visie, roadmap en prioriteiten.

  • Je vertaalt operationele uitdagingen naar praktische AI-toepassingen.

  • Je zorgt ervoor dat Sparkle veilig, betrouwbaar en gebruiksvriendelijk functioneert.

  • Je werkt samen met technische specialisten aan de verdere ontwikkeling van deze digitale collega.

Processen verbeteren en automatiseren

  • Je analyseert bestaande operationele processen en identificeert mogelijkheden voor automatisering.

  • Je optimaliseert workflows, kennisbanken en werkinstructies.

  • Je zorgt voor een goede samenwerking tussen medewerkers en AI.

  • Je draagt bij aan de ambitie om minimaal 75% van de standaard operationele processen met AI te ondersteunen of volledig te automatiseren.

Verandering begeleiden

  • Je werkt samen met Operations, Software Development, Business Consultancy en externe partners.

  • Je begeleidt medewerkers in de overgang naar een meer AI-gedreven manier van werken.

  • Je creëert draagvlak, communiceert helder en zorgt ervoor dat veranderingen daadwerkelijk worden doorgevoerd.

Wie zoeken wij?

Wij zoeken een operationeel sterke manager die structuur weet aan te brengen, medewerkers kan motiveren en tegelijkertijd vooruitkijkt naar de mogelijkheden van nieuwe technologie.

Je begrijpt hoe een IT-supportorganisatie werkt, weet hoe je processen beheersbaar en voorspelbaar maakt en krijgt energie van het continu verbeteren van de dienstverlening.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • Hbo- of wo-werk- en -denkniveau.

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen Managed Services, ICT Operations of IT Service Management.

  • Ervaring met het aansturing, coachen en ontwikkelen van operationele teams.

  • Goede kennis van ITIL-processen en servicemanagement.

  • Affiniteit met AI, automatisering en digitale innovatie.

  • Sterke analytische en organisatorische vaardigheden.

  • Het vermogen om technische mogelijkheden te vertalen naar concrete operationele verbeteringen.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en ervaring met verandermanagement.

Je hoeft geen AI-developer te zijn. We zoeken juist iemand die begrijpt hoe je AI en automatisering succesvol inzet binnen een operationele IT-organisatie en medewerkers hierin weet mee te nemen.

Wat kun je verwachten?

Je komt rechtstreeks in dienst bij onze opdrachtgever en krijgt een sleutelrol binnen een organisatie die volop investeert in de toekomst van IT-dienstverlening.

Je kunt rekenen op:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris van €4.487 tot €6.494, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.

  • Een mobiliteitsbudget van €850 per maand, vrij in te zetten op de manier die bij jou past.

  • Een fulltime dienstverband.

  • Flexibele werkmogelijkheden en ruimte om hybride te werken.

  • Veel zelfstandigheid en directe invloed op de ontwikkeling van de organisatie.

  • Ruime mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling.

  • De kans om actief bij te dragen aan innovatieve AI- en automatiseringsprojecten.

  • Een informele en professionele werkomgeving met korte lijnen.

  • Een betrokken team van collega's dat samenwerkt aan verbetering en innovatie.

Waarom is dit een interessante functie?

Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is de combinatie van peoplemanagement, operationele verantwoordelijkheid en AI-innovatie.

Je krijgt niet alleen de opdracht om een bestaande supportorganisatie goed te laten functioneren, maar ook om deze klaar te maken voor de toekomst.

Daarbij krijg je de ruimte om processen structureel te verbeteren, nieuwe technologie toe te passen en daadwerkelijk invloed uit te oefenen op de manier waarop IT-dienstverlening wordt georganiseerd.

Een mooie uitdaging voor een ervaren Service Delivery Manager, IT Operations Manager of Support Manager die toe is aan een volgende stap.

Interesse?

Wil jij leidinggeven aan een IT-supportorganisatie én een belangrijke rol spelen in de verdere ontwikkeling van AI binnen Managed Services?

Dan komen wij graag met je in contact!

title: MD-Expert:in (m/w/d) – Prüfmanagement
descriptionHtml:
Über Valova

Wir entwickeln KI-Software für Krankenhäuser, die administrative Prozesse in Dokumentation, Kodierung und Abrechnung automatisiert. Damit entlasten wir Klinikteams, sichern Erlöse und schaffen mehr Zeit für Patient.

Unser ambitioniertes Team aus Medizin, Technologie und Business arbeitet daran, die Krankenhausverwaltung nachhaltig zu verändern.

Warum diese Rolle zählt

In der MD-Prüfung werden Erlöse gesichert oder verloren. Jede verpasste Frist, jede fehlende Unterlage und jede schwache Begründung kostet Kliniken Geld, das sie längst erwirtschaftet haben, und ab 2027 steigen die Prüfquoten deutlich. Valova ist gebaut, um das zu ändern, aber nur, wenn unsere Software MD-Prüfungen so gut versteht wie die besten Expert:innen auf beiden Seiten des Tisches.

Genau hier kommst Du ins Spiel. Als unsere MD-Expertin bzw. unser MD-Experte sorgst Du dafür, dass Valova den Prüfprozess von Anfang bis Ende beherrscht, und bringst unser Produkt in den Klinikalltag. Du bist die Brücke zwischen Prüfpraxis und Code und zwischen unserem Team und den Menschen, die täglich mit Valova arbeiten.

Was Du bewirkst, siehst Du schwarz auf weiß: in weniger verlorenen Prüfungen, erfolgreichen Widersprüchen und Stunden, die das Medizincontrolling zurückgewinnt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Valova die MD-Prüfung beibringen: Du übersetzt Prüfgegenstände, Fristen nach PrüfvV und die Prüfquotensystematik in klare fachliche Anforderungen.

  • Prüfrisiken früh erkennen: Du entwickelst Regeln und Testfälle, die prüfanfällige Fälle und Dokumentationslücken erkennen, bevor die Rechnung rausgeht.

  • Die Verteidigung aufbauen: Du legst fest, wie Valova für jeden Fall eine belegbare Argumentation vorbereitet, von der Unterlagenauswahl bis zum Widerspruch.

  • Veränderungen im Blick behalten: Du verfolgst PrüfvV, Prüfquoten und Rechtsprechung und bringst Änderungen ins Produkt.

Was Du mitbringst

  • Fundierte Ausbildung: Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung in einem Gesundheitsfachberuf mit Weiterbildung zur Kodierfachkraft oder im Medizincontrolling, oder ein Medizinstudium.

  • MD-Erfahrung: Mindestens drei Jahre im MD-Prüfgeschehen, idealerweise als Gutachter:in beim Medizinischen Dienst, alternativ im Medizincontrolling einer Klinik.

  • Sicher im Detail: Du kennst Dich mit ICD-10-GM, OPS, DKR und PrüfvV aus und weißt, woran ein Gutachten scheitert.

  • Präzises Denken: Du hinterfragst gern Prozesse und beschreibst Regeln so genau, dass Software sie umsetzen kann.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du bist im Gespräch mit Ärzt:innen, MD, Kostenträgern und Technik gleichermaßen sicher.

  • Ein Plus: Erfahrung mit KIS- oder Prüfmanagement-Software (z. B. Orbis, SAP IS-H, i.s.h.med) oder Software-Einführungen, Erfahrung mit Sozialgerichtsverfahren sowie erste Erfahrung mit Datenanalyse (Excel, SQL) oder KI-Anwendungen.

  • Dir fehlen ein oder zwei Punkte, aber Du bist überzeugt, die richtige Person für diese Rolle zu sein? Dann bewirb Dich trotzdem. Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Flexible Arbeitszeit. 30 bis 40 Stunden pro Woche, Du entscheidest. Unbefristeter Vertrag.

  • 100 % remote in ganz Deutschland, optional mit dem Team in München oder Berlin.

  • Faires Gehalt, orientiert an Deiner Erfahrung und mindestens auf Klinik-Niveau. Die konkrete Spanne nennen wir Dir schon im ersten Gespräch.

  • Sinn mit Hebel. Statt Rückstände in einer Klinik abzuarbeiten, entlastest Du Kodierteams in vielen Kliniken gleichzeitig.

  • Direkter Draht zu den Gründern. Du arbeitest täglich mit Sophia, Ärztin und ehemalige McKinsey-Beraterin, und Christian, der zwei Health-Tech-Startups gegründet und ein Jahrzehnt lang klinische Systeme gebaut hat. Keine Hierarchieebenen, kein wochenlanges Warten auf Freigaben.

title: Mechatronics and Hardware Test Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
The Mechatronics Teams at Agile Robots are looking for a Mechatronics and Hardware Test Engineer (m/f/d). We are seeking an experienced and curious, hands-on generalist with a multidisciplinary background who thrives across mechanical, electrical, and software engineering domains.

Responsibilities

  • Test Automation: Plan, design, and automate test setups and fixtures for robot prototypes, subassemblies, and components across the product lifecycle.
  • Test Execution: Run tests, analyze the test data, and report findings to the engineering teams.
  • Root Cause Analysis: Investigate and diagnose product defects and quality issues to support corrective actions.
  • Technical Reviews: Work with development, quality, and production teams, and represent testing in technical reviews.
  • Documentation: Create, standardize, and maintain test specifications, procedures, and reports.
  • Test Methods: Identify and implement improvements to existing test methods to increase efficiency, coverage, and repeatability.
  • Production Support: Support manufacturing and production teams in troubleshooting and resolving test-related issues.

Essential Skills

  • Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in mechatronics, robotics, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent qualification.
  • System Verification: At least three years of industry experience testing, verifying, and validating complex mechatronic or robotic systems.
  • Python Programming: Professional experience writing Python for test automation, using Git-based version control such as GitLab.
  • Sensor Integration: Experience implementing and maintaining sensor applications, such as force and torque, position, or temperature sensors.
  • Industrial Interfaces: Practical experience with Linux environments, including Bash scripting, and with industrial communication protocols and real-time bus systems such as OPC UA or EtherCAT.

Beneficial Skills

  • Hardware Work: Experience with CAD for mechanical design, such as SolidWorks, or PCB layout tools, such as Altium, and practical workshop skills such as soldering, harness wiring, mechanical assembly, and prototyping.
  • Safety Standards: Experience with certification and functional safety standards, such as ISO 10218, ISO 13849, or IEC 60204.
  • Factory Automation: Background in industrial robotics or factory automation, including PLC programming and integration, for example with TwinCAT or Beckhoff.
  • Real-Time Programming: Familiarity with C++ and MATLAB/Simulink for real-time applications.
  • Quality Tools: Familiarity with requirements and quality management tools such as Jama or SAP.
  • German Language: German language proficiency.
  • Driving License: Valid Class B driving license or equivalent.

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots is a leading provider of AI-powered robotics solutions. By combining artificial intelligence and robotics, the company makes industries smarter, more flexible, and more efficient. 

Founded in Munich in 2018 by renowned robotics researchers from the German Aerospace Center (DLR), Agile Robots has experienced rapid global growth. Today, more than 3,500 highly skilled robotics and AI enthusiasts are employed worldwide. The company has one of the largest research and development teams in the AI and robotics industry. 

Agile Robots has built a unique portfolio, together with the subsidiaries BÄR Automation, Franka Robotics, idealworks, and Krause Automation, the company covers all areas of AI-driven robotics.

title: Member of Technical Staff (Web Access Engineer, Crawler)
descriptionHtml:
Perplexity is hiring a Web Access Engineer for the Crawler team to build reliable fetching and rendering systems for AI-powered search. You'll work on freely available public web content, within site permissions and approved access policies, and develop the infrastructure that supplies content to downstream indexing and retrieval systems.

Your focus will be diagnosing network errors, page-loading issues, and incomplete rendering. You'll trace problems from network protocols through client-side execution, distinguish technical failures from intentional access restrictions, and turn findings into production fixes that improve content quality and efficiency at scale.

Responsibilities

  • Own fetching and rendering improvements end to end, from investigation through implementation and production rollout, partnering with crawler engineers and SREs.

  • Investigate fetch and rendering failures across DNS, TLS, HTTP, caching, redirects, and client-side rendering, and classify root causes.

  • Improve page loading, completion detection, and content capture to preserve relevant content and handle dynamic pages reliably.

  • Ensure the crawler respects site-imposed access restrictions and rate limits, identifies itself clearly, and retries only transient technical errors.

  • Build tools to reproduce failures, compare crawler output against expected page content, and turn findings into regression tests.

  • Define metrics for fetching reliability, content completeness, and error classification, and use them to prioritize improvements.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in web infrastructure, browsers, CDNs, or crawling, with strong programming skills in at least one of Go, Python, Rust, or C++.

  • Deep understanding of HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, and HTTP/3, including status semantics, caching, conditional requests, content encoding, and redirects; strong knowledge of TLS, DNS, cookies, and sessions.

  • Understanding of CDN caching and content delivery, HTTP error handling, retry backoff, and server-defined rate limits.

  • Knowledge of page lifecycle, network idle, service workers, client-side rendering, and shadow DOM; experience debugging JavaScript and fluency with Chrome DevTools, CDP, HAR files, curl, and packet captures.

  • Comfort working independently when the path forward is not fully defined.

Nice to have

  • Experience developing CDN, caching, or web performance systems.

  • Experience operating crawlers, headless browsers, or distributed content-acquisition systems at scale.

  • Contributions to a browser engine or JavaScript runtime.

title: Mobile UI Designer

We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

We are looking for a Mobile UI Designer to create elegant, intuitive and high-performing mobile experiences for BJAK's AI Neobank and financial products.

This role is for someone who loves designing mobile interfaces that feel effortless, responsive and visually refined. You'll work alongside engineers and product managers to create experiences used daily by millions of users.

  • Design beautiful and intuitive interfaces for iOS and Android applications.

  • Design mobile experiences across insurance, payments, claims, investments and financial services.

  • Iterate designs using analytics, usability findings and product feedback.

  • Ensure consistency across different devices, screen sizes and operating systems.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience designing mobile applications.

  • Strong portfolio showcasing high-quality mobile UI work.

  • Expert proficiency in Figma and interactive prototyping.

  • Deep understanding of iOS Human Interface Guidelines and Android Material Design.

  • Strong understanding of mobile usability, responsive layouts and interaction design.

  • Ability to simplify complex financial workflows into clean mobile experiences.

  • Portfolio is required.

Design Stack

  • FigJam

  • Design Systems

  • Auto Layout

  • Interactive Prototyping

  • iOS Human Interface Guidelines

  • Material Design

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks mobile-first.

  • Notices small UI inconsistencies before users do.

  • Cares about accessibility, responsiveness and performance.

  • Collaborates closely with engineers to deliver high-quality products.

  • Takes pride in shipping pixel-perfect interfaces.

This Role Is Not For

  • Designers whose experience is primarily marketing or branding.

  • People who design without considering real user behaviour.

  • Designers unfamiliar with mobile platform conventions.

  • Individuals who struggle to collaborate with engineers.

  • Candidates who cannot explain the rationale behind their design decisions.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our primary working language across our global teams. Strong English communication skills are required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Portfolio review

  3. Role-specific interview

  4. CEO / Final interview

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments promptly will be prioritized.

We've created this website packed full of information about moving to New Zealand to work for Propellerhead, if you're interested in making the move to our wonderful country.
