The Role:

At Propellerhead, the Technical Strategist role focuses on the delivery of resilient software systems that power everything from complex infrastructure to innovative new platforms. This role works alongside our Product Strategists to shape the technical specification and platform direction for a portfolio of client products.

We’re looking for someone who combines architectural insight with a strong hands-on engineering background and a genuinely AI-native way of working. You will have spent the formative part of your career as a software developer and still be confident with understanding the structure of software solutions. You'll have knowledge of emerging trends and you are agentic-first where you reach for AI to rapidly prototype new ideas and judge their value in hours, not weeks, and you are at home with directing an AI-assisted delivery pipeline.

You will lead and guide the design of complex systems, and we'll depend on your extensive experience, judgement and insights to ensure that early delivery and continuous improvement is possible. You’ll be applying and reinforcing Engineering standards for programming, and shape the technical solutions our AI-assisted pipeline builds, in a lean and evolutionary manner. Importantly, you will be responsible for ensuring that client platforms align with our technical strategy. You will work closely with the Chief Technologist and Engineering Principal to apply standards, patterns, and tooling in client contexts, and provide informed input into technical strategy through client platform insights and delivery experience.

Propellerhead operates a hybrid working model (work from our office and from your own home). While you must be based in Auckland for this role, we warmly welcome applications from across New Zealand and internationally who are planning to relocate to Auckland. This particular role requires regular in-person office attendance.

We offer a culture built on trust, continuous learning, and meaningful impact. You'll join a team that values integrity over ego, and clarity over complexity.

If you're looking to contribute your insight and engineering experience to projects that matter - we would like to hear from you.

  • 8+ years of experience with the development of multi-tier and distributed applications.
  • Agentic-first: very comfortable using AI to rapidly prototype, shape solutions, and direct an AI-assisted delivery pipeline across requirements, testing and code generation. This is central to the role.
  • A confident, credible communicator and presenter in front of senior client stakeholders.

  • Strong communication skills must be demonstrable, with tangible examples of your skills to bridge technical solutions with business needs and present these concepts to a variety of internal and customer stakeholders.
  • Hands-on experience with designing solutions on Azure is essential, including active participation in building CI/CD pipelines and instrumenting for operations, is required.
  • Experience with streaming and messaging platforms, such as Kafka or NATS, is highly desirable.
  • Proven experience in leading the design of complex software applications, preferably for corporate enterprise, where solutions comprise existing services alongside custom development.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. You will represent Propellerhead in front of stakeholders, so a professional, confident presence and the ability to communicate and influence with clarity are essential.
  • We are particularly looking for technical leaders with experience or demonstrable interest in any of the following: digital identity, verifiable credentials, open banking, AI agent authorization, edge or device-based software deployment.

    • Responsibilities:
  • Authoring, reviewing and communicating solution architecture and specifications in collaboration with the Development teams and our core Engineering team.
  • Championing the technical strategy of Propellerhead as our key business differentiator, and aligning design and implementation of the solutions in your portfolio in line with that technical vision.
  • Building trusted relationships with key client decision-makers. You will be responsible for ensuring our teams understand technical requirements and for clearly explaining our solution design to client technologists.
  • You will be the go-to technical person for our client’s solutions, including facilitating any technical pre-requisites for delivery or addressing improvements from operational feedback.
  • Developing strategies to ensure quality measures such as speed-to-value, security, reliability, maintainability, performance and functional fit for purpose.
  • Specifically, you will be facilitating the evolution of our code base from C# to Rust and the ecosystem of tools, practices and services that implies, with AI central to how we handle requirements, testing and code generation.

    • About Propellerhead:

We place emphasis on producing technology which is meaningful, has value, and can make a difference in the world. We foster long lasting and trusting relationships with all our clients. Over our 20+ years in the market we have worked with a diverse range of commercial, non-profit, and government organisations.

Our work starts from real stakeholder needs and the value they unlock, with an AI-assisted pipeline now generating much of the code.As a result, our digital platforms are a mixture of custom components and external services which produce a powerful and engaging experience when combined.

title: Operations Assistant (Lab and Office)
descriptionHtml:
About IMU Biosciences

IMU Biosciences has developed proprietary platform technologies that generate and translate vast system-level immune data into actionable insights and tools to drive the development of precision medicines across a variety of diseases. IMU leverages advanced immune profiling with proprietary AI and machine learning analytics to uncover novel clinical immune signatures. IMU continues to establish partnerships with leading pharma and biotech companies to advance disease diagnosis, optimise product selection, and improve patient stratification and monitoring - while also building its own pipeline of innovative products.

Job Description

Job Title: Operations Assistant (Lab and Office)
Department: Laboratory
Term: Full-time
Location: Canary Wharf, London (on-site, 5 days per week)
Reports To: Caitlin Dwight-Evans, Laboratory Manager

Overview

We are looking for a reliable, practical and organised Lab & Office Operations Assistant to provide hands-on support with the day-to-day running of our laboratory and office.

This is a varied, task-focused role involving routine laboratory housekeeping, stock management, deliveries, cleaning, waste handling and general administrative support. The ideal candidate will enjoy practical work, take pride in completing tasks thoroughly and be happy to lend a hand wherever needed.

About the Role

Working alongside the Laboratory Manager and Lab Operations team, you will help keep our laboratory and office clean, organised, well-stocked and running smoothly.

This is primarily a practical, hands-on support role rather than a scientific or research position. You will be responsible for a mixture of daily, weekly and ad-hoc tasks, ranging from routine laboratory maintenance and stock replenishment to general office administration.

We are looking for someone who is dependable, comfortable carrying out repetitive tasks, able to follow established procedures and happy to adapt to changing priorities. You should be willing to get stuck in and support the team with practical tasks as they arise.

The role is based at our head office in Canary Wharf and requires on-site attendance five days per week during standard working hours.

Core Responsibilities

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

Lab

  • Receive, unpack, check and correctly store laboratory deliveries.

  • Assist with ordering, restocking and managing laboratory consumables and supplies.

  • Autoclave laboratory waste in accordance with established procedures and training.

  • Assist with laboratory waste management and recycling, including the daily removal of waste from designated laboratory areas.

  • Carry out routine laboratory cleaning, including wiping down surfaces, workbenches and equipment.

  • Maintain laboratory organisation and housekeeping, including keeping storage areas, cupboards and supply stations tidy and appropriately stocked.

  • Follow laboratory Health & Safety procedures, including the correct use of PPE, and help remind employees and visitors of established laboratory requirements.

  • Undertake routine manual handling tasks, including moving boxes, storing supplies and relocating appropriate equipment, in accordance with safe manual handling procedures.

  • Provide general hands-on assistance to the Laboratory Manager and wider lab team as required.

Office

  • Collect, receive and distribute office deliveries.

  • Scan paperwork and assist with document filing, organisation and storage.

  • Help maintain organised and well-stocked communal areas and office storage spaces.

  • Assist with general office administration, practical errands and day-to-day requests as needed.

Weekly Responsibilities

Lab

  • Assist with routine stock checks and flag low-stock, expired or soon-to-expire items.

  • Help prepare and refill routine laboratory solutions (e.g. 70% ethanol and sheath fluid) in accordance with established procedures and training.

  • Wash, clean and maintain laboratory glassware.

  • Assist with monitoring liquid nitrogen levels and coordinate with building facilities for refilling, following relevant safety procedures.

  • Perform weekly sink flushing.

Office

  • Monitor, order and replenish office sundries, including drinks, snacks, stationery and other regularly used supplies.

  • Check orders and deliveries against invoices, flagging any discrepancies.

Ad-Hoc Responsibilities

Lab

  • Provide practical support during audits, inspections and compliance checks.

  • Assist with equipment deep-cleaning as required and in accordance with training.

  • Assist with arranging access for on-site engineers, contractors, equipment repairs and maintenance visits.

  • Support sustainability initiatives to help maintain our My Green Lab Green certification.

  • Help with reorganising laboratory spaces, moving supplies and preparing areas for operational activities.

  • Suggest simple, practical improvements to laboratory organisation and everyday workflows where appropriate.

Office

  • Support office sustainability and recycling activities, including printer ink recycling, battery recycling and confidential waste collection.

  • Assist with the issuance, tracking and return of IT equipment, ensuring the Asset Management Log is kept up to date.

  • Help prepare office spaces and coordinate arrangements for visitors, contractors or internal activities as required.

The above list of responsibilities is not exhaustive, and the post holder may be required to undertake other reasonable duties consistent with the scope, purpose and level of the role.

Team and Ways of Working

This role sits within the Lab Operations team and reports to the Laboratory Manager, with regular interaction with colleagues across the laboratory and office.

The successful candidate will be expected to:

  • Take direction from the Laboratory Manager and respond to changing operational priorities.

  • Work independently on assigned tasks, ensuring they are completed accurately and on time.

  • Communicate effectively, ask questions when needed and promptly flag any issues or concerns.

Skills, Knowledge and Experience

Qualification Requirements

  • A minimum of two A-levels, including at least one science-related subject (e.g. Biology or Chemistry), or an equivalent science-related vocational qualification (e.g. BTEC Applied Science).

Essential Skills and Attributes

  • Reliable and dependable: Able to complete assigned tasks consistently, accurately and on time.

  • Practical and hands-on: Comfortable undertaking routine manual tasks, including cleaning, organising, restocking and moving supplies.

  • Organised and detail-oriented: Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.

  • Flexible and adaptable: Willing to take on a variety of responsibilities, switch between tasks and respond to changing priorities.

  • Able to work independently: Comfortable following written and verbal instructions, managing a task list and knowing when to ask for guidance.

  • Positive and team-oriented: A helpful, cooperative attitude and willingness to support colleagues wherever needed.

  • Good communication skills: Able to communicate clearly and flag issues or concerns appropriately.

  • Basic computer literacy: Familiarity with email, spreadsheets and document management.

  • Safety-conscious: Awareness of the importance of workplace Health & Safety, with the ability to follow established procedures and willingness to undertake relevant laboratory safety training, including COSHH, PPE and waste handling.

  • Comfortable with physical tasks: Able to undertake the practical aspects of the role, including standing, moving around the laboratory and office, handling deliveries and moving supplies, with appropriate training, equipment and reasonable adjustments where required.

Nice-to-Haves (Desirable Experience)

  • Previous experience working in a laboratory, particularly one processing human material.

  • Experience with stock management, consumables, inventory or laboratory operations.

  • Experience in a practical support role, such as logistics, facilities, warehouse operations or office administration.

  • Familiarity with laboratory Health & Safety procedures, including COSHH and safety data sheets.

  • Experience supporting audits or working in regulated environments.

  • Experience using stock management or asset tracking systems.

Why Join Us?

  • Competitive salary and company bonus scheme.

  • Pension, health insurance, life assurance and income protection.

  • Fast-paced, collaborative startup culture.

  • Opportunity to gain practical experience in a growing laboratory environment.

  • A varied role where your contribution directly supports the day-to-day running of the business.

  • Opportunities to develop operational skills and take on additional responsibilities as the company grows.

title: Outcome Testing and Controls Assurance Officer
descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Role Description

This role is responsible for delivering Outcomes Based Testing (OBT), providing independent, evidence-based assurance that Allica is consistently delivering good customer outcomes in line with the FCA's Consumer Duty. The role also undertakes Secondary Controls Testing in accordance with Allica's Risk Management Framework.

The successful candidate will plan and execute a portfolio of testing activities, communicate findings clearly to stakeholders, and agree, monitor, and support action plans through to resolution. They will work collaboratively with Risk Business Partners and the wider First Line of Defence (1LoD) Controls team.

Beyond completing testing against a defined framework, the role requires a proactive and analytical approach. The role holder will identify root causes, drive meaningful remediation, and provide constructive challenge to stakeholders, helping to improve customer outcomes and strengthen Allica's control environment.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Conduct outcome-based testing across Allica’s customer facing journeys to assess whether customer outcomes are consistent with Consumer Duty obligations. 

  • Review customer cases, communications and operational activity to identify potential customer harm, process weaknesses or customer experience issues, including the treatment of vulnerable customers. 

  • Assess both process execution and customer experience, ensuring documentation is complete, communications are clear and customers do not face unnecessary barriers or delays. 

  • Communicate Outcomes Based Testing results clearly to relevant stakeholders, ensuring findings are understood and owned. 

  • Agree appropriate action plans with stakeholders to remediate instances of poor outcomes and track these through to closure. 

  • Deliver Secondary Controls Testing, assessing the design and operating effectiveness to obtain an overall rating for each control, in line with Allica’s Control Testing Standards. 

  • Communicate control testing output to stakeholders and agree action plans where control weaknesses or failures are identified. 

  • Accurately update RiskSmart with control test results, ratings, findings and associated action plans. 

  • Maintain regular engagement with Risk Business Partners across the wider 1LoD Controls team on control testing outputs, sharing themes and supporting a consistent testing approach. 

  • Escalate significant issues, risks or thematic concerns in a timely manner. 

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of Outcomes Based Testing and controls testing methodology, templates and reporting. 

  • Ensure all testing is conducted objectively and independently, in line with Allica's Risk Management Framework and relevant regulatory requirements, including the FCA Consumer Duty and Conduct Rules. 

  • Support reporting and insight through dashboards and analysis, contributing to root cause identification and continuous improvement initiatives.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Capable of working in a fast-paced environment, managing complex, competing and alternating priorities across control testing and outcomes based testing with a constant focus on delivery. 

  • Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify root causes behind poor customer outcomes or control failures, not just symptoms. 

  • A confident, clear communicator, able to present findings and constructively challenge stakeholders at varying levels of seniority. 

  • Show curiosity and sound judgement when assessing customer journeys and identifying potential customer harm or process weaknesses. 

  • Demonstrate a proactive and solution-focused mindset, with a desire to improve processes and customer experience. 

  • Be able to work independently with minimal supervision, while remaining a collaborative and engaged member of the wider team. 

  • Have experience of controls testing, quality assurance, outcomes-based testing, or 1st/2nd line risk and assurance work, ideally within Financial Services. 

  • Have a working knowledge of the FCA Consumer Duty and Conduct Rules, and how these apply in practice to Allica’s products and supporting customer journeys. 

  • Be explicit in demonstrating where they've gone the extra mile, embraced new challenges, or stood out from their peers in a previous testing, assurance or risk role.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

title: Partner Deployed Engineer - Europe
descriptionHtml:
We are an applied AI lab building end-to-end software agents.

We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer.

Our team is extremely talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro.

Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us.

About the Role

At Cognition, partners are force multipliers. Partner Deployed Engineers (Partner DEs) are partner-facing (and customer-facing) technical experts who enable services partners such as Global Systems Integrators to successfully deploy, scale, and deliver value with Devin and Windsurf across their client base.

In this role, you will work closely with partner solution architects, delivery leads, and engineering teams to help them build repeatable offerings and internal expertise on top of the Cognition platform. Rather than owning a single customer, you’ll amplify impact by enabling partners to support many customers at scale.

This role blends deep technical work, partner enablement, and ecosystem thinking. You’ll lead technical enablement sessions, co-deliver pilots, unblock complex deployments, and help GSIs operationalize Devin/Windsurf into their delivery motions. You’ll act as Cognition’s technical representative within partner organizations.

In This Role, You Will

  • Own the technical success of GSI partners across onboarding, enablement, and scaled delivery of Devin/Windsurf

  • Work directly with partner engineering and architecture teams to understand their delivery models, tooling, and customer use cases

  • Enable partners to build repeatable solutions, accelerators, and reference architectures using Devin/Windsurf

  • Lead technical trainings, workshops, and deep dives for partner teams (hands-on, not slideware)

  • Support partner-led customer pilots and early production deployments, stepping in where complexity is highest

  • Act as a technical escalation point for complex integrations, security reviews, CI/CD environments, and enterprise workflows

  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with partner technical leaders in GSIs (e.g., delivery heads, principal engineers, solution architects)

  • Capture field learnings and partner feedback to influence product roadmap, packaging, and partner readiness

  • Proactively identify gaps in partner capability and work with internal teams to close them

What We Value

  • Partner expertise. You understand how GSIs operate, deliver projects, and measure success

  • Ownership mindset. You take responsibility for partner outcomes, not just enablement activities

  • Technical depth. You can reason about real systems, not just demos

  • Leverage thinking. You prefer enabling 10 teams over doing the work for 1

  • Bias toward execution. You move quickly from concept to working deployment

  • Comfort with ambiguity. Partner environments are messy; you thrive in that reality

Requirements

  • Degree in STEM field and a strong engineering foundation from a rigorous technical environment

  • Demonstrated track record of exceptional performance in academic, professional, or entrepreneurial pursuits

  • Experience working with or alongside large engineering teams (enterprise or services environments preferred)

  • Strong communication skills; you can engage credibly and build relationships with senior partner leaders, architects, and executives

  • High tolerance for ambiguity, intensity, and sustained effort when required

  • Willingness to travel 25–50%, including frequent travel to India and partner/customer sites

You Might Excel If You…

  • Are advanced in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, TypeScript)

  • Have experience writing, debugging, and deploying real production systems

  • Have worked with SI / GSI delivery models, enterprise software deployments, or large-scale developer platforms

  • Enjoy enabling others to be successful, not just building things yourself

  • Learn quickly by embedding in complex, real-world environments

  • Have operated beyond your formal job description in high-growth or early-stage settings or have previously founded a startup

  • Thrive in roles that require you to context switch quickly and handle a broad range of technical and non-technical problems

Our Commitment

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout the hiring process - please let us know if you need any. Cognition also considers applicants with criminal histories consistent with the SF Fair Chance Ordinance and similar local laws.

title: People & Culture Specialist (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:

Notre prochain objectif ? Devenir le produit juridique le plus utilisé en Europe.

Pourquoi Lexroom ?

  • Définir les standards : rejoignez l’équipe qui fixe la référence de l’IA juridique en Europe.

  • Travailler avec les meilleurs : collaborez avec des collègues d’exception, dans une culture qui valorise la compétence, la curiosité et l’ambition.

  • Avoir un impact concret : votre travail influencera directement la manière dont les professionnels du droit exercent leur métier, plus rapidement, plus clairement et plus efficacement.

Chez Lexroom, nous laissons les buzzwords de côté. Ici, vous construirez quelque chose de durable : une plateforme de confiance, une solide réputation et un nouveau standard pour le monde juridique.

Le poste
En tant que People Operations Specialist pour la France, vous serez l’interlocuteur de référence de nos équipes parisiennes. Vous prendrez en charge l’ensemble des aspects opérationnels de l’expérience collaborateur, du premier contrat à la paie mensuelle, en veillant à ce que tout fonctionne de manière fiable, conforme et fluide au fil de notre croissance. Lexroom connaît une expansion rapide à travers l’Europe, et la France est l’un de nos marchés stratégiques. Vous rejoindrez l’équipe People à un moment clé, pour construire les fondations sur lesquelles notre équipe française pourra se développer.

Vos responsabilités

  • Être le référent People en France : devenir l’interlocuteur RH de confiance de nos équipes parisiennes, répondre aux demandes avec réactivité et clarté, tout en sachant dire non lorsque c’est nécessaire.

  • Gérer l’ensemble du cycle de vie des collaborateurs : des contrats à l’onboarding en passant par les avantages sociaux, garantir que chaque étape soit fiable, conforme et fluide.

  • Assurer le bon fonctionnement des opérations : prendre en charge les éléments variables de paie et les données RH, en collaboration avec nos prestataires externes, pour une fiabilité irréprochable, mois après mois.

  • Construire un cadre de conformité évolutif : travailler avec nos conseillers juridiques pour mettre en place les standards adaptés à la France, au rythme de la croissance de nos effectifs.

  • Automatiser ce qui nous ralentit : utiliser l’IA, HiBob et les données pour réduire les tâches manuelles et construire les tableaux de bord qui aident l’équipe People à décider plus vite.

Profil recherché

  • 1 à 3 ans d’expérience en People Operations, HR Operations ou en tant que généraliste RH, avec une pratique concrète des contrats, de l’onboarding et de la paie. Votre potentiel et votre motivation comptent davantage que le nombre d’années d’expérience.

  • De solides bases en droit du travail français : vous maîtrisez les fondamentaux de la législation sociale et avez déjà géré directement des contrats, des intégrations et des départs, idéalement avec une paie externalisée.

  • À l’aise avec les données et l’IA : les SIRH n’ont pas de secret pour vous, et vous repérez instinctivement les tâches répétitives qui pourraient être automatisées.

  • Organisé(e) et rigoureux(se) : vous savez gérer des échéances récurrentes, comme la paie mensuelle, sans rien laisser passer.

  • Proactif(ve) et résilient(e) : vous anticipez les besoins et agissez avant qu’un collaborateur n’ait à se plaindre.

  • Excellentes compétences en communication, à l’oral comme à l’écrit : français (langue maternelle) et anglais courant (C1 minimum). L’italien est un plus, sans être obligatoire.

  • Atouts supplémentaires : une connaissance de HiBob ou d’outils RH et de paie similaires, ainsi qu’un intérêt pour le secteur juridique (aucune formation juridique requise).

Perspectives d’évolution
Ce poste repose sur la profondeur et la responsabilisation, pas sur une échelle hiérarchique. À mesure que notre équipe française grandit et que de nouveaux marchés s’ouvrent, votre périmètre évoluera avec elle. Vous contribuerez à définir la manière dont les People Operations fonctionnent sur un nouveau marché et travaillerez aux côtés d’un nouveau Head of People Operations. Vous développerez aussi une expertise très recherchée en paie, conformité et automatisation.

Ce qui nous distingue
Une équipe d’exception
Chez Lexroom, vous travaillerez aux côtés des meilleurs talents de la tech et de l’IA juridique. Nos équipes agissent avec sens et autonomie, pour que chaque contribution produise des résultats visibles. Vous collaborerez avec des personnes qui allient innovation et rigueur, curiosité et discipline, ambition et profondeur.

Une croissance qui compte
Nous recrutons des personnes exceptionnelles pour faire la différence, et nous leur donnons l’espace pour mener. Votre travail façonnera l’avenir de la legal tech et fixera de nouveaux standards pour le secteur. L’impact se mesure à la vision et à l’exécution, pas à l’âge ni au titre. Si vous êtes prêt(e) à prendre des responsabilités, vous trouverez de vraies opportunités de grandir et de piloter des projets à fort enjeu.

Valoriser votre contribution
Nous valorisons l’excellence et partageons le succès :

  • Rémunération : 30 000 – 45 000 € brut annuel

Des avantages qui comptent

Processus de recrutement

Chez Lexroom, l’ambition rencontre la discipline et le sens. Nous ne construisons pas seulement un produit : nous définissons un nouveau standard pour le monde juridique. Si vous êtes prêt(e) à contribuer à quelque chose de durable et porteur de sens, nous serions ravis d’échanger avec vous.

title: People Partner
descriptionHtml:
About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.

The role

You’ll act as a trusted advisor to managers and employees, providing practical guidance and support across employee relations, performance management, manager coaching and the wider employee lifecycle. Combining hands-on HR expertise with a solutions-focused approach, you’ll help managers navigate complex people matters confidently, ensure consistent and compliant People practices across our global teams, and drive continuous improvement through data, technology and automation as Radiant continues to scale.

What You'll Do

  • Act as the day-to-day point of contact for employees and managers on HR questions across the full employee lifecycle: onboarding, policy interpretation, benefits, and performance management.

  • Managing employee relations, providing expert support and recommending appropriate actions to address queries or problems. Proactively reviewing data to spot employee relations trends and suggest solutions, coaching Managers to tackle issues early on.

  • Serve as the local first line of defense for compliance, ensuring strict adherence to UK labor laws, employment standards, site-specific contracts, and safety protocols.

  • Help coordinate and run core HR cycles: performance reviews, compensation planning, and engagement surveys, for the London office.

  • Draft, review and interpret employment contracts, variations and restrictive covenants.

  • Own the review and update of people policies and the employee handbook, keeping them compliant and easy to use.

  • Track legislative changes, including the Employment Rights Act reforms, and lead their implementation.

  • Maintain accurate employee records and HR systems, and help build out People processes and documentation as the team grows.

 

Compliance

 

  • Help ensure compliance with employment law and best practice across the UK, Europe and the US, in consultation with the HRBP and external counsel as needed.

  • Compliance and risk. Make sure People processes meet UK employment law, data protection requirements, our ISO requirements and Radiant's own policies. Ensure the team keeps policies and manager guidance up to date as legislation changes.

Immigration and visas

  • Manage Skilled Worker and other visa applications from assessment to approval, partnering with our external immigration lawyers.

  • Advise on global mobility as we expand into Europe.

Workforce planning

  • Partner with leaders to build headcount plans aligned to business priorities and budget.

  • Advise on organisation design, team structures and spans of control as teams scale.

  • Use people data from HiBob and Ashby to inform hiring, retention and capacity decisions.

Performance

  • Help design and run the performance reviews and calibration process.

  • Support managers to set clear goals, give regular feedback and manage underperformance through fair, well-documented processes.

  • Link performance outcomes to development, promotion and reward decisions.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years in a People Partner, HR Business Partner or senior generalist role, ideally in a scaling tech or high-growth business.

  • Deep, current knowledge of UK employment law and confidence applying it to real situations.

  • CIPD Level 5 or 7, or an employment law qualification.

  • Confident and knowledgeable enough to manage employee relations issues independently, with sound judgement on when to escalate.

  • A proactive, solutions-oriented approach and a track record of taking initiative.

  • Exposure to multi-jurisdiction employment matters is an advantage.

  • Strong technical capability and data literacy, and comfort using data and technology to inform decisions and drive efficiency

title: PhD Researcher – Video Understanding & VLMs
descriptionHtml:
About Almetra

We build vision-language models that understand what happens on real factory floors. Cameras on 20+ production lines stream video into our models, which turn every step (assembling, screwing, inspecting) into structured data several times per second. Customers use it to see where time gets lost and how to improve their processes.

Your role

You’ll do your PhD with us from day one, working closely with Sascha, our Head of ML (VLM), on research problems that come straight from our product. Your research runs on real industrial video at a scale few academic labs have. The PhD is co-supervised by a university professor, and you’ll be enrolled at a partner university.

What you’ll work on

  • Video understanding with VLMs: action recognition, temporal grounding and long-video reasoning on factory footage

  • Making models robust in the real world: occlusions, unusual viewpoints, new stations and products with little labelled data

  • Turning research results into improvements in our production models

  • Publishing at top venues (CVPR, ICCV/ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR) together with our ML team

What you bring

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI or a closely related field, with a focus on computer vision or multimodal learning (finished or finishing by early-2027)

  • Solid deep learning foundations and hands-on PyTorch

  • Experience with computer vision, video or multimodal models (thesis, projects or internships)

  • Curiosity about real-world problems, not only benchmarks

  • Fluent English

Nice to have

  • First publications or a strong thesis in vision-language, video understanding or multimodal learning

  • Experience with open VLMs (e.g. Qwen-VL, InternVL, LLaVA) or video models (e.g. VideoMAE, ViViT)

  • Training on GPU clusters (DDP / FSDP)

Why a PhD with us

  • A full-time, paid PhD position in Berlin

  • Mentoring from our Head of ML plus academic co-supervision

  • Unique real-world video data and the compute to use it

  • Your research reaches a real product, not just a paper

What we offer

Employee Share Options Program for all permanent employees*

An increasing benefits list: currently includes Urban Sports club and quarterly team retreats.

Be on the forefront in defining what artificial intelligence means in manufacturing

Gain hands-on experience in working in an AI-first software company

Supportive and inclusive culture that values diversity and promotes the advancement of underrepresented groups within the company

Collaborate with a diverse (currently more than 10 nationalities) and talented team, working on cutting-edge projects with real-world impact

Network with professionals and leaders in the field, opening doors to potential future career opportunities

We have a very flat hierarchy, open 360° feedback, and flexible working hours

Ethics⚖: We are committed to developing ethical AI software

Don't meet all the requirements?

Almetra is committed to creating a workplace that is diverse, fair, and inclusive. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds, even if they do not meet every qualification, to submit their application. We firmly believe that having a team with diverse perspectives only strengthens our company and drives innovation. title: Platform Associate (m/f/d): Talent, Growth, Content & AI Workflows
descriptionHtml:
Remote, with offices in Munich and Karlsruhe · Start January or February 2027

About us

First Momentum invests in deep tech and industrial tech founders across Europe at pre-seed when there's more lab than traction. We've made 40+ investments into industries like energy, space, industrial, and semicon, and our companies went on to raise from Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, or Insight Partners.

We're a team of engineers, scientists, and operators on a mission to build a different kind of VC fund. Our goal isn't the biggest fund or the loudest headlines, but to be the VC deeply technical teams need and deserve at inception. Someone who truly understands their tech, is humble and candid, and connects them with the relevant people they need at a given stage, be it a designer or a pilot customer. You won't find us at the after-party; instead, we're obsessing over good reads, fast bikes, and the latest moonshots we want to bring to life.

Your tasks

For us, platform is like a product with multiple customer groups: founders, LPs, Scouts, and the investment team. While we get inspired by playbooks and what other funds are doing, we treat them as what they are: past successes. For us, platform is much more similar to what our portfolio teams are doing: building products and driving growth, whether for our fund or our portcos. We come up with new ideas, identify the most impactful ones, test them, measure, iterate, or drop them and rerun the entire sprint. Your north star: helping our portfolio founders succeed through intros, hires, and any other random request. We measure ourselves on support per euro invested. Much of that support runs through the Platform team.

Call it Founder's Associate, Chief of Staff, Venture Ops, GTM, or Growth. Here, it means you take on some of the most pressing problems of our portfolio companies and the fund operations. You'll work with several super-technical, highly humble founders and the investment team at once.

  • Hiring for the portfolio: The first 10 people shape a startup more than anything else. You run multiple outbound campaigns in parallel, from sourcing and outreach to the final intro, and learn each field well enough to find the best talent. Sometimes that means building teams from zero for our incubation projects; previous ones: Telura (deep geothermal) and Starforge (fusion energy).

  • Content and website: You turn the technical and industry expertise from First Momentum's investment team and portfolio news (funding rounds, launches, technical results) into content for LinkedIn, our blog, and our newsletter. You also own our Webflow site and how AI search finds us.

  • European deep tech community: You grow our community of 100+ technical Venture Scouts and bring them into hiring and deals. You support in-person events like our annual meeting and help co-organize the European Spinoff Summit in Munich.

  • Tooling and workflows: If you've done something by hand twice, you build a Claude skill or automation for it the third time.

Your profile

  • 1–2 years of hands-on work at a startup, VC, recruiting firm, or similar

  • Sourcing or outbound experience, whether in recruiting or in sales/GTM

  • You write very well in English (full working proficiency); German is a plus

  • You can run 10+ workstreams at once without daily steering and know where the 80/20 is

  • You're fast, friendly, and specific with founders, partners, and candidates

  • You like building generally, also with AI tools, BUT know when not to use them and when your own judgment beats the model's

  • You're curious about many fields and fine switching from a Head of Biology search to a blog post to a website fix in one afternoon

  • A good eye for design

What we offer


Work with people building fusion reactors and foundation models

You work with the teams behind 40+ deep tech companies and with our partners from day one.


See Technology 5–10 years earlier

You see what comes straight out of research labs long before most people meet it in a product.


Your next job is already in the portfolio

You'll get to know dozens of startups from the inside. If at some time you feel like moving on, you’ll have a great network to rely on, but we will also actively help. If you want, you can stay part of First Momentum after your time with us through our Venture Scout program. Some Scouts have since joined Y Combinator, built $20M-funded robotics spinouts, or moved to Anthropic's design team. More here: https://www.firstmomentum.vc/venture-scouts


Room to build

New tools, workflows, and formats. If it works, it stays. You'll have few meetings, coordinate mostly async, and plan your own week.


Five fields in one job

Recruiting, content, design, web, and AI tooling. Most people with 1–2 years of experience get to work in one of them.


Remote Culture

Our team is spread across Germany, Austria, the UK, and Spain. We don't hire local optimum but hire the best people wherever they are in Europe. To work together and have some fun, we meet every two months for our team days.

Before you apply

Start: January/February 2027 · Full-time · Remote, offices in Munich and Karlsruhe · English required, German is a plus

Along with your CV, add 2–3 sentences on something you built, wrote, or sourced. If you don't tick every box, tell us in your application why you'd still fit. Career switchers and people from outside VC are explicitly welcome.

Please apply only if you can start in January/February 2027.

title: PMO Operations Specialist (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

As a PMO Operations Specialist, you'll play a central role in building and running the operational foundation of our growing Project Management Office (PMO). Working closely with the PMO Lead, you'll turn newly developed processes into practical, well-documented ways of working that are consistently adopted across dozens of active initiatives.

You'll own the day-to-day operating rhythm of the PMO, from weekly project reporting and portfolio data quality to project lead onboarding, training, and process improvement. You'll work across teams, including scientists, engineers, and project leads, helping make project management processes simple, effective, and accessible to everyone.

This is an opportunity to join the PMO during its early development and make a meaningful impact on how Focused Energy plans, tracks, and delivers its most important initiatives. You'll bring structure to complexity, ensure important details don't fall through the cracks, and help build a scalable foundation for the company's continued growth.

What You'll Do

  • Own the PMO Operating Rhythm: Coordinate and manage the weekly project reporting cycle across dozens of active initiatives, ensuring timely updates, accurate information, and consistent visibility into project progress.

  • Drive Portfolio Data Quality: Monitor project information, identify missing or inconsistent data, follow up with project leads, and ensure leadership and teams can rely on accurate portfolio reporting.

  • Make PMO Processes Work in Practice: Translate newly designed PMO processes into simple, documented, and usable workflows that can be adopted consistently by project leads and non-PM colleagues.

  • Lead Project Onboarding and Training: Coordinate onboarding for new project leads and deliver training on PMO processes, tools, reporting expectations, and ways of working to build confidence and self-sufficiency.

  • Improve Processes and Efficiency: Identify recurring manual tasks, process gaps, and opportunities for improvement, helping streamline workflows and flag opportunities for automation.

  • Drive Improvement Initiatives: Partner with the PMO Lead on selected PMO improvement projects, taking ownership of execution, coordination, documentation, and follow-through.

  • Support Cross-Functional Collaboration: Prepare and support workshops, meetings, and working sessions, ensuring the right information is available, discussions stay organized, and agreed actions are followed through.

  • Maintain Clear Documentation: Ensure PMO processes, project information, and supporting documentation are complete, accessible, and consistently maintained.

  • Keep Things Moving: Proactively identify overdue actions, unclear responsibilities, and emerging gaps, escalating risks to the PMO Lead before they impact project delivery.

Who You Are

  • You have a degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • You bring experience in project management, PMO operations, project coordination, or business operations, ideally within a technical, engineering, R&D, or fast-growing organization.

  • You understand project management fundamentals and the importance of consistent reporting, reliable documentation, clear ownership, and effective coordination across multiple initiatives.

  • You are highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage competing priorities, recurring deadlines, and large volumes of project information without losing sight of the bigger picture.

  • You are comfortable translating processes and concepts into practical workflows, documentation, and guidance that people outside of project management can easily understand and adopt.

  • You take an ownership-driven approach to your work, naturally identifying what's missing, unclear, or unfinished and proactively driving it toward resolution.

  • You are a clear and confident communicator in both German and English, able to follow up persistently and constructively with stakeholders across different functions and levels of technical expertise.

  • You enjoy working with diverse teams, including scientists, engineers, and business professionals, and can adapt your communication style to different audiences.

  • You demonstrate good judgment and understand when to make decisions independently versus when to escalate process or scope changes to leadership.

  • You have a continuous improvement mindset and are interested in simplifying processes, reducing manual work, and leveraging automation and AI tools to improve efficiency.

  • You thrive in an evolving environment where processes are still being established and enjoy bringing structure, consistency, and momentum to a growing organization.

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

  • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

  • Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

title: Portfolio Risk and Treasury Manager
descriptionHtml:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

We're rebuilding how energy is bought and sold. That means cutting out middlemen, connecting businesses directly with renewable generators, and ensuring every transaction is traceable and transparent.

We're a 160+ person team - operators, data scientists, engineers, customer champions and energy experts - backed by top-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Hitachi Ventures, Allianz, AlbionVC and Atomico. We closed a $75M Series B round in early 2026, taking our total funding to $94M, and we now power energy for over 4,000 UK businesses across 8,500+ sites, with over £75m in value returned to businesses and generators so far.

We're a technology company solving the energy industry, not an energy company. Some people call us a neo-utility, the neo-bank idea, applied to energy.

The industry is noticing. We were crowned Europe's Most Exciting Tech Company at the GP Bullhound Allstars awards, came in at #6 on LinkedIn's Top Startups 2026 in the UK, #7 on the Scaling Europe 50 of Europe's fastest-growing companies, and #14 on Sifted's AI 100.

Learn more about us on our website.

🎙️ The Role

We're hiring a Portfolio Risk and Treasury Manager.

This role reports directly to the CFO and sits in our Finance team. You will be tem's first dedicated hire in risk oversight and treasury, independent of the teams whose positions and processes you oversee and challenge. It's a solo, individual-contributor role for now: no team to manage, but real ownership of a complex, cross-functional, load-bearing area that touches our pricing and trading engine, FP&A, cash management and our commercial and people teams, and that increasingly matters to how investors, the board and funding partners see tem's risk maturity.

tem doesn't yet have anyone who owns liquidity as a discipline, or a second line of defence on risk. Growth in our business is capital-intensive: every collateral demand, margin call, commission payment and new market adds to the cash we need to carry, and the cost of that cash is rarely visible in the decisions that create it. You will build that capability from scratch, bringing treasury and independent risk oversight together, so that tem's risk and liquidity management stands on its own rather than marking its own homework.

In your first 12 months, you might:

  • Stand up tem's second line risk function: independent oversight and challenge of our first line risk processes, with risk appetite and limits that are set, monitored and acted on.

  • Build the liquidity models tem runs on, short and long term: working capital, collateral, margin calls, cash runway, and the credit facilities and letters of credit behind them.

  • Put cost of capital into our commercial pricing decisions, so the liquidity a deal consumes is visible at the moment the deal is made.

  • Work with the CFO to secure liquidity provision that scales ahead of the business and new markets.

  • Replace manual portfolio reconciliation with automation, and build our operational risk framework from the ground up.

🚀 Responsibilities

  • Second line oversight: establish and run independent oversight and challenge of tem's first line risk processes across trading and portfolio activity, input into risk appetite and the setting of notional and VaR limits, and monitor ongoing adherence.

  • Liquidity modelling: build and maintain short-term (cash runway, margin call forecasting) and long-term (growth and new market funding) liquidity models, covering generator collateral, hedging counterparty collateral, variation margin, credit facilities and letters of credit.

  • Working capital: own working capital efficiency as a measured, targeted discipline rather than a byproduct of other teams' decisions, working closely with Finance's cash management team.

  • Cost of capital and pricing: develop tem's cost of capital framework, make it usable in pricing, give our pricing and commercial teams the cost of capital impact of their decisions, and challenge decisions that consume liquidity without adequate return.

  • Liquidity risk: model liquidity risk from volume and price variance on energy volumes, run stress scenarios and report liquidity headroom against them.

  • Liquidity supply and funding: work with the CFO to engage lenders, credit facility providers and collateral and letter of credit providers, keep liquidity provision ahead of the business with early visibility of when new capacity is needed, and prepare liquidity and risk materials for funding partners, investors and the board.

  • Operational risk: build tem's operational risk framework from the ground up, including incident reporting and management, and drive automation of portfolio data reconciliation, from hedge contracts and confirmations through to hedge settlement and cash reconciliation with Finance.

  • Reporting and stakeholders: build automated, async-first risk reporting (dashboards and written updates by default, a live sync only when something needs real-time discussion), represent tem with hedging and generator counterparties and funding partners, and communicate risk and liquidity positions clearly to leadership.

🎯 Requirements

Must-Haves

  • Risk management or treasury experience from a fintech, quant trading or other digital-native environment: modern, tech-first risk practices rather than legacy, spreadsheet-driven ones.

  • Knowledge of energy markets, energy trading or energy risk management and portfolio balancing.

  • Liquidity modelling experience: working capital, collateral and margin dynamics, and cash forecasting over short and long horizons.

  • Risk modelling experience, including VaR and stress testing, and an understanding of cost of capital and how to translate it into commercial decisions.

  • Data literate: comfortable working with and drawing conclusions from portfolio and risk data.

  • Genuinely curious and intellectually sharp (this is a thinking role, not a process-running one), and confident communicating with senior stakeholders, external counterparties and funding partners.

Desirable

  • Experience raising or managing credit facilities, letters of credit or other trade finance.

  • Experience of US electricity markets.

  • Operational risk experience, or familiarity with the Ofgem regulatory environment.

  • Comfortable using AI tools as part of day-to-day work. No coding or SQL required.

✨ Benefits & Perks

  • Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off.

  • Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

  • Up to GBP1,200 or EUR1,400 per year for your remote setup.

  • Up to GBP150 or EUR170 per month for wellbeing.

🗣️ Interview Process

  • First call with our Talent Team.

  • Behaviour Interview with the Hiring Manager.

  • Technical Interview with the Team (90 mins). You'll meet with potential peers in this session and will discuss how you would model and stress tem's liquidity, where you would set and monitor risk limits, and how you would make cost of capital usable in pricing decisions, including a practical exercise.

  • Bar Raiser Interview with Stakeholders.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

title: Praktikum Kreation (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Vielfalter ist der sexy Nerd im schummrigen Partykeller, der China-Böller im Hundehaufen, der Warp-Antrieb der Enterprise, der erste Kuss deiner Jugendliebe, der Defibrillator im Seniorenheim, der Choleriker in der Sonntagsmesse und die letzte Rose des Bachelors. Ansonsten baut Vielfalter digitale Produkte und besondere Marken. Ab und zu etwas drüber, manchmal außergewöhnlich, immer besonders – und über allem mit mit dem Glauben an digitale Transformation und Liebe zum Handwerk. Viel good.

Aufgaben

Soviel vorab: Als junge Start-Up-Agentur suchen wir geradlinige Anschieber und Macher, die mit einem hohen Eigenanspruch und universellen Blick Projekte kreativ nach vorne bringen. Dabei legen wir viel Wert auf Liebe zum Detail und Trendaffinität. Wir bieten dir vielfältige kreative Aufgaben in einem wachsenden Unternehmen, eine lockere Arbeitsatmosphäre und flache Hierarchien.

Du sprühst vor Ideen und willst sie bis zum WOW-Erlebnis umsetzen? Von Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma und HTML hast du schon einmal gehört bzw. und hast eventuell schon erste Erfahrungen gesammelt? Dann bist du vielleicht genau der- oder diejenige, den/die wir suchen!

Qualifikation

Das erwarten wir von dir:

  • Du bist Schüler oder Student und hast schon die ersten Erfahrung im Umgang mit Medien gesammelt.
  • Du suchst nach praktischer Erfahrung und willst in realen Projekten für Kunden aus dem Mittelstand neue Skills erlernen.
  • Du hast ein Auge für Design, Ästhetik, Form- und Farbgebung.
  • Du bist kommunikativ, trendaffin und und fühlst dich in den sozialen Medien zu Hause.
  • Du bist ein positiver und humorvoller Mensch.
  • Du denkst auch mal „out of the box“ und bist mutig genug, deine eigene Meinung mit viel Fingerspitzengefühl und diplomatischem Geschick zu vertreten.
  • Du bist immer am Puls der Zeit: offen für Neues, innovativ und vor allem lernbereit.

Benefits

  • Null Überstunden (ohne Scheiß)
  • Zwei Betriebsausflüge im Jahr (Yeah!)
  • 10.00 bis 15.30 Uhr Kernarbeitszeit, der Rest ist Gleitzeit.
  • Zwei Tage Homeoffice pro Woche möglich
  • Come as you are! Keine Dresscodes.
  • Latest Shit. Bei uns arbeitest du mit top-aktueller Software.
  • Zukunft: Mit Engagement und guten Ideen bringst du die Agentur tagtäglich nach vorne? Dann steht deiner Karriere hier nichts im Weg.

Wenn du dich bei uns bewerben möchtest, solltest du vorab folgendes wissen:

Unser Deal lautet: Erfahrung gegen Einsatz. Wir vergüten generell keine Praktika.

Bring etwas Zeit mit: Die Mindestdauer für ein Praktikum beträgt acht Wochen.

Bleib hartnäckig: Je nach Auslastung können wir nicht immer so schnell antworten, wie wir gerne würden. Dennoch hat es jeder, der es wirklich wollte, auch zu uns in die Agentur geschafft.

Wir sind gespannt, wie du uns überzeugst :)

title: Praktikum Social Media Cutter (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Little Dot Studios Deutschland ist ein mehrfach ausgezeichnetes Multi-Plattform-Produktionsunternehmen, Social-Media-Agentur und digitales Mediennetzwerk. Als Social Media Agentur bieten wir ein umfassendes Leistungsportfolio und zählen zu den weltweit führenden YouTube-Spezialisten für zahlreiche Premium-Marken aus den Bereichen Entertainment, Sport und Industrie.

Little Dot Studios wurde 2013 in England gegründet und ist seit 2018 vom Standort München aus im deutschsprachigen Markt aktiv, als Teil eines globalen Teams von über 500 Digital-Expert*innen in UK, US, Deutschland und APAC. Wir betreuen und produzieren Content für mehr als 1000 digitale Kanäle weltweit und erreichen über 11 Milliarden organische Views jeden Monat.

Wir bedienen die verschiedensten Bereiche des Produktionsgeschäfts: von hochwertigen Film- und TV-Formaten über preisgekrönten Podcasts bis hin zu kurzen, viralen Social-Media-Inhalten, TV- & Social Werbespots und Livestreams, die den Puls der Zeit treffen. Die Formate sind darauf ausgelegt, Communitys aufzubauen, Fans zu begeistern und messbare Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Erfolgreiche Kooperationen umfassen unter anderem Projekte mit der ARD, YouTube Health, MAN Trucks & Bus, DAIKIN sowie mit erfolgreichen Content-Creators wie zum Beispiel Matthias Malmedie.

Außerdem ist Little Dot Studios Deutschland ein wichtiger Bestandteil des globalen Mediennetzwerks von Little Dot Studios, das mehr als 135 eigene Social-Media-Kanäle und sechs FAST-Channels betreibt sowie über 21.000 Stunden long-form Content lizenziert und damit weltweit 125 Millionen Unique Viewers und über 50 Millionen Abonnenten erreicht.

Wir suchen Dich für ein bezahltes Pflichtpraktikum (4–6 Monate) ab Anfang 2027! Dein Arbeitsmodell richtet sich nach deinem Wohnort: In und um München arbeitest du hybrid, von jedem anderen Ort in Deutschland vollständig remote.

Du interessierst Dich für TV, Online Video und Social Media und hast bereits erste Erfahrungen in der Content Creation von Social Media bzw. TV-Videoinhalten gesammelt? Dann bist Du bei uns richtig!

Aufgaben

  • Schneiden und Konzipieren von Content für TV- und verschiedene Social-Media-Kanäle
  • Erstellung von Social Media (YouTube, Facebook, Instagram) Grafiken (u.a. Thumbnails, Banner)
  • Mitarbeit an der Erstellung von Branded-Entertainment-Videokonzepten und cross-channel Marketing-Kampagnen
  • Verfassen von Titeln und Beschreibungstexten für Social Media Content, insbesondere YouTube

Qualifikation

  • Du bist an einer Hochschule eingeschrieben und möchtest im Rahmen deines Pflichtpraktikums in die Social-Media-Welt eintauchen.
  • Du hast Grundkenntnisse in DaVinci Resolve und einer Bildbearbeitungssoftware (Photoshop, Affinity etc.)
  • Idealerweise hast Du bereits an Online-/Social-Media-Projekten mitgearbeitet und so erste Erfahrungen gesammelt.
  • Auf den aktuellen verschiedenen Social-Media-Plattformen fühlst Du Dich zu Hause (YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat).
  • Vielleicht hast Du schon erste Kenntnisse über Marketing- und Vertriebsmechanismen gesammelt.
  • Du beherrschst die deutsche Sprache fließend in Wort und Schrift und hast sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.
  • Ausgeprägte Kreativität und Mut zu neuen Ideen & Ansätzen zeichnen Dich aus.
  • Du überzeugst mit Deinem sympathischen Auftreten, Teamgeist und Deiner Zuverlässigkeit.
  • Dein offenes Mindset, Deine positive Grundeinstellung und Dein Sinn für Humor bereichern unsere Zusammenarbeit im Team.

Benefits

Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft: Wir bieten dir die Möglichkeit, aktiv an unserem Wachstum mitzuwirken, neue Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln und selbst zu wachsen, während du spannende und vielfältige Aufgaben übernimmst.

Für deine Fitness und Gesundheit: Mit dem Wellpass unterstützen wir dich dabei, körperlich und mental in Bestform zu bleiben.

Arbeite in einem inspirierenden Umfeld: Unser Team vereint entspannte Atmosphäre mit ehrgeizigen Zielen – hier gehen Spaß an der Arbeit und Erfolg Hand in Hand.

Bringe frische Perspektiven ein: Als wertvolles Mitglied unseres Teams hilfst du uns, die Trends deiner Generation zu verstehen und unser Unternehmen weiterzuentwickeln.

Profitiere von flexiblen Arbeitsbedingungen: Wir legen großen Wert auf Flexibilität – du kannst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten profitieren.

Lerne von Experten: Unsere Expertise basiert auf Insights und Analysen von mehr als 2,7 Milliarden Views – bei uns erfährst du, wie die Mechanismen und Algorithmen von Social-Media-Plattformen wirklich funktionieren.

Erkunde vielfältige Inhalte: Mit einer breiten Palette an Themen, von Sport über True Crime bis hin zu Nachhaltigkeit, bieten wir Inhalte, die für jede/n interessant sind.

Erlebe echten Teamgeist: Teamarbeit steht bei uns im Mittelpunkt – wir kommen regelmäßig zusammen, nicht nur in Meetings, sondern auch bei Team-Events, um den Zusammenhalt zu stärken.

Wir freuen uns schon jetzt, dich kennen zu lernen, wenn du auf der Suche nach einem Pflichtpraktikum bist! Bitte schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein kurzes Anschreiben aus dem hervor geht, warum dich das Praktikum interessiert. Deine Bewerbung geht bei Anna ein, die gern auch schon im Vorfeld deine Fragen beantwortet.

title: Principal BMS & PMS Controls Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

The role

As Principal BMS & PMS Controls Engineer, you will be Volta's technical authority for building and power management controls. You will set the controls architecture, standards and acceptance regime that every DSX site is built to, across Europe and North America.

This is a principal-level individual contributor role. Reporting to the Senior Director, Global E2E DSX Execution, you will decide how controls are specified, integrated and proven, and your standards will be used by design, delivery, commissioning and operations teams across the whole portfolio.

What you will do

Controls architecture and standards

  • Set Volta's global controls architecture for BMS and PMS, including system boundaries, network design, redundancy and integration with facility monitoring and compute.

  • Own the controls standards library: sequences of operation, points schedules, alarm philosophy, naming conventions and FAT/SAT requirements.

  • Define controls requirements for high-density AI workloads, including liquid cooling, CDU integration and power-to-compute interfaces.

Technical authority

  • Make the final technical call on controls design deviations, vendor proposals and integration disputes across all sites.

  • Shape vendor and framework strategy with Procurement, setting the technical bar suppliers are selected against.

  • Set controls security requirements with Systems Security, covering segmentation, access and secure remote support.

Capability and improvement

  • Use operating data and incidents to evolve the standards and the reference design.

  • Coach and raise the capability of controls engineers and specialists across Volta and its partners.

What we are looking for

  • Recognised senior authority in BMS/PMS or mission-critical controls, typically 12+ years, with data centre experience essential.

  • A track record setting controls architecture and standards across a portfolio of sites, not a single project.

  • Deep knowledge of electrical and mechanical control sequences, supervisory platforms, and protocols such as BACnet and Modbus.

  • Experience making and defending high-consequence technical decisions with vendors, designers and executives.

  • Experience defining FAT/SAT and integrated systems test regimes for controls.

  • Ability to influence across functions and regions without direct authority.

Nice to have

  • Controls for high-density AI facilities and direct liquid cooling.

  • OT security and controls network architecture, for example IEC 62443.

  • Standardising controls across an international portfolio.

What We Offer

At Volta, we believe people do their best work when they feel supported, trusted and able to grow. We're building a company where you can make an impact, keep a healthy balance between work and life, and build a career you're proud of.
As a global team, we do our best to provide great benefits wherever you're based. While some benefits vary by country due to local regulations, we believe looking after our people is simply the right thing to do.

  • Competitive salary based on the work you do here, not your previous salary

  • Equity in Volta, giving you the opportunity to share in the company's long-term success

  • Retirement/pension contributions

  • Comprehensive health, wellbeing and insurance benefits

  • Generous number of vacation days each year

Additional Information

Background Checks

All offers of employment at Volta are conditional on the satisfactory completion of pre-employment screening, which includes confirmation of your right to work, verification of your employment history and a criminal record check, where this is permitted by local law. Screening is carried out by Zinc, an accredited third-party provider, after an offer is made and all information is handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection law.

Equal Opportunity

Volta is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and make employment decisions based on skills, qualifications, experience and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic.

Accessibility

Volta is committed to providing an accessible recruitment experience for all candidates. If you require accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the application or interview process, please contact us at

Candidate Privacy Notice

By applying, you consent to the processing of your personal data for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the UK GDPR, EU GDPR and relevant US state privacy regulations. Your data will be shared only with those involved in the hiring process and will not be used for unrelated purposes. For details, see our Recruitment & Candidate Privacy Notice.

Note to Recruitment Agencies

Volta does not accept unsolicited CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies. Any unsolicited submissions, including those sent directly to hiring managers or employees, will be treated as the property of Volta. No agency fees will be payable unless a valid, signed recruitment agreement is in place, and the agency has been specifically engaged for the relevant vacancy.

title: Principal Delivery Lead
descriptionHtml:
Who is Atominvest

Atominvest is the operating system for modern private markets asset managers. Our modular, flexible SaaS technology underpins key investor- and portfolio-management workflows.

Our customers are sophisticated private equity, growth equity, and private credit firms managing billions in assets globally. We aim to deliver ongoing high-quality outcomes for them through a long-term partnership mindset.

At Atominvest, you’ll be working on something very exciting: the future of work, investments and sustainability/ ethical investing for the world’s best investors and delivering a positive impact through this. Based on the growth we are experiencing, we think we’re on to something big.

It won’t be easy. Joining a scale up business is an amazing and rewarding challenge, pushing well beyond the boundaries of natural growth cycles. You’ll move quicker than feels comfortable and be brilliant at continually re-prioritizing what must get done to keep Atominvest growing year over year at the pace of the best SaaS companies on the planet.

We’ve gone from zero to ten, now we’re looking to go from ten to one hundred!


Role Overview

As Principal Delivery Lead, you will lead Atominvest's most complex enterprise deliveries for sophisticated alternative investment managers. You are the delivery lead from scoping through go-live and long-term adoption.

You will also shape how Atominvest delivers: leading innovation in our delivery approach, setting the standard for an exceptional client experience, and making sure every programme leaves clients with lasting value. It is a hands-on senior role, grounded in deep PCM SaaS and private markets expertise.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead enterprise delivery

• Own the delivery lifecycle as the senior face of Atominvest to CFOs, COOs and heads of operations and internal technology teams.

• Run steering committees, executive reviews and detailed project updates.

• Act as design authority, turning fund structures, portfolio data and reporting processes into platform design and a phased implementation plan

• Scope integrations (APIs, SFTP, data feeds) with client technical teams, Product and Engineering, defining what's feasible and who builds what

• Stay hands-on: analyse and reconcile complex datasets, configure the platform and solve technical problems yourself

• Proactively manage risk, scope, change and customer health across complex programmes

Shape how we deliver

• Support and develop innovation in Atominvest's delivery approach: methodology, tooling, templates and documentation

• Set and uphold the standards that define an exceptional client experience, and coach internal team members on best practice

• Partner with Sales in pre-sales from a delivery angle: solution design, effort estimates and building out complex delivery SOWs

Drive long-term value

• Deliver solutions that embed Atominvest in clients' operating models and build the long-term value that drives renewal

• Bridge clients and the product roadmap: feed structured insight to Product, influence prioritisation and own feature rollouts to your clients

• Identify expansion opportunities through a deep understanding of clients' operating models and strategic goals

Requirements

• 8+ years leading enterprise B2B SaaS implementations end to end in financial services or asset management, with hands on experience configuring software and leading large-scale client programmes

• Deep functional knowledge of the private markets and SaaS that serves this industry

• A track record of developing and leading new delivery approaches, standards or methodologies that measurably improved client experience

• Experience scoping complex SOWs and supporting pre-sales from a delivery perspective

• Evidence of delivering solutions that drove long-term adoption, renewal and expansion

• Exceptional consultative skills: you’ve run workshops, translated requirements, created delivery documentation, consulted with C-suite and back-office functions as the delivery SME.

• Outstanding programme management: every dependency tracked, every deadline owned, changes communicated early, commercially minded around delivery budgets

• Delivery substance first, with an entrepreneurial mindset: clients trust you because you know their data and the platform inside out
