title: Senior Customer Success Manager
descriptionHtml:
About the role:

The Customer Success department is the backbone of Forter. As a Senior CSM, you are a key commercial lead responsible for the health, retention, and growth of our strategic accounts. We put a great deal of faith in our CSMs, who own not only customer satisfaction but also renewals, expansion, and strategic ROI. In this role, you’ll build lasting executive relationships and solve complex business challenges, developing the commercial and technical skills that will be the cornerstone of your future career.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Own the Renewal Lifecycle: Act as the primary commercial owner for your book of business, managing the end-to- end renewal process and hitting retention targets.
  • Drive Net Revenue Growth: Identify and qualify upsell opportunities within your accounts, collaborating with Sales to expand Forter’s footprint.
  • Quarterback Executive Value: Lead MBRs and QBRs to communicate Forter’s performance, ROI, and strategic impact to client stakeholders.
  • Strategic Advocacy: Convert client success into commercial momentum by securing references and case studies that serve as sales accelerators.
  • Product & Roadmap Influence: Translate client business needs into actionable insights for our Product and leadership teams to help shape the company roadmap.
  • Data Hygiene: Maintain accurate data within internal systems to ensure leadership has real-time visibility into the commercial health of your portfolio.

What you’ll need:

  • 5+ years of post-live, client-facing CS experience with a proven track record of managing renewals and hitting retention targets.
  • Commercial Acumen: Experience leading executive-level business reviews focused on ROI, budgets, and long-term contract value.
  • Strategic Planning: Ability to communicate client objectives to internal leadership to execute high-impact account strategies.
  • Industry Context: Experience in a SaaS startup; background in payments, fraud, or fintech is a significant bonus.
  • Problem-Solving Grit: Ability to break down ambiguous problems into concrete solutions and a willingness to get "in the weeds" to solve operational issues.
  • High Agency: Trusted to drive initiatives autonomously and gain buy-in from a wide collection of internal and external stakeholders.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary and bonus plan
  • Restricted Stock Units (RSU's)
  • Private health insurance, including vision and dental coverage
  • Generous PTO policy
  • Half day Fridays, every Friday

About Us:

Commerce is evolving faster than the systems built to support it. Agentic AI is redrawing how people buy. Customer expectations have a new ceiling. And bad actors are evolving alongside every advancement. 

Forter was built to meet this moment — and stay ahead of it.

We are a human-first, AI-built company. Our technology analyzes patterns across a network of over 2 billion shoppers, delivering identity intelligence across the entire commerce journey — from sign-up to checkout to returns — that protects revenue and unlocks great customer experiences simultaneously. With Forter, businesses know who to trust, whether it’s humans or the agents shopping for them. The result: zero friction for the customers who matter. No revenue left behind.

The world's most trusted brands — Nordstrom, Instacart, Priceline, Adobe, ASOS, and eBay among them — rely on Forter to get this right. Since 2013, we've raised $525M from investors including Tiger Global, Bessemer, Sequoia Capital, and Salesforce Ventures, and today we power commerce decisions for nearly 1 million businesses globally. We're more than fraud, payments and orchestration – we make trust a competitive advantage.

Trust is backed by data –  Forter is a recipient of over 10 workplace and innovation awards, including: 

  • Great Place to Work Certification (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025)
  • Fortune’s Best Workplaces in NYC (2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025)
  • Forbes Cloud 100 (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025)
  • Anti-Fraud Solution of the Year at the Payments Awards (2024)

Life as a Forterian:

Forterians are, genuinely, some of the best people you'll work with. Smart, curious, and deeply good humans who care about the work and each other. That's not an accident — it's something we've been intentional about since day one, and it's the thing people mention most when they talk about why they stay. When you're surrounded by people like this, doing work that actually matters, it changes what a job can feel like.

Forter was built on a simple but powerful conviction: when AI does its job, humans can do theirs better. That philosophy shapes our products and shapes how we work. AI is core to our workflows — not as a shortcut, but as a force multiplier that gives Forterians the space to focus their energy where human judgment is irreplaceable.

We're a global team of 500+ people, with regional headquarters in New York, Tel Aviv, London, and Singapore, and employee presence across the US, Canada, Germany, France, Japan, China, and Australia. Our teams are cross-functional by design, and the work you do here is visible, consequential, and connected to the outcomes that matter.

You'll have real ownership here and proximity to decisions. And we back that with investment in your growth — RSU offerings, L&D programs built around AI tools, and a culture of recognition rooted in our 4.5 day weeks (aka Forter’s Appreciation Fridays and Sundays). From team outings to local cultural celebrations, we mark the moments that matter — wherever you are in the world. We don't want Forter to be just another job. We want it to be the place you build.

If you're ready to work on a problem that sits at the intersection of AI, commerce, and human trust, this is it.

Forter is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that will consider all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, gender identity or expression, national origin, genetics, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please email us at ----- This information will be treated as confidential and used only for the purpose of determining an appropriate accommodation for the interview process.

Hybrid work:

At Forter, we embrace a hybrid work model that blends in-person connection with the flexibility of remote work. Team members based near our key hubs are expected to work from the office at least three days per week. We believe that regular face-to-face collaboration fuels professional development, strengthens our culture, and builds the relationships that help teams thrive.

title: Senior Data Scientist, FinCrime
descriptionHtml:
What We're Looking For

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to help build the intelligence layer behind ARQ's financial products. You'll work on some of our most important risk and financial crime challenges, developing machine learning models that help us detect fraud, prevent losses, and make better decisions at scale.

This is a highly impactful role where you'll take problems from idea to production — partnering with Product, Engineering, and Operations teams to turn large-scale datasets into models that directly influence customer and business outcomes.

You'll join a fast-growing team helping build the future of financial services for more than 2 million customers across the Americas.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, build, and deploy machine learning models that solve real-world financial crime and risk challenges.

  • Work on problems such as fraud detection, chargeback prediction, anomaly detection, identity verification, and transaction monitoring.

  • Transform ambiguous business problems into measurable ML solutions.

  • Partner closely with Product and Operations teams to define requirements, success metrics, and decision frameworks.

  • Analyse large datasets to identify patterns, opportunities, and risks.

  • Build and maintain production-ready data pipelines and model-serving solutions.

  • Monitor model performance and continuously improve accuracy, reliability, and business impact.

  • Collaborate with Data Engineering and Backend Engineering teams to operationalise machine learning at scale.

  • Help shape the future of AI and machine learning capabilities across ARQ.

What You'll Need

  • 5+ years of experience across Data Science, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, or related disciplines.

  • Strong Python skills and experience working with large-scale datasets.

  • Proven experience developing and deploying machine learning models in production environments.

  • Strong understanding of supervised learning techniques, particularly classification problems.

  • Experience with anomaly detection, fraud prevention, risk modeling, or related domains.

  • Ability to translate business challenges into data-driven solutions.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders.

  • Strong communication skills and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving.

  • Comfortable operating in fast-moving environments with high ownership.

Nice To Have

  • Experience in financial crime, fraud prevention, AML, risk, or payments.

  • Experience in fintech, banking, or financial services.

  • Backend engineering experience and familiarity with production systems.

  • Experience building real-time decisioning or risk platforms.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and benefits

  • Stock options, so you own part of what you build

  • Discretionary performance bonus

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Mit Sustaind schaffen wir die erste global harmonisierte Gesetzesdatenbank. Unsere B2B-Kunden nutzen diese Daten, um Compliance-Risiken zu minimieren und Rechtspflichten weltweit zu managen. Als einer der ersten Anbieter im Rechtskataster-Monitoring bieten wir dazu, gemeinsam mit der Great Lakes Insurance SE (Munich-Re-Gruppe), eine Leistungsgarantie an. Dafür verarbeiten wir sensible Kundendaten und Dokumente und müssen jederzeit belegen können, worauf unsere Ergebnisse beruhen. Bei uns baust Du eine Plattform, auf der das sicher, nachvollziehbar, zertifizierbar und kosteneffizient läuft.

Deine Rolle

  • Unsere AWS-Umgebung mit Terraform und Terragrunt weiterentwickeln: Multi-Account-Setup, Netzwerk, Datenschicht und EKS

  • CI/CD-Pipelines mit GitHub Actions betreiben und verbessern

  • Unsere Infrastruktur kosteneffizient der aktuellen Last anpassen, mit Autoscaling, Kostentransparenz statt Überprovisionierung

  • Unsere Agent Runtime und den Ingestor, der Dokumente für uns ausliest, aktiv mitgestalten und für ihre Skalierung und Stabilität verantwortlich sein

  • Monitoring, Alerting und Backup so betreiben, dass Störungen auffallen, bevor Kunden sie bemerken

  • Verantwortung für die Developer Experience übernehmen: Tooling, Entwicklungsumgebungen, Pipelines und Releases so gestalten, dass unser Team schnell, sicher und ohne Reibung liefern kann

  • Eine nach ISO 27001 zertifizierbare Infrastruktur bauen und bei der Beantwortung von Kunden-Security-Fragebögen unterstützen

Was Du mitbringst

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung (+ 5 Jahre) mit AWS (idealerweise Multi-Account) und Infrastructure as Code, vor allem Terraform mit Terragrunt

  • Erfahrung mit CI/CD und GitOps (z. B. GitHub Actions, ArgoCD), IAM und Least Privilege

  • Erfahrung mit Autoscaling in der Praxis mit Kubernetes

  • Erfahrung mit ISO 27001 und ISMS-Arbeit, zum Beispiel Risikomanagement, Richtlinien oder Audit-Vorbereitung, aber kein Muss. Eine Erstzertifizierung selbst begleitet zu haben ist ideal.

  • Kenntnisse in Monitoring, Audit-Trails und Backup-Konzepten

  • Erfahrung mit AI-assisted Coding und die Bereitschaft, solche Tools im Arbeitsalltag gezielt einzusetzen

  • Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Postgres, Redis + BullMQ und Nestjs sind ein Plus aber kein Muss

  • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Was Dich erwartet

Du wirst Teil eines kleinen, schlagkräftigen Teams, in dem jeder Verantwortung übernimmt und Ergebnisse erzielt:

  • Remote-first Engineering-Team, mit Büro in Bielefeld.

  • Eine Infrastruktur, die schon heute als Code gepflegt wird, mit Audit-Logging und klar getrennten Rollen.

  • Wöchentliche Releases auf Production

  • Eine spannende Phase im Unternehmen: Du baust mit uns an einem System, das Agents das erste Mal mit einer Leistungsgarantie anbietet und gestaltest von Beginn an mit, wie Nachweisbarkeit und Vertrauen in einer neuen Produktkategorie technisch aussehen

  • 100+ Kunden vertrauen bereits auf unser Produkt

  • Stabile Finanzierung aus Umsatz und starken Investoren

  • Regelmäßige Offsites (bisher Lissabon, Porto, Fuerteventura)

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Perm, UK, London - Onsite)
descriptionHtml:
Senior DevOps Engineer (Perm, UK, Onsite in London) 

This is a permanent full time opportunity for those based in the UK. This role will require 4 days per week onsite in London. 

About Nearform

Nearform is an independent team of data & AI experts, engineers, and designers who build intelligent digital solutions and capability at pace. We create AI-enabled solutions that enhance digital experiences, empower developers, and deliver measurable results. In these ways, we partner with ambitious enterprises to deliver enduring impact.

Our deep expertise in solving the world’s most complex digital problems, along with our collaborative, people-first approach, enables enterprises to build breakthrough products and modernise legacy systems by unleashing the power of AI.

Today, our team of 500 experts in 20+ countries is trusted by leading enterprises including Lululemon, Puma, Sun Life, Starbucks, Travelex, Virgin Media 02, and Walmart.  

As part of our Engineering function, you will work closely with clients to translate complex business requirements into innovative digital products. Whether you are a Senior Engineer, Tech Lead, or DevOps Engineer, you will collaborate with distributed teams, leveraging cutting-edge technologies to build secure, high-performance applications. Our Nearform engineers are known for building high quality, scalable solutions that solve real world problems.

About the Senior DevOps Engineer Role:

As a Senior DevOps Engineer at Nearform, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure to support scalable and reliable applications. Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Developing and managing cloud-based infrastructure on AWS
  • Financial services industry experience, trading or market-data systems
  • Strong Linux and Bash/Python scripting
  • Creating and maintaining deployment architectures and continuous delivery pipelines.
  • Designing high-availability and fault-tolerant solutions for applications.
  • Implementing monitoring frameworks, including dashboards, alerts, and escalation processes.
  • Automating infrastructure provisioning and management using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Managing containerized applications and orchestrating deployments using Kubernetes.
  • Ensuring security best practices are applied across CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and microservices.
  • Optimizing system performance and scalability through observability and proactive monitoring.
  • Collaborating with development teams to streamline deployment workflows and improve DevOps processes.
  • Advising clients on best practices for cloud infrastructure, deployment automation, and system security.
  • Engaging in technical discussions with stakeholders and supporting project execution to ensure timely delivery.
  • Assisting with the analysis of client requirements.
  • Working with and supporting Technical Leaders in project execution and timely delivery.
  • Collaborating with client teams.
  • Available to travel onsite 4 days per week, travel can be expensed 

What we are looking for in this person

  • Significant experience delivering at a Senior Engineer level. Our Seniors typically have at least 6 years’ commercial experience.
  • Practical experience and knowledge of developing real-world solutions.
  • Practical experience of delivering in an agile environment.
  • Strong experience managing and automating cloud-based infrastructure on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Proficiency in infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration tools, ideally Kubernetes (K8s).
  • Experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, ideally with GitHub Actions or Jenkins.
  • Scripting and automation expertise, preferably with Python.
  • Experience with observability tools and monitoring frameworks for system performance optimization.
  • Solid understanding of security best practices across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and microservices.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Professional proficiency in English.

Benefits & Perks

  • Annual Company Bonus - We all help Nearform to hit company goals so we all receive a share of the profits on an annual basis in line with company performance.
  • Paid Time Off Package - We offer an annual leave of 25 days plus public holidays. We also offer sick leave, marriage leave and many more.
  • Remote Working Allowance - Every 2 years, you will have a budget of up to €1250 (equivalent in GBP) to help you set up a comfortable and productive workspace in addition to your essential equipment provided by Nearform when you join.
  • Training and Development Allowance - Nearform is committed to supporting and investing in employees’ ongoing learning and professional development. You will be encouraged to pursue relevant learning opportunities that support your growth and the growth of others, subject to manager approval.
  • Healthcare - It’s important to always take care of your health, so we offer additional private healthcare here at Nearform. If you wish to learn more about the plan offered feel free to reach out to our team.
  • Pension & Insurances - We offer a pension match of up to 5% and Income Protection and Death in Service for peace of mind.

Our Interview Process

Talent Call (30 mins via Zoom)
An introductory conversation with a member of our Talent Team to learn more about your background, experience, and career goals. We'll also provide a high-level overview of Nearform and answer any questions you may have. This step helps us assess initial alignment.

Technical Assessment (1 hour via Zoom)
A live coding challenge with one of our trained interviewers. You'll be asked to build a working solution to a problem via screen sharing, demonstrating your DevOps engineering expertise, problem-solving ability, and coding best practices in a real-time environment.

Hiring Manager Interview (45 mins via Zoom)
A conversation with a Hiring Manager focused on your approach to teamwork, client collaboration, and problem-solving in an enterprise development setting. We'll also share more details about Nearform and the potential projects you may join.

There may also be an additional interview with the client depending on the project

Ready to Join Us?

If you're passionate about building high-quality applications, solving complex challenges, and driving innovation in enterprise development, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now via our careers page at Nearform and be part of a team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.



Nearform is committed to shaping a better world in all that we do. Our global team is built based on respect, inclusivity, diversity and excellence. 

If you require any adjustments to the interview process as part of your application, please let someone from our Talent Team know so they can help.

title: Senior Embedded Linux Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Auterion builds a cutting-edge operating system for autonomous robotic systems that empower a diverse range of platforms to perform surveillance, reconnaissance, inspection, mapping and logistics tasks. Our industry-leading software drives the adoption of robotic fleets and is recognized by the U.S. government as the future standard for its drone programs. 

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Linux Software Engineer taking on tasks within the AuterionOS ecosystem, from writing applications to adding driver support for new peripherals, maintaining system services and optimizing performance on embedded platforms. You will be working closely with:

  • Linux running on embedded hardware
  • C/C++, Python & Bash codebases
  • Engaged and friendly engineers from across Auterion

Responsibilities

  • Work within the Board Support team and collaborate with other development teams to build leading-edge products.
  • Add features, solve bugs, write tests and improve the performance of software components running on AuterionOS, Auterion’s custom embedded Linux distribution.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand both internal and customer use cases.
  • Propose new software solutions and take ownership of the implementation. Your technical expertise will have a huge impact on bringing Auterion’s drone products to market.
  • Provide expert support (L3) to customers facing technical issues.
  • Write clear and concise internal documentation, in addition to contributing to the public-facing knowledge base.
  • Participate in daily stand-ups, as well as release planning and task prioritization meetings.

Qualifications and Skills

  • B.Sc./M.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields.
  • 3+ years of experience writing object-oriented C++ and/or Python code in a professional setting.
  • Extensive experience working with embedded architectures, including cross-compilation, debugging, and performance optimization.
  • Expert Linux skills, with an excellent grasp of command line operations, resource management, systems services and networking.
  • Deep knowledge of the Linux kernel, embedded device drivers, device tree configuration and u-boot.
  • Experience with Debian/Ubuntu-based systems, Debian packaging workflows and managing complex Docker environments.
  • Knowledge of OTA updates (e.g. mender).
  • Proficient in networking concepts across all layers of the OSI model, including connectors, and hardware interfaces, IP addressing, routing protocols, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, etc.
  • Skilled in using network diagnostic tools (e.g., Wireshark, tcpdump) to identify and resolve network issues.
  • Basic embedded security knowledge, such as secure boot on embedded devices and/or UEFI, boot chain verification.
  • Proven experience with network security protocols (e.g., SSL/TLS, VPNs) and best practices for securing embedded devices, such as secure boot and encryption mechanisms.
  • Basic electrical engineering experience, such as familiarity with schematics and the instrumentation required to debug communication over I2C, SPI, UART, CAN bus.
  • Bonus: Experience with video streaming and MIPI CSI drivers.
  • Bonus: Experience with NVIDIA Jetson platforms and their associated BSP packages.
  • Bonus: Experience with NXP iMX8 platforms and their associated BSP packages.
  • Bonus: Previous contributions to open source projects, especially in the Linux ecosystem.
  • Bonus: Experience with CI/CD systems, such as Jenkins, GitHub actions, GitLab CI.
  • Experience working in an agile environment, providing daily updates in stand-ups and managing tasks in a sprint board.
  • A product-oriented mindset, with an eagerness to drive forward project initiatives.
  • EU Citizenship required.

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Company pension plan 
  • Car parking  
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave
  • Mental health and wellbeing support
  • Learning and development opportunities

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

title: Senior Field Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Fastned is one of Europe's leading fast-charging networks. Active across nine countries, we have spent nearly 15 years building the infrastructure, expertise and brand that define premium fast charging in Europe. What sets us apart is our focus on reliability, sustainability and the energy transition. We have been awarded “Best Charging Network” in the UK, France, Switzerland and the Netherlands, further establishing Fastned as a leading player in the field. This is your opportunity to make a lasting impact and help us accelerate our operations in the DACH region to the next level! Join Fastned at the forefront of Europe’s electric vehicle and charging infrastructure revolution.

The role is based in our beautiful office in Cologne, where your over 50 future colleagues cannot wait to meet you!

Your role

As Senior Operations Manager DACH, you will initially focus on Germany and Switzerland while helping shape the future of operations across the wider DACH region, including Austria as the organisation expands. Germany is entering a major growth phase, with the network expected to expand significantly in the coming years. You will help design an operating model that can absorb this growth while keeping uptime above 99%, improving customer experience and managing costs and team growth responsibly.

You will have significant ownership of how operations are run in Germany and Switzerland. As the key operational point of contact for German, Swiss and future Austrian stations, you will work closely with country and central teams, as well as contractors and service providers. Your scope spans preventive maintenance of chargers and stations, station appearance and amenities, reactive maintenance, spare parts logistics, and the continuous improvement of our operations and processes. Within the broader direction set by Fastned, you will define priorities, improve the operating model and make pragmatic decisions that keep the region performing as the network grows.

Your responsibilities

Team leadership

Lead and grow the DACH field team.

  • Supervising, coaching and developing a team of five Field Engineers and a Station Manager, with a Maintenance Coordinator joining over time, ensuring they work safely, efficiently and as one strong team.

  • Managing team capacity, prioritising work and dispatching jobs in the most efficient way across the Swiss and German network.

  • Bringing structure to the team’s priorities and ways of working, helping ensure maintenance work is completed on time and the network remains safe, reliable and available for our customers.

  • Creating a strong safety culture by ensuring full compliance with Health & Safety standards and regulatory requirements, and providing a safe and caring work environment for colleagues on the road and on site.

Operational excellence

Ensure high uptime and a great station experience.

  • Being accountable for all day-to-day operations of Fastned stations in the DACH region, from chargers and systems to the overall look and feel of our sites.

  • Ensuring we maintain network uptime above 99% in your region through effective preventive maintenance plans and swift, high-quality reactive repairs.

  • Managing a network of partners responsible for maintaining and servicing our stations.

  • Supporting improvements to the customer experience and your team in the field by regularly visiting stations, performing site inspections and quality audits, with a strong focus on safety and customer experience.

  • Overseeing the handover of new stations in the DACH region from Construction to Field Operations, ensuring they meet our operational, safety and quality standards from day one.

  • Managing spare parts flows together with our Supply Chain team to optimise local stock levels, minimise downtime and ensure that engineers always have the right parts at the right time.

  • Leading and coordinating with external partners larger infrastructure works at your stations.

  • Continuously improving how we work by taking local initiatives, standardising best practices, simplifying processes and using data and insights to make better decisions.

Customer, stakeholder and partner management

  • Delivering a best-in-class customer experience by ensuring stations are always clean, safe and easy to use, with strong attention to detail across lighting, signage, landscaping, cleanliness and amenities.

  • Collaborating closely with Customer Operations and other internal teams to monitor performance, respond to incidents and ensure a smooth, end-to-end customer journey across the network.

  • Acting as the voice of DACH Operations within the leadership team and central organisations, representing operational priorities and insights.

  • Initiating, developing and maintaining strong relationships with external partners and contractors, such as electrical contractors, cleaning, landscaping and civil works providers. Providing operational input into new station designs, upgrades and local initiatives to ensure operational excellence is embedded from the outset.

You will report to our Director of Operations, based in Amsterdam. The role is based in Germany and involves regular travel across the DACH region to visit stations and team members, as well as occasional travel to our Amsterdam headquarters.

Who are we looking for?

You are a seasoned field operations leader who can both set direction and get things done on the ground. You combine a strategic mindset with strong operational experience, and you are excited to scale and professionalise Fastned’s German and Swiss operations. You think in terms of network performance, customer experience and long-term capabilities, while also being comfortable jumping into the details when needed to remove blockers for your team.

In addition, you meet most of the following criteria:

  • You have at least eight years of relevant experience in operations roles.

  • You have proven experience scaling or professionalising operations in a growing market, for example by building teams, introducing new ways of working, improving performance and enhancing customer experience.

  • You are a strong people leader who coaches and develops your team, communicates clearly and stands your ground when needed, leads by example in the field, and creates a safe, high-performance culture.

  • You combine a strategic mindset, including the ability to set a vision for DACH Operations, define priorities and align stakeholders, with hands-on senior operational experience. You are comfortable going on site, understanding technical issues and making pragmatic trade-offs.

  • You remain calm and organised under pressure, can manage multiple priorities at once and maintain a positive, can-do attitude.

  • You are a strong communicator and stakeholder manager, able to connect the needs of the German and Swiss operations with those of our central teams and influence decisions where needed.

  • You are fluent in English and German. Any additional European language is a plus.

Join us in building a better future

We work hard to change the world, but we do not forget to recognise and celebrate our successes, big and small. We value work-life balance, offer real work flexibility and have family-friendly policies in place. We have an inclusive work environment and love authentic people, so do not try to fit in because we like you for who you are!

  • A fully electric company car, with all charging expenses covered.

  • 29 days of annual leave.

  • Two Mission Days each year to support a cause you care about or contribute to our mission.

  • A company bonus plan that recognises the impact you make.

  • A Deutschlandticket covered by Fastned.

  • An annual personal development budget of €3,000, because there is always more to learn and improve.

  • Mental wellbeing support through nilo health.

  • A subsidised Urban Sports Club membership.

  • Access to women’s health experts through our partnership with Flouria.

  • A laptop and phone of your choice, with an EU-wide mobile phone plan.

  • Daily vegetarian lunches, snacks and drinks at our office locations.

  • Team events throughout the year, an annual company trip and our legendary Christmas parties.

Interested? Apply today!

We would love to have a conversation with you! Apply now, send us your CV and explain in your cover letter why you are excited about joining our mission for freedom in sustainable transportation.

We are looking forward to your application!

title: Senior Field Performance Partner, AI
descriptionHtml:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

The GTM Performance & Strategy team helps teams turn strategy into consistent execution through targeted coaching, practice, and performance improvement. As a Senior Field Performance Partner, you’ll work with frontline Sales and Channel leaders across EMEA to diagnose performance gaps, build focused development plans, and use data and AI to help teams improve. Your work will help 1Password’s go-to-market organization perform at its best while advancing our mission to enable a safe, productive digital future.

This is not a traditional enablement role. We don’t believe more training is always the answer. We believe enablement should start with the performance problem, use data and AI to understand what’s happening, and apply the most targeted intervention possible.

You’ll independently own the performance improvement cycle for the teams you support: diagnose → prescribe → activate → reinforce → measure → adjust.

You’ll combine business results, AI-generated coaching insights, field observations, and manager input to identify where teams and individuals need support. You’ll turn those insights into focused enablement plans, use AI to scale individualized practice and coaching, help managers reinforce the right behaviors, and measure whether performance actually changed.

As 1Password continues to scale our partner-led GTM motion, you’ll also help make channel execution part of how our field operates every day. Rather than treating channel as a separate motion or specialist skill, you’ll help managers and teams build the behaviors needed to effectively identify, engage, and sell with partners as part of their everyday work.

Your job isn’t to keep people busy with enablement. It’s to help them perform better.

How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

Expectations of this role
This is a hybrid role. You will be expected to work from 1Password's London office 3 days per week, with the flexibility to work from the office up to 5 days based on business needs.

What we're looking for:

  • 7+ years of experience in a B2B technology GTM organization across Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, BDR, Enablement, frontline leadership, or a combination of these roles.

  • Experience working in a channel or partner-led GTM environment, with practical knowledge of selling with and through partners such as resellers, MSPs, distributors, and other channel partners, including partner engagement, account mapping, co-selling, and partner-led growth.

  • Experience carrying a quota, leading a frontline GTM team, or directly coaching customer-facing teams strongly preferred.

  • Strong business and analytical acumen, with demonstrated ability to diagnose performance problems, identify root causes, and turn insights into practical, measurable plans that improve skills, behaviors, and business outcomes.

  • Understanding of how to apply sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC in coaching, enablement, or field execution.

  • Credibility with frontline GTM leaders and sellers, built through curiosity, thoughtful discovery, and sound judgment, with the ability to operate independently as a coach, advisor, and constructive challenger.

  • High curiosity and fluency with AI, with experience using AI, automation, dashboards, and performance signals to make coaching more individualized, scalable, and measurable.

  • Understanding of how selling practices and customer needs vary across EMEA markets; additional language skills are helpful.

  • A bias toward action, experimentation, measurement, and continuous improvement.

What you can expect:

  • Own the performance improvement cycle for the frontline managers and teams you support: diagnose, prescribe, activate, reinforce, measure, and adjust.

  • Establish a consistent operating rhythm with managers, bringing data-informed insights and recommendations about where their coaching can have the greatest impact.

  • Combine business results, behavioral data, AI-generated coaching insights, field observations, and manager input to identify performance gaps and create focused development plans.

  • Create strategic enablement plans that address root causes and become part of the team’s day-to-day work.

  • Use AI-powered role-play, practice, feedback loops, manager coaching, live learning, and tools such as Hyperbound to support individualized development at scale.

  • Help managers reinforce key skills, products, messaging, partner motions, and GTM priorities through ongoing coaching and team practice.

  • Partner across Technical Enablement, Revenue Operations, Go-to-Market Engineering, and other teams to bring the right resources into identified performance challenges.

  • Facilitate workshops, webinars, and other learning experiences when appropriate, while enabling managers to lead reinforcement with their teams.

  • Measure whether interventions are changing behavior and improving outcomes, and share recurring performance patterns and field feedback with cross-functional partners.

UK-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between £78,000 GBP and £113,000 GBP. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, pension, and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.



At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.


Our approach to work

title: Senior Fraud Strategy Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Parcel delivery has a quality problem the industry has learned to live with. Parcels go missing between depots. Parcels get marked as delivered and never reach the customer. Most carriers treat a steady rate of loss as a cost of doing business. Relay is building the delivery company where that stops being true.

That is harder for us than for most, because nearly everyone who touches a Relay parcel is an independent partner. We can't manage them into performance. We have to build the standards, the evidence and the product that make doing the job well the natural outcome. Engineering builds the product changes you design.

Partner Excellence Highlights

  • You own decision-making, not the model: you decide which signals count, which checks become rules, and whether each fix belongs in product, policy or training. The squad lead acts on your calls.

  • Most of a parcel's journey happens between scans. How do you prove a handover happened without making the job slower for the people doing it?

  • A delivery is marked complete and the customer says it never came. How do you tell a wrong address from a handover that went wrong, and put the fix where it belongs: product, policy or training?

  • Some checks can only answer "can't tell". Which are worth making provable, and which should we stop measuring?

  • A whole area, not a slice: you decide what evidence a whole network runs on, and the result is on the street the next morning.

  • Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Fraud Strategy Analyst at Relay, you'll:

  • Decide which Partner Excellence problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

  • Design how Partner Excellence decides: which signals count, what evidence the network runs on, and what good looks like.

  • Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

  • Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

  • Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop.

  • Get the missing data built, and prove which fixes worked. In a year, the squad can prove every handover in the network.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have owned fraud, risk or trust decisions end to end: turned investigations into rules, standards or interventions, and owned their number, such as the false positive rate you were held to, rather than building the model.

  • Have run investigations in fraud, risk, financial crime or trust and safety, and decided whether a signal was real or noise.

  • Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or engineers built what you asked for.

  • Have worked somewhere with enough volume for a false positive rate to mean something, where your rules ran live and something happened when they were wrong.

  • Have got records created by teams who didn't report to you, and know how long it takes.

  • Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: Senior Geodesist
descriptionHtml:
Senior Geodesist

This is a future role. We're building a shortlist now and will contact you when it opens.

About us

Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit.

We design and run low-cost, autonomous satellite laser ranging stations. They measure the distance to satellites with extreme precision, day and night. Our data platform turns those measurements into tracking data and orbit products for satellite operators, space agencies and governments. We also build our own flight-proven laser retroreflector arrays, so any satellite can be tracked.

Our station network is expanding across continents. The data supports resilient navigation, Earth observation and the safe, sustainable use of space.

We're a small, fast-moving team of engineers, scientists and operators in London. We're backed by venture investors and supported by ESA, the UK Space Agency, and Innovate UK.

Position Overview

London · Full time · On-site

You'll lead our geodesy work. That means making sure our ranging data meets the standards of the international geodetic community, and turning it into products that scientists and operators trust.

What you'll do

  • Lead geodetic processing and analysis of our satellite laser ranging data

  • Contribute to reference frame and Earth orientation products

  • Define data quality standards, and validate our data against international analysis centres

  • Represent Foundational in the ILRS, IAG and wider geodetic community

  • Guide our data scientists and software engineers on models and algorithms

  • Publish and present at conferences

What you'll bring

  • A PhD or equivalent experience in space geodesy or a related field

  • Deep knowledge of SLR and at least one other space-geodetic technique (GNSS, VLBI or DORIS)

  • Experience with reference frames (ITRF), Earth orientation and IERS conventions

  • Experience with geodetic analysis software such as GEODYN, Bernese or GipsyX

  • A publication record or equivalent track record

Nice to have

  • Experience at an ILRS analysis or data centre

  • Gravity field modelling or precise orbit determination

  • Python

What We Offer

descriptionHtml:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.   We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

About the Role

CoreWeave is seeking a Data Center Senior Lease Analyst to support the administration, accuracy, and ongoing optimization of our growing data center, real estate, and equipment lease portfolio. In this role, you will own complex lease administration activities, maintain lease data integrity, support ASC 842 / IFRS 16 and SOX compliance, and improve reporting and controls within our lease management system, CoStar.

You’ll partner closely with Accounting, Finance, Operations, Tax, Legal, and external landlords and brokers to ensure lease obligations are accurately captured, payments are processed appropriately, and critical dates and contractual requirements are effectively managed. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys interpreting complex agreements, solving problems, and improving processes in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Own lease abstraction and interpretation for complex and non-standard data center, real estate, and equipment leases.
  • Review and approve lease abstractions and data entry completed by Lease Analysts and third-party providers, providing quality-control sign-off.
  • Manage critical lease dates, including renewals, terminations, escalations, and notice deadlines.
  • Coordinate with Accounts Payable and DC leadership to ensure timely and accurate lease payments and approvals.
  • Partner with landlords and brokers to resolve billing disputes, reconcile CAM, operating expenses, and tax charges, and confirm lease commencement and rent commencement dates.
  • Perform desk audits of annual operating expense statements to validate charges against lease terms.
  • Interpret complex commercial lease provisions related to rent, taxes, insurance, power usage, cross-connects, and other contractual obligations.
  • Support lease negotiations, amendments, and legal redlines by providing lease administration expertise and historical context.
  • Maintain accurate lease data in CoStar, identify data quality issues, and implement improvements to strengthen controls and reporting.
  • Support ASC 842, IFRS 16, and SOX compliance, including internal and external audit requests, documentation, and data validation.
  • Prepare and distribute recurring and ad hoc reports, KPI dashboards, critical-date trackers, and briefing materials for internal stakeholders and leadership.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for landlord and broker relationships, including escalations and issue resolution.
  • Build strong relationships with Accounting, Finance, Operations, Tax, and Legal to ensure timely and accurate lease information.
  • Train, mentor, and provide quality oversight for Lease Analysts.
  • Drive continuous improvement across lease administration workflows, reporting, controls, and system utilization.
  • Serve as backup to the Lease Administration Manager during absences, including approvals, escalations, and time-sensitive decisions.
  • Support Tax with VAT recovery activities as needed by region.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Real Estate, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of commercial real estate lease administration experience, preferably supporting data centers or other complex infrastructure portfolios.
  • Strong understanding of ASC 842 / IRFS 16 and lease accounting principles.
  • Demonstrated experience reviewing, interpreting, and administering complex commercial lease agreements and amendments.
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with experience identifying discrepancies and resolving complex lease or billing issues.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and critical deadlines in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across Finance, Accounting, Operations, Legal, and external partners.

Preferred:

  • Experience with CoStar or a similar lease administration platform.
  • Experience with Asana and Google Workspace.
  • Familiarity with SOX controls and IFRS 16.
  • Data center or infrastructure-related lease administration experience.

Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.

  • You possess excellent communication, organisational, and analytical skills.
  • You are able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • You have a proactive mindset with a track record of identifying gaps and driving solutions.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

  • Be Curious at Your Core
  • Act Like an Owner
  • Empower Employees
  • Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
  • Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.

What We Offer

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:

  • Family-level Medical Insurance
  • Family-level Dental Insurance 
  • Generous Pension Contribution 
  • Life Assurance at 4x Salary 
  • Critical Illness Cover 
  • Employee Assistance Programme 
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Work culture focused on innovative disruption

Benefits may vary by location. 

Equal Opportunity 

CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

Recruitment Agencies

CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms & Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void.

Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us – that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy – will be considered by us to be a “free gift”, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate’s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate’s details also be submitted by any other party.

Export Control Compliance

This position requires access to technology and/or source code subject to U.S. export control laws. Any such access will be provided only in compliance with applicable U.S. export control requirements. As part of the recruitment process, CoreWeave may request limited information reasonably necessary to assess applicable export-control requirements.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, GPU Optimization
descriptionHtml:
About Boltz

Boltz is a public benefit company building the next generation of AI-powered molecular modeling tools to make biology programmable and accelerate drug discovery, while keeping frontier capabilities broadly accessible.

Boltz began as an MIT spin-out. Our founders built Boltz-1 at MIT, and it became the first fully open-source model to match AlphaFold 3's accuracy in predicting the 3D structure of biomolecular complexes.

We focus on two things:

  • Open foundation models. Boltz-1, Boltz-2, and BoltzGen are open models trusted by 100,000+ scientists across biotech and academia, and used in programs at every Top 20 pharma as well as leading agrichemical and industrial research organizations.

  • Boltz Lab. Our commercial platform runs our latest models and design agents as reliable, production-grade tools built around real chemistry and biology workflows. Teams start from a target and a hypothesis, then generate, evaluate, and rank candidate molecules, while we provide the compute, infrastructure, and collaboration layer so their scientists can move faster.

The two feed each other: open-source adoption earns scientific credibility and community insight, and Boltz Lab turns that into real impact on our partners' discovery programs.

You can read more about our mission, research and product vision in our manifesto.

About the role

As a ML Engineer in GPU Optimization, you will own how fast and how reliably our structure models train. Every hour cut from a training run is another experiment our researchers can run; a near-term goal is a 1.5x speedup on our structure model, with long runs finishing without interruption.

You will spend most of your time embedded with a research team (such as pre-training, post-training or biologics), working side by side with research scientists, and the rest with Research Engineering on tools shared across teams. You'll also work with Platform Engineering, who own GPU orchestration across Boltz.

This role is ideal for an engineer who loves profiling, can look at a GPU utilization or loss curve and know where to start digging, and wants their speedups to show up in better science.

What you'll do

  • Speed up large-scale training of our structure models, finding and removing bottlenecks in kernels, memory, communication, data loading and parallelism.

  • Write and tune custom GPU kernels where they pay off (e.g. Triton or CUDA), and get the most from each new GPU generation.

  • Make long training runs complete without interruption: diagnose failures and degraded runs from throughput, utilization and loss signals, and fix the root cause.

  • Build reusable profiling and optimization tooling, including agent-assisted, profile-guided optimization, so speedups carry across teams.

  • Feed what you learn about performance back into how researchers design models and experiments.

About you

Minimum Requirements

  • Experience in optimizing deep learning training on multi-node GPU clusters (e.g. FSDP, DeepSpeed, Megatron).

  • Deep GPU performance expertise: profiling (e.g. PyTorch Profiler, Nsight), memory and communication tuning, and kernel work in Triton or CUDA.

  • Strong PyTorch and Python, with enough ML intuition to judge how an engineering change affects training dynamics and results.

  • A track record of measurable speedups or reliability gains on real, large training workloads.

  • You enjoy investigating problems with researchers, rather than taking tickets.

Preferred Requirements

  • Exposure to structure prediction, diffusion models, or biology and chemistry data.

  • Experience with Kubernetes and cluster operations; coding agents as a core part of your workflow.

  • Experience using Boltz models, or contributions to open-source training frameworks or kernel libraries.

We know great people don't always tick every box. If this role excites you and you meet most of the minimum requirements, we'd like to hear from you.

What we offer

  • Make training faster for open models used by 100,000+ scientists.

  • Work alongside one of the most talent-dense teams in the field.

  • Significant ownership and independence, with responsibility for driving projects from concept to deployment.

  • Highly competitive salary with meaningful equity in a public benefit company.

  • Benefits:

    • 25 days plus bank holidays a year

    • Annual team offsite trip

    • Private healthcare (BUPA), covering pre-existing conditions

    • Pension program

    • Paid parental leave

    • Wellhub gym membership

    • Free lunch every day

    • Travel expenses

How we hire

  1. Initial screen with a member of the Talent team

  2. Diagnosis interview: work through a degraded training run with us (no manual coding test)

  3. Onsite in London or virtual onsite with the team

  4. Offer + Onboarding

Our commitment

Boltz is committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. If you need any adjustments during the hiring process, tell us and we'll make it work.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.


About the team

 

Our Retail and Consumer experts are dedicated to helping clients in an industry which is being transformed by new technologies and evolving consumer expectations. Leveraging over a decade of experience in Applied AI, we combine exceptional technical and delivery expertise to empower businesses to adapt and thrive.

  

About the role

 

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, we’ll look to you to lead development and deployment of cutting-edge AI systems for our diverse clients. You’ll design, build, and deploy scalable, production-grade ML software and infrastructure that meets rigorous operational and ethical standards.

 

This is an ambitious, cross-functional role requiring a blend of technical expertise, engineering leadership, and confident client-facing skills.

 

What you'll be doing:

 

  • Leading technical scoping and architectural decisions for high-impact ML systems

  • Designing and building production-grade ML software, tools, and scalable infrastructure

  • Defining and implementing best practices and standards for deploying machine learning at scale across the business

  • Collaborating with engineers, data scientists, product managers, and commercial teams to solve critical client challenges and leverage opportunities

  • Acting as a trusted technical advisor to customers and partners, translating complex concepts into actionable strategies

  • Mentoring and developing junior engineers, actively shaping our team's engineering culture and technical depth

     

Who we're looking for:

 

  • You understand the full ML lifecycle and have significant experience operationalising models built with frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch

  • You bring deep expertise in software engineering and strong Python skills, focusing on building robust, reusable systems

  • You have demonstrable hands-on experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), including architecture, security, and infrastructure

  • You've extensive experience working with container and orchestration tools such at Docker & Kubernetes to build and manage applications at scale

  • You thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments, demonstrating ownership and autonomy in driving projects to completion

  • You communicate exceptionally well, confidently guiding both technical teams and senior, non-technical stakeholders

 

Our Interview Process

 

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Pair Programming Interview (90 minutes)

  3. System Design Interview (90 minutes)

  4. Commercial Interview (60 minutes)

#LI-PRIO

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Small Molecules
descriptionHtml:
About Boltz

Boltz is a public benefit company building the next generation of AI-powered molecular modeling tools to make biology programmable and accelerate drug discovery, while keeping frontier capabilities broadly accessible.

Boltz began as an MIT spin-out. Our founders built Boltz-1 at MIT, and it became the first fully open-source model to match AlphaFold 3's accuracy in predicting the 3D structure of biomolecular complexes.

We focus on two things:

  • Open foundation models. Boltz-1, Boltz-2, and BoltzGen are open models trusted by 100,000+ scientists across biotech and academia, and used in programs at every Top 20 pharma as well as leading agrichemical and industrial research organizations.

  • Boltz Lab. Our commercial platform runs our latest models and design agents as reliable, production-grade tools built around real chemistry and biology workflows. As a Machine Learning Engineer on Small Molecules, you will own the engineering that turns our small-molecule models into fast, reliable pipelines, from training and evaluation to the design workflows partners run in Boltz Lab. Our next model, BoltzMol-2, has to work at scale on real hit-finding and hit-optimization programs, and that depends on the pipelines around it as much as the model itself.

You will work closely with the Small Molecules team's research and cheminformatics scientists, Research Engineering, our Product and Platform engineers, and our pharma and biotech partners.

This role is ideal for an engineer who likes owning ML systems end to end and wants to see them used on real discovery programs.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain training, fine-tuning and evaluation pipelines for our small-molecule models.

  • Build scalable design pipelines: generate, score, filter and rank millions of molecules with consistent, reproducible outputs.

  • Take small-molecule models and workflows from research into Boltz Lab, with Product and Platform engineers.

  • Run and adapt pipelines on partner data for pilots and customer projects, and deliver results on time.

  • Feed what you learn about performance, failure modes and usability back to research scientists and the product team.

About you

Minimum Requirements

  • Senior or Staff-level experience building and shipping machine learning systems in production.

  • Solid software engineering fundamentals: clean, tested, maintainable code and reproducible pipelines.

  • A track record of taking models from research to production or to real users.

  • Working knowledge of molecular ML or cheminformatics (e.g. RDKit, molecular representations), and comfort working with chemists and researchers.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience on drug discovery programs, or with binding, screening or protein–ligand structural data.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration, Kubernetes or cloud GPU infrastructure; early-stage startup experience.

  • Experience using Boltz models, or open-source contributions.

We know great people don't always tick every box. If this role excites you and you meet most of the minimum requirements, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Senior Manager, Global Direct Procurement (f/m/x)
descriptionHtml:
The role

HelloFresh manages approximately €1.7B in annual direct procurement spend across ingredients and packaging, covering markets in the EU, US, Canada, ANZ, and the UK. This role builds the cost intelligence capability for Global Procurement. You will create the analytical models and frameworks that give the business clear visibility into what ingredients really cost: where those costs come from, how they move, and where the opportunities lie. Your work will give regional teams the insight they need to make well-grounded decisions and to track progress against the group's cost reduction ambitions. This is a role for a senior procurement professional who is comfortable with detailed analysis and who can explain complex numbers simply to senior leaders and to colleagues in markets. You will be recognised as the go-to expert on cost across the team.

You will...

  • Develop a harmonised cost measurement methodology with Finance and regional procurement teams, so that ingredient savings are defined, measured, and reported consistently across all markets.
  • Build should-cost models and total cost of ownership frameworks for priority categories, breaking unit price into its drivers (origin, processing method, logistics, certification, and shelf life), and use them to identify savings and inform sourcing decisions.
  • Track ingredient price drivers across markets, including contract prices, actual prices, and market inflation, and identify overlap across brands to find rationalisation and consolidation opportunities.
  • Report progress against the group's ingredient cost reduction target to senior leadership, explaining root causes rather than just variances, and help build the governance needed to sustain this over time.

You are....

  • An analytical professional who builds models that hold up to scrutiny from Finance and senior leadership.
  • Commercially minded: you look at total value, not just unit price, and you understand what drives cost in food and packaging.
  • A clear communicator who turns complex analysis into a simple story that regional teams can act on.
  • Collaborative: you build alignment with Finance, procurement, and market teams through influence rather than authority.
  • Self-directed: you manage several analyses at once and take ownership from the question through to the recommendation.

You have....

  • 5+ years in procurement, cost analysis, or consulting in a global food, retail, or consumer goods business.
  • Hands-on experience building should-cost models or total cost of ownership frameworks, and using them to influence real commercial decisions.
  • Experience measuring cost and savings across multiple markets, including the common pitfalls such as inconsistent methods, inflation effects, and volume mix.
  • Experience with food, ingredient, or packaging categories, including origin, certification, and specification considerations.
  • Fluent in English. Bonus if fluent in French, German, or Dutch. Comfortable working across time zones, with the ability to travel up to 20%.

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with sustainability certification schemes and their cost implications.
  • Experience with commodity price risk or hedging frameworks.

What we offer

Compensation & Financial Wellbeing

  • Enjoy 20% off HelloFresh and 40% off Factor_ subscriptions.
  • Access the "Benefits at Work" platform for discounts on brands like Nike, Bol.com, and IKEA. 
  • You'll receive a HelloFresh laptop, a €250 home office setup budget, and contribute to the Bedrijfspensioenfonds Levensmiddelen pension scheme (2025 rate 27.6%; employer pays 19.64%, employee pays 7.96%).

Health & Wellbeing

  • Benefit from discounts on ClassPass and gym memberships via Bedrijfsfitness Nederland, free bootcamp classes (Amsterdam), and free subscriptions to Headspace and OpenUp.
  • Get a 10% discount on additional health insurance at Zilveren Kruis in 2025.

Flexibility & Work-Life

  • Work flexibly with our hybrid setup (50% office, 50% remote), plus a €2.40 daily remote work allowance.
  • Receive 24 days of annual leave (pro-rated), plus one additional day per year of service (up to 30 days total).
  • Full reimbursement for 2nd-class public transport to the office, plus €0.23 per km for car and bicycle travel.
  • Eligible employees can work from another country for up to 8 weeks per year.

Career & Development

  • Grow with our "Learning Never Stops" mindset: participate in Pantry Staple trainings, access internal/external opportunities, and join our cross-market mentoring program.

Culture & Environment

  • Enjoy fresh homemade lunches in the office (€3.00/day), weekly vrij-mi-bo (Friday drinks), quarterly strategy sessions, and team events.

We are HelloFresh

At HelloFresh we embrace and welcome diversity and we currently employ over 15,000 individuals globally who contribute to this. We employ individuals based on their ability to perform a job rather than on the basis of their: race, national origin, color, caste, social origin or position, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, political opinion, marital status or any other characteristic. We encourage everyone to apply and will give everyone equal consideration. We are an equal opportunity employer – everyone is welcome at our table.
