title: Senior Manager, Integrated MarComms, France & Benelux
descriptionHtml:
Tinder exists to help people meet, connect and create a spark. After 13 years of leadership in the dating industry, culture is what keeps that mission relevant to each new generation of daters. Product is central to this shift. Every new feature is a chance to tell a human story about how people connect, and culture is where those stories land.

To make that shift real, we’re bringing our Tinder MarComms regional EMEA strategy together: one unified in-country team in each key market and one regional structure. Communications now sits within Marketing, so both work toward the same KPIs and growth objectives.

The Integrated MarComms role is where culture meets brand relevance, with one holistic objective: driving MAU growth. Social Media is the true D2C MarComms engine for Tinder, and creator and influencer led activations play a central role in driving registrations, reactivations and cultural relevance.

The regional MarComms team owns the full paid, earned and owned media cycle across key markets. The Integrated MarComms Senior Manager leads the earned and influence dimension of that ecosystem, with a strong influence on owned social channels and brand partnership storytelling.

The role reports to the Director of Marketing of France & Benelux. It works in a matrix with the Snr. Director of Social Media, Snr. Manager of Brand Partnerships, and closely with the Global Comms team.


Key Responsibilities

1. Creator & Influencer Ecosystem Engagement

  • Build and nurture a diverse network of community voices: creators, influencers, podcast hosts, cultural commentators and community leaders.
  • Develop collaborations rooted in a strong audience insight and shared creative idea, giving partners a meaningful role beyond content distribution.
  • Work closely with social, influence and brand partnership teams to connect local opportunities with broader brand priorities.
  • Create opportunities for audiences to participate and share their own stories, turning campaigns into conversations that extend beyond launch.

    • 2. Social-First Integrated MarComms Strategy

  • Translate market priorities into integrated MarComms plans for France & Benelux, in close partnership with the market lead, marketing manager and EMEA teams.

  • Develop compelling creative ideas with the potential to travel across paid, owned and earned channels, giving each channel a clear role in building relevance, consideration and action.

  • Build strategies around how Gen Z discovers, shares and participates in culture, across various formats, creators, podcasts, digital communities and emerging platforms.

  • Help raise the creative and strategic standard of Tinder’s organic social channels, building distinctive formats and stories that audiences want to be part of.

    • 3. Creating Cultural Narratives for Gen Z

  • Turn audience insights, cultural tensions and dating behaviours into locally relevant narratives that strengthen Tinder’s role in modern dating, particularly among young women.
  • Make product innovation meaningful through human stories and creative experiences that show how Tinder helps people meet, connect and create a spark.
  • Broaden the representation of dating success to reflect the connections, experiences and stories Gen Z values, building a more positive and credible perception of Tinder.
  • Anticipate cultural moments and emerging conversations, using data, cultural understanding and creative judgment to identify where the brand can make a meaningful contribution.
  • Own a quarterly and annual activation calendar, balancing planned campaigns with timely opportunities, and contribute local insights and ideas to EMEA initiatives.

    • 4. Earned Impact & Measurement

  • Connect MarComms activity to clear objectives, supporting registrations and reactivations as contributions to the overarching goal of MAU growth.

  • Own measurement of earned and social impact, including share of conversation, message uptake, sentiment and meaningful engagement, moving beyond coverage volume and impressions.

  • Partner with Insights and Analytics to assess contributions to brand consideration, trust, relevance and perceptions of the dating experiences Tinder enables.

  • Use results to sharpen creative choices, improve distribution and recommend where to scale, adapt or stop activity.

    • 5. End-to-End Campaign & Agency Management

  • Own campaigns from brief to launch to wrap-up in France & Benelux, making sure paid, owned and earned moments work as one story.

  • Brief, steer and hold agency partners to the bar on creative quality, timelines and budgets, so their work feeds the integrated plan.

  • Keep workflows with EMEA and Global teams clear, so local executions stay on brand and on time.

  • Coordinate crisis and issue management with Comms leadership, anticipating sensitive topics and keeping responses fast, aligned and on brand.

    • As part of our team, you'll enjoy:

    • The hustle of a startup with the impact of a global business
    • Tremendous opportunity to solve some of the industry’s most exciting problems
    • Working with an extraordinary team of smart, creative, fun and highly motivated people
    • Comprehensive health coverage, competitive pay, team bonding events, yoga classes and social events

    Commitment to Inclusion

    At Tinder, we don’t just accept difference, we celebrate it. title: Senior Manager
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

In our Professional and Financial Services Business unit, we bring everything we have learned in more than a decade of Applied AI, and use it to help our clients navigate a rapidly changing landscape.

We develop and embed AI solutions which help firms become more efficient, enhance customer experience, and find the commercial upside in uncertain markets. Within the constraints of a highly regulated industry, we see so much opportunity for meaningful innovation and are proud to set the gold-standard for marrying technical excellence with safe deployment.

About the role

Join us as a Senior Manager to oversee a critical portfolio of projects, acting as the primary senior point of contact for both clients and internal Faculty teams. You will drive successful delivery, manage project commercial viability, and nurture strong customer relationships. This is an entrepreneurial role where you will identify new business opportunities, develop proposals, and contribute to the growth of the business unit. You will lead and mentor cross-functional teams while acting as a strategic consultant, applying structured thinking to solve complex, real-world problems with Applied AI.

What you'll be doing:

  • Overseeing delivery of an end-to-end project portfolio, ensuring high quality, timely completion, and managing commercial margins

  • Forming and maintaining strong, trusted relationships with customers, proactively managing expectations and carefully controlling project scope

  • Leading effective project meetings and ensuring clear, consistent communication of purpose and direction to both internal teams and clients

  • Identifying risks early, and leading teams to implement effective mitigating actions to ensure project success

  • Developing compelling proposals and sales pitches to generate new leads and identify opportunities for additional account growth

  • Mentoring and developing project team members’ skills, aligning their responsibilities with their professional growth

  • Advising clients on AI strategy and solutions, while articulating the value of AI in diverse business contexts

Who we're looking for:

  • You have successful experience in technology delivery, ideally from a consulting, technology, or data-specific background

  • You are adept at building and maintaining customer trust and translating between technical detail and core business challenges

  • You can provide a structured, analytical, and technical breakdown of problems, defining solutions that enhance customer workflows

  • You have demonstrated experience in the smooth delivery of excellent outcomes, using methodologies like Agile, Scrum, or Kanban

  • You are comfortable working in an ambiguous setting and have a clear understanding of how to structure commercials and pricing

  • You can identify and implement new business opportunities, including finding growth within accounts and visible support on external business development

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Senior Manager, Product Partnerships
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

Perk works best when it connects seamlessly with the tools and platforms our customers

already rely on. From ERP and accounting systems to workplace software, mobility providers,

technology platforms, and emerging AI ecosystems, these third-party relationships can directly

shape the value customers get from Perk.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Product Partnerships to own and build those relationships.

Unlike our Growth Partnerships and Supplier Partnerships teams, this role isn’t responsible for

generating sales pipeline or supplier commission revenue. Its goal is to make Perk’s product

and customer experience stronger through the third parties we depend on and integrate with.

You’ll determine where strategic relationships can unlock the most customer value, build and

manage those partnerships, secure the access and agreements our teams need, and work

closely with Product and Engineering to turn them into successful customer-facing experiences.

This is a new role at Perk with significant opportunity to define how Product Partnerships should

work as we scale.

What You’ll Do

  • Build our product partnership strategy: Translate Perk’s product and company priorities into a clear roadmap of third-party relationships across areas such as ERP and accounting, business software, mobility, integration platforms, and AI.

  • Own strategic partner relationships: Serve as Perk’s primary relationship owner for the external platforms and technology companies that enable or enhance customer-facing product experiences.

  • Unlock Product and Engineering: Secure the developer access, API licences, programme memberships, certifications, marketplace approvals, and other partner support our teams need to build and maintain integrations.

  • Structure and negotiate partnerships: Lead commercial and strategic discussions around API access, data, licensing, marketplace participation, co-marketing, and other partnership terms, working closely with Legal, Security, Finance, Product, and Engineering.

  • Partner with Product on priorities: Bring the partner and market perspective into roadmap discussions while Product Managers own product requirements and delivery. Help determine which external relationships and integration models create the greatest customer value.

  • Own the partner lifecycle: Manage relationships from initial engagement through integration, certification, launch, ongoing roadmap alignment, escalations, programme changes, and renewals.

  • Drive adoption and customer value: Work with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Sales, and Support to ensure partnerships aren’t simply launched—they are discoverable, useful, reliable, and adopted by customers.

  • Build the Product Partnerships playbook: Establish how Perk evaluates, prioritises, launches, measures, and manages product partnerships as this function grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience in strategic partnerships, ecosystem partnerships, business development, or a product-adjacent role within SaaS, fintech, or B2B technology.

  • Experience building and managing complex relationships with technology or platform companies, ideally including developer, API, certification, or marketplace programmes.

  • Comfortable working with Product and Engineering and understanding technical concepts such as APIs, OAuth, data models, sandboxes, and integration dependencies without needing to be an engineer.

  • Ability to distinguish between an interesting partnership and one that will meaningfully improve Perk’s product or customer experience.

  • Strong relationship-building, negotiation, and communication skills across both external partners and senior internal stakeholders.

  • Able to move complex initiatives forward across Product, Engineering, Legal, Security, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, and Sales without relying on direct authority.

  • Comfortable defining the strategy, operating model, priorities, and processes for a new function rather than inheriting an established playbook.

  • Able to build the case for a partnership and measure its impact through adoption, customer experience, integration quality, and other relevant outcomes.

  • Based within commuting distance of our London or Barcelona hub.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with ERP, accounting, spend management, payments, travel, or fintech ecosystems.

  • Experience managing relationships with major business software, technology, mobility, or AI platforms.

  • Familiarity with unified API or integration-platform models.

  • Experience with European ERP and accounting ecosystems across markets such as DACH, Benelux, France, the Nordics, or the UK.

  • Additional European languages.

 

What We Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

The Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30 mins - Virtual

  • Hiring Manager Interview - 30 mins - Virtual

  • Assessment Interview - 60 mins - IRL / Virtual

  • Values interview - 30 mins - Virtual

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

title: Senior Manager, Site Merchandising UK
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Senior Manager, Site Merchandising - UK

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Manager, Site Merchandising to own the customer journey across the Quince UK site—our largest and most important market. This role sits at the intersection of storytelling, strategy, and data. You’ll be responsible for how products and content come to life on the site to attract, engage, and convert customers.

Beyond optimizing the onsite experience, this role will take a leading position in SEO and organic growth, leveraging content and site merchandising tools to drive awareness, discovery, and traffic. You’ll use insights and data to ensure Quince’s unique value proposition shines through every page—from homepage to product detail.

This role will participate in shaping our growth in the UK and EU through leveraging our global tools and processes, helping improve them and developing impactful localization strategy and tactics across web and app. You’ll partner closely with Marketing, Creative, Category Management, and Engineering to ensure site merchandising supports both brand and business goals.

This role requires being onsite at our London office four days a week.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end merchandising strategy for the Quince UK website and mobile apps, ensuring a seamless and inspiring customer experience.
  • Manage and optimize merchandising tools and platforms that power product discovery, personalization, and site and app performance.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Merchandising, Marketing, Creative, and Data teams to align onsite experiences with seasonal campaigns, assortment shifts, and brand priorities.
  • Partner with global teams to ensure improvements to tooling, automation, merchandising best practices can be easily adopted in the region as well as improving our key metrics.
  • Use analytics and testing to continuously improve site navigation, product placement, and content engagement.
  • Own site merchandising calendar and execution for key selling moments (e.g., Black Friday/Cyber Monday, holiday, new launches).
  • Drive best practices in product storytelling, cross-selling, and navigation to improve engagement and conversion.
  • Partner with Engineering and Data teams to implement content automation, metadata structuring, and semantic optimization that improve site crawlability and ranking in AI search results.
  • Stay ahead of evolving SEO landscapes (Google’s SGE, OpenAI’s search integrations, etc.) to ensure Quince ranks prominently in next-generation search ecosystems.

Qualifications

Required:

  • A minimum of 5+ years of experience in site merchandising, ecommerce, digital merchandising, site optimization, or growth/SEO
  • Proven track record of an end-to-end customer journey across web and app for a high-volume consumer brand.
  • Experience leading a merchandising or digital experience function for an international or multi-market business and strong localization expertise.
  • Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience using A/B testing, web analytics tools (e.g., GA4, Amplitude, Mixpanel), and experimentation platforms.
  • Advanced knowledge of SEO foundations: metadata, internal linking, site structure, schema marketup, crawlability.
  • Strong understanding of UK/EU ecommerce consumer behavior, online buying patterns, seasonal trends, and regulatory considerations.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Experience leading a design-forward team that is obsessed with pixel-perfect craftsmanship.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 4 days onsite at our London office is required.

Preferred:

  • Personalized customer experience across multiple channels.
  • Demonstrated experience applying AI tools.
  • Track record of success in fast-scaling, high-growth environments, ideally in direct-to-consumer (DTC) or omnichannel commerce.
  • Familiarity with search & merchandising tools (Bloomreach, Algolia).
  • Familiarity with SEO platforms (Botify, Semrush).
  • Familiarity with A/B testing tools (Optimizely, VWO) and product analytics tools (Looker, Tableau). 
  • Excited by super-IC role with broad scope and impact.

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. 

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

title: Senior Network Operations Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the job

Turn complex network faults into lasting fixes, and make new services ready for reliable operation.

As a Senior Network Operations Engineer in Bristol, UK, you’ll keep Graphcore’s networks reliable and secure. This full-time role spans the network lifecycle, from shaping operational requirements to resolving complex incidents.

Your improvements will reduce downtime and manual errors across new and existing services. You’ll help colleagues operate services confidently, with practical runbooks and recovery procedures ready when problems arise.

You’ll troubleshoot routing and firewalls, improve monitoring and automate routine operations. You’ll also support upgrades and deployments through testing, controlled changes and clear handovers.

Your scope includes AWS networking, Cisco Software-Defined Access and SD-WAN across cloud and on-premises environments. Occasional travel to remote data centres and offices will involve installations, troubleshooting and hands-on support. 

The team and culture

You’ll join a supportive, multidisciplinary IT infrastructure team that works closely together and regularly shares knowledge. With new projects ahead, you’ll bring operational experience into network designs alongside architects and project teams.

As a senior escalation point, you’ll own complex incidents through to resolution. You’ll use monitoring evidence and recurring incident trends to prioritise reliability improvements. 

What we’re looking for

AWS networking, Cisco Software-Defined Access (SDA) or SD-WAN experience would be particularly valuable, but is not essential.

  • At least five years’ hands-on network engineering experience, focused on production support, with certification in a major networking platform.
  • Strong practical knowledge of large-scale L2/L3 networks, including BGP, OSPF, switching, routing and resilience.
  • Experience supporting centrally controlled Wi-Fi, such as Cisco Meraki or Aruba, and resolving connectivity and performance issues.
  • Experience managing and troubleshooting centralised firewalls, including rulesets, NAT and VPNs, plus familiarity with open-source products such as pfSense.
  • Hands-on use of Ansible, Python or similar tools to automate operations and manage network configurations.
  • Evidence-led troubleshooting using monitoring, packet captures and logs, alongside clear communication, documentation and sound judgement during incidents. 

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.

Benefits

  • Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
  • Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work
  • Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension
  • Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success
  • Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day
  • Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones
  • Electric Vehicle Scheme: Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice
  • Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme and dental cover

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you. 

Sponsorship

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role. 

Access to controlled technology

Some roles at Graphcore involve access to technology subject to U.S. export control regulations. Depending on the role, we may need to assess whether export authorisation is required, taking account of factors such as work location, citizenship and immigration status. Where authorisation is required, this may affect whether or when you can start the role. We’ll explain any relevant requirements during the recruitment process. 

Join the Team at Graphcore

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute. 

Apply to join Graphcore in Bristol and turn your network operations expertise into more reliable services.

title: Senior NX CAD Application Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Maya HTT is a world leading developer of digital industries software solutions. The world’s top tier engineering and manufacturing organizations rely on Maya’s experience and expertise to achieve the full potential of their software investment. Maya HTT is also a Value Added Reseller (VAR) for the Siemens PLM Software products, with a focus on CAE-based simulation and providing engineering services, including software training, migration, implementation, and custom development, along with consulting.

Position Summary

We’re looking for an experienced Senior NX CAD Application Engineer to join our UK team. In this role, you’ll be a trusted technical partner to our customers, helping leading engineering organizations solve complex design challenges and get more value from Siemens NX and the broader digital engineering ecosystem. You’ll bring deep NX CAD expertise while taking a broader view of customer success - helping lead technical projects, supporting other engineers, identifying opportunities for automation and innovation, AI adoption and making sure solutions deliver real value for our customers. This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced NX professional who wants to move beyond traditional CAD support into a role with greater technical ownership, customer responsibility, and deliver digital engineering transformation via automations and AI.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as a senior subject matter expert for Siemens NX CAD and NX best practices.

  • Explore and leverage AI to provide agentic solutions to improve engineering workflows and customer outcomes.

  • Contribute to automation and customization initiatives using NX Open, journaling, scripting, and related technologies.

  • Contribute to presales activities, including discovery sessions, technical presentations, demonstrations, solution definition, and proposals.

  • Take technical ownership of customer engagements, helping coordinate activities, solve problems, and ensure successful outcomes.

  • Collaborate with Maya HTT specialists across PLM, software development, simulation, manufacturing, and AI to deliver broader customer solutions.

  • Build trusted relationships with customers, understanding their engineering challenges and proactively helping them identify solutions.

  • Deliver high-quality NX CAD consulting services and technical training.

  • Mentor and support other engineers working on NX-related projects.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of industrial experience working with Siemens NX CAD, (product design, configuring and administering NX environments)

  • UK nationality (British citizenship) is required due to the nature of the projects associated with this role.

  • An interest in applying AI and emerging technologies to engineering and product development workflows.

  • Experience working directly with customers or internal engineering stakeholders in a consulting, application engineering, technical support, or similar role.

  • Ability to troubleshoot complex problems beyond standard user-level functionality and the confidence to navigate unfamiliar technical challenges

  • A strong sense of ownership and the ability to take a customer problem from initial discussion through to resolution.

  • Experience leading technical activities, work packages, or customer projects.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build credibility with both technical specialists and customer stakeholders.

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams.

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

  • Occasional travel to customer sites when required.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with NX Open, NX journaling, or NX automation/customisation.

  • Experience with scripting or programming, such as Python, TCL, C#, C++, or similar technologies.

  • Exposure to Teamcenter or other PLM systems, particularly from an NX user or power-user perspective.

  • Experience with NX CAM, NX Post Builder, Siemens Post Configurator, or related manufacturing tools.

  • Experience with Solid Edge or other commercial CAD platforms.

  • Experience delivering or supporting design automation solutions.

  • Experience mentoring engineers or informally leading technical teams.

  • Experience with additive manufacturing or other advanced manufacturing technologies.

What Success Looks Like

You’ll become one of the senior technical anchors for NX within our UK team - someone customers and colleagues can rely on when a problem is complex, when a project needs technical leadership, or when an opportunity requires connecting CAD expertise with automation, PLM, software, or emerging technologies.

You won’t need to be the expert in every technology. What matters is knowing NX deeply, understanding engineering, having a keen interest to adopt new technology such as AI, taking ownership, and knowing how to bring the right people together to solve the customer’s problem.

Why join Maya HTT?

  • Permanent Position, Competitive Base Salary, and Yearly Increase.

  • Employer-Paid Benefits starting from Day One: private healthcare, vision and dental care, travel insurance, critical illness, income protection and life insurance

  • Retirement Savings with Employer Contributions and open to join from Day One

  • Career Growth Opportunities: Our flexible career paths allow you to grow, and we like to promote internally.

  • Learning Opportunities: Learn from the best in the industry and develop your skills.

  • Generous Time-Off Policy: We promote a Healthy Work-Life Balance with a Flexible PTO Policy, Sick/Personal Days, and a Summer Flex Schedule.

  • Structured Onboarding Program: We’re invested in your success; you’ll have team members to support you and provide a wide range of assistance from Day One.

  • Join an award-winning company that is recognized worldwide as an industry leader.

title: Senior Partner Manager - Italy, Spain and The Netherlands
descriptionHtml:
Algolia is the retrieval intelligence layer that turns intent into trusted, decision-grade outcomes. Powering more than 1.7 trillion queries a year for over 18,000 customers with millisecond latency and 99.999% reliability, we are the recognized leader for Search and Product Discovery by top industry analyst firms. The Algolia platform turns a company's products, content, and business rules into data that humans, applications and AI agents can act upon. The result is trusted customer experiences with stronger conversions for measurable business impact.  

The opportunity

We’re looking for a Partner Account Manager to grow Algolia’s partner ecosystem across Italy, Spain and the Netherlands, with a primary focus on Italy and the Netherlands.

As part of our Global Alliances team, you’ll build strong relationships with system integrators, digital agencies and other services partners. You’ll bring partners and Algolia teams together around shared opportunities, helping customers create better digital experiences while generating pipeline and revenue.

This is an opportunity to make an impact across a diverse territory: you’ll help develop the partner ecosystem in Italy and Spain while deepening established relationships in the Netherlands. You’ll have room to shape your approach to each market, supported by a collaborative team and a shared focus on growth.

Examples of partners include Atoms, Reply, Accenture, Kega, SQLI, Ogilvy, VASS, Shopify and commercetools.

What you’ll do

  • Own a revenue quota based on the business generated by your partners across Italy, Spain and the Netherlands.
  • Develop and execute a partner strategy for Italy, Spain and the Netherlands, prioritizing the opportunities with the greatest potential for growth.
  • Build trusted relationships with key system integrators and digital agencies, from sales and marketing teams to alliances leaders and executives.
  • Create joint business plans and coordinate sales and marketing initiatives that generate qualified pipeline and revenue.
  • Help partners understand Algolia’s value, build their capabilities and position our solutions with their customers.
  • Represent Algolia at partner meetings, events and other activities across the territory.

What you’ll bring

  • At least 5 years of experience in partner management, alliances, channel sales or a comparable role.
  • Experience carrying a quota, with a track record of driving pipeline and revenue through partners.
  • Experience building and growing relationships with system integrators, digital agencies or other services partners.
  • A strong ability to identify opportunities, develop joint plans and turn them into results.
  • Confidence working across sales, marketing and technical teams, both internally and within partner organizations.
  • The ability to balance strategic thinking with a hands-on approach to execution.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Fluency in English and Italian, both written and spoken. Additional languages, particularly Dutch or Spanish, are a plus.
  • Willingness to travel regularly across the territory

Algolia does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, military status, veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

On-Target Earnings Pay Range£108,000—£150,000 GBP

FLEXIBLE WORKPLACE STRATEGY:

Algolia’s flexible workplace model is designed to empower all Algolians to fulfill our mission to power search and discovery with ease. We place an emphasis on an individual’s impact, contribution, and output, over their physical location. Algolia is a high-trust environment and many of our team members have the autonomy to choose where they want to work and when. 

We have a global presence with offices in Paris, NYC, London, Sydney and Bucharest, however we also offer many of our team members the option to work remotely either as fully remote or hybrid-remote employees. Positions listed as "Remote" are only available for remote work within the specified country. Positions listed within a specific city are only available in that location - depending on the role it may be available with either a hybrid-remote or in-office schedule.

WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO CAN LIVE OUR VALUES:

  • GRIT - Problem-solving and perseverance capability in an ever-changing and growing environment.
  • TRUST - Willingness to trust our co-workers and to take ownership.
  • CANDOR - Ability to receive and give constructive feedback.
  • CARE - Genuine care about other team members, our clients and the decisions we make in the company.
  • HUMILITY - Aptitude for learning from others, putting ego aside.

We’re looking for talented, passionate people to help build the world’s best search and discovery technology. We value autonomy, diversity, and collaboration. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is respected and supported—regardless of race, age, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, color, veteran status, disability, or socioeconomic background.

IMPORTANT NOTICE FOR CANDIDATES - Recruitment Fraud Notice

We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams targeting job seekers. To help protect yourself, please keep the following in mind:

READY TO APPLY?

If you share our values and our enthusiasm for building the world’s best search & discovery technology, we’d love to review your application!

title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager Paid Social – Meta & TikTok (m/w/d) · Remote
descriptionHtml:
Das ist dein Job bei uns

Du möchtest E-Commerce-Brands über Meta und TikTok profitabel zum Wachsen bringen? Paid Social ist bei vielen unserer Kunden der entscheidende Wachstumskanal. Deine Aufgabe ist es, ihn zu verantworten und auf hohe fünf- bis sechsstellige Monatsbudgets zu skalieren. Unser internes Team aus Creative Strategist, Copywriting, Grafik, Video- und Landingpage-Spezialisten unterstützt dich dabei.

Wie dein Arbeitsalltag aussehen kann:

Mittwochmorgen. Im Business Manager laufen zwei neue Hooks deutlich über Benchmark. Du erhöhst die Budgets und briefst das Creative Team auf Iterationen der Best Performer. Daraus entsteht ein neues Set aus UGC, Founder Ads und Statics, das wenige Tage später live geht.

Am Donnerstag präsentierst du dem Kunden die Entwicklung der Performance, die nächsten Schritte und deine Vorschläge für den nächsten Funnel. Danach briefst du dein Team, jeder Schritt ist klar verteilt.

Drei Tage nach dem Launch steht ein Performance-Uplift von 30 %, der Account skaliert auf 3.000 € Ad Spend am Tag, profitabel bei stabilem CAC. Genau das ist der Job.

Wofür wir arbeiten

Wir sind einer der führenden ganzheitlichen Wachstumspartner für E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Raum.

Denn was wir immer wieder sehen: Agenturen und Dienstleister betreuen Brands nischig und siloartig, Kanal für Kanal, ohne Blick aufs Ganze. Dabei bleiben enorme Potenziale auf der Strecke.

Wir verstehen uns deshalb nicht als Dienstleister, sondern als Teil des Unternehmens unserer Kunden. Dafür arbeiten bei EVOLVE 30 Spezialisten in sechs Fachbereichen zusammen, vollständig remote ab Tag 1. Weekly Recaps, Coffee Chats und Team-Events sorgen dafür, dass Remote bei uns kein Einzelkämpfertum bedeutet.

So funktioniert Paid Social bei EVOLVE

Dass Creatives über die Performance entscheiden, ist kein Geheimnis mehr. Wir setzen zudem eine Ebene höher an und entwickeln conversionstarke Angebote und Funnel für unsere Kunden mit. Denn Skalierung entsteht selten nur aus guten Ads, sondern auch aus dem Angebot dahinter.

  • Angebotslogik und Preisstruktur gehören für uns zum Kanal. Jedes Angebot rechnen wir auf Deckungsbeitrag durch, bevor es live geht

  • Landingpages und Funnels bauen wir mit. Ein Ad verkauft nur so gut wie die Seite dahinter

  • Creative Strategist, Copywriter, Grafiker und Videografen im eigenen Haus. Kein Warten auf externe Zulieferer

  • KI als Werkzeug im Alltag. AI ersetzt bei uns niemanden. Du arbeitest damit wie mit einem Junior an deiner Seite, von der Creative-Recherche bis zur Auswertung

Was dich hier erwartet

  • Kampagnensteuerung: Du planst und steuerst die Paid-Social-Kampagnen auf Meta und TikTok, von der Strategie bis zur täglichen Optimierung

  • Skalierung: Du skalierst Accounts auf hohe fünf- bis sechsstellige Monatsbudgets. Die Zielmetrik ist Profitabilität, nicht Ad Spend

  • Creative: Du entwickelst die Creative-Konzepte mit dem Creative Team. Welche Hooks, Formate und Angebote gelauncht werden, entscheidest du

  • Testing: Du sorgst dafür, dass Hooks, Formate und Narrative laufend getestet werden. Denn ein Gewinner-Creative hält auf hohem Ad-Spend-Level nicht lange

  • Datenanalyse: Du bewertest alle Maßnahmen anhand der Performance-Daten

  • Kunden: Du führst die wöchentlichen Kundenreportings und berätst Kunden ganzheitlich, nicht nur auf Kanalebene

  • Aufbau des Bereichs: Du entwickelst Social Ads weiter, über SOPs, Qualitätsmanagement und die fachliche Führung neuer Teammitglieder

Deine Rolle und deine Ressourcen: Du lieferst die Ideen für Ads und Funnels nach Direct-Response-Prinzipien und entscheidest, was getestet wird. Die Detailarbeit übernimmt das Team aus Creative Strategist, Copywriting, Grafik und Video. Perspektivisch übernimmst du die Verantwortung für das gesamte Paid-Social-Team und entwickelst dich zum Paid Social Lead.

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Performance Marketing mit Schwerpunkt Paid Social, als Hauptkanal und nicht nebenbei

  • Nachweisbare Skalierung von E-Commerce-Accounts auf hohe fünf- bis sechsstellige Monatsbudgets

  • Tiefes Wissen im Meta Business Manager, idealerweise auch im TikTok Ads Manager. Dazu Routine mit Tracking-Tools wie Triple Whale, admetrics oder Tracify

  • Strategisches Verständnis für E-Commerce und sicherer Umgang mit Margen, Deckungsbeiträgen, CAC und POAS. Du denkst über den Werbekanal hinaus und steuerst entlang des gesamten Kundengeschäfts

  • Verständnis für Direct-Response-Mechanismen, UGC-Formate und Founder Ads. Du erkennst die Systematik dahinter, warum ein Creative verkauft

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau für Kundenkommunikation und Copy-Bewertung, Englisch fließend für die Arbeit in den Ad-Managern. Idealerweise bringst du erste Erfahrung in fachlicher Führung oder im Mentoring mit

Der Rahmen

  • 100 % Remote, kein Hybrid-Kompromiss

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Zweimal jährlich Team-Events und Workations, in Person und an wechselnden Orten

  • Wöchentliche Team-Recaps und Coffee Chats, damit Remote nicht heißt, den ganzen Tag allein zu arbeiten

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Jobrad und Firmenfitness über Wellpass

  • Steuerfreier Sachbezug von 50 € monatlich als Gutschein deiner Wahl

  • Laptop deiner Wahl und hochwertige Homeoffice-Ausstattung

  • Weiterbildungsbudget sowie interne und externe Quellen und Mentoren an deiner Seite

  • Voller Zugriff auf unseren internen AI-Stack

So läuft der Prozess

Deine Bewerbung. Dein Lebenslauf reicht. Wenn wir Rückfragen haben, schicken wir dir einen kurzen Fragebogen.

Erstgespräch. Ein kurzes Video-Gespräch mit Vanessa aus unserem HR. Es geht um gegenseitiges Kennenlernen, Rahmen und Erwartungen.

Fachgespräch. Hier geht es in die Tiefe, mit der Geschäftsführung oder dem Lead deines Fachbereichs.

Finales Kennenlernen. Mit der Geschäftsführung und deinem zukünftigen Ansprechpartner, menschlich und fachlich.

Entscheidung und Start. Wir entscheiden schnell und planen dein Onboarding gemeinsam.

Wie lange das dauert: Wir legen Wert auf einen schnellen Bewerbungsprozess. Zwischen den einzelnen Schritten liegen nur wenige Tage. Wenn du parallel in anderen Prozessen bist, sag uns Bescheid. Dann richten wir uns danach.

Deine Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Die ersten zwei Monate. Einarbeitung in die EVOLVE-Methodik und unsere Prozesse. Du übernimmst erste Accounts gemeinsam mit dem Team.

Mittelfristig. Volle Verantwortung für mehrere High-Budget-Accounts. Du steuerst das Paid-Social-Team fachlich und onboardest ein weiteres Teammitglied.

Langfristig. Du führst als Paid Social Lead den gesamten Social-Ads-Bereich, fachlich und disziplinarisch, mit bis zu zehn Personen.

Deine Ansprechpartnerin

Vanessa, unsere HR Managerin, ist dein erster Kontakt und freut sich auf deine Bewerbung.

descriptionHtml:

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

Operations is roughly half of Lendable's people. Central Ops Engineering is a small product engineering team that builds the tooling to help keep back office operations lean and efficient, while maintaining good customer outcomes.

We're hiring a senior product engineer who can own and deliver large problems in that space. You'll build the internal web apps and automations that agents use every day, and help shape how the team uses AI coding tools.

What you'll work on

Current problems include:

  • Complaints: we've already made handling much more efficient for officers, and are continuing to push on this.

  • Fraud and Fincrime: putting the signals an investigator needs into one place.

  • Quality assurance: using AI to review far more calls than a QA team can sample, and directing coaching to the agents who need it.

How we work

We use Claude Code, Codex, Augment and other AI tools every day. They've tripled our productivity, and we want you to help decide where we take that next. You'll hand real work to coding agents and take responsibility for what ships.

You'll work directly with ops agents and their managers, and with Product. Data Science and Analytics own the models and prompt engineering, and you'll build the tools that put their work in front of agents.

Who you are

  • An experienced product engineer with a strong track record of delivering practical, full-stack solutions on modern technology

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and focused on business outcomes, looking beyond the stated requirements to address the underlying problem

  • Experienced in shaping team ways of working and mentoring other engineers

  • Enthusiastic about AI-assisted development, ideally with a record of using it to improve how your team delivers

Our tech stack

This is what we use today, to give you a feel for the work. If your tech stack is different, we'd still like to hear from you: we've successfully onboarded engineers from different stacks in the past.

  • Backend: Python and FastAPI

  • Frontend: React, Next.js and Tailwind

  • Infrastructure: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Argo and Terraform

  • Data: SQL & Snowflake

  • Patterns: Domain Driven Design, message-driven systems and event sourcing

Interview process

  1. Intro call with Talent (30 min).

  2. Coding exercise in your own time ([2-3 hours max]). It's a small internal-tool problem, and you should use AI tools as you normally would.

  3. Technical interview (60 min). You'll walk us through your exercise, then we'll change the requirements and extend it together.

  4. Culture and behavioural interview (60 min), with time for your questions.

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

title: Senior Product Manager (Roadmap) - Star Trek Fleet Command
descriptionHtml:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Star Trek™ Fleet Command team in London on a hybrid basis.

Star Trek Fleet Command's ongoing success goes from strength to strength. Our in-house developed 4X MMO was launched in 2018 and continues to evolve, being consistently one of the top grossing Massive Multiplayer Strategy games on the market.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

What You Will Do

As the Senior Product Manager, you will be the product owner for key monetisation and engagement initiatives across the live game. This includes driving the roadmap and execution of our monthly content releases, ensuring they are cohesive, compelling, and highly performant. You will work cross-functionally with Game Design, Product Marketing, Product Ops, Economy Design, and Data Science teams to define, prioritise, and deliver exceptional player experiences that meet business and player goals.

  • Own the content and performance strategy for our monthly releases, aligning them to player motivations, economic balance, and business KPIs
  • Define and manage the monthly content calendar, collaborating with Design, Production, and Engineering to deliver high-quality, on-time experiences
  • Use data and experimentation to optimise monetisation, engagement, and retention across a broad player lifecycle—from new users to end-game whales
  • Deeply understand player behaviour across multiple geos and platforms to ensure we deliver value through personalisation and segmentation strategies
  • Work closely with the economy and systems design teams to ensure content aligns with long-term progression goals and avoids inflation
  • Partner with UX, Research, and Community teams to develop empathy for player sentiment and pain points, and translate them into actionable product improvements
  • Build business cases for major new initiatives and content verticals, including competitive research and revenue forecasting
  • Mentor junior PMs and contribute to a culture of product excellence and cross-functional collaboration.

What We're Looking For

  • Extensive experience in product management, ideally with significant responsibility on a F2P mobile game
  • Demonstrated success managing complex monetisation and engagement systems, with extensive experience in content development
  • Data-native mindset, with the ability to translate raw performance metrics into strategic insights and actionable plans
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a proven track record of aligning diverse teams around a shared product vision
  • Strong player empathy and experience working with user research, community feedback, or other voice-of-player channels
  • Experience driving impact across cross-functional pods, including creative, design, and engineering teams

At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that!  We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

title: Senior Program Manager
descriptionHtml:
About us

INCO is a leading social enterprise on a mission to shape a more inclusive and sustainable economy that creates opportunities for all. We have teams and programs in over 50 countries. Our work spans five complementary activities:

  1. INCO Academy: skilling programs for people facing barriers to employment, leading to careers in fast-growing industries such as technology, sustainability and healthcare (400,000+ job seekers trained to date).

  2. INCO Kids: education and awareness programs giving school-age learners future-proof knowledge in technology, sustainability, citizenship and more (350,000+ learners supported to date).

  3. INCO Entrepreneurs: incubation and acceleration for underrepresented founders and social entrepreneurs (2,000+ businesses supported every year).

  4. INCO Ventures: impact investing and funding for social and environmental impact startups (€500M+ assets under management).

  5. INCO Spaces: co-working and co-living spaces for social and environmental innovators (Paris, Berlin, Warsaw and more).

About the program:

AI and the Future of Work is a new three-year research and policy-engagement program (2026–2029), funded through a research grant partnership and led end to end by INCO. It tracks AI's real-world impact on jobs, tasks and productivity across all 27 EU member states, and gives policymakers the evidence, trend baselines and scenario-planning tools to capture AI's productivity upside while managing the workforce transition.

About the role:

We are looking for a Senior Program Manager to run the AI and the Future of Work program day to day and make sure it delivers on time, on budget and to the grant's commitments. You will closely lead and collaborate with a Research Lead and a Policy Lead. 

You will turn a three-year grant into a working operation: a deliverables calendar across 27 countries, a consortium of up to 15 partners, a publication schedule and a reporting cycle the funder can trust. You need to be comfortable working alongside researchers and policy specialists, and fluent in the rhythm of grant-funded research programs.

Responsibilities:

Lead program delivery end to end 

Planning and implementation

  • Build and own the three-year implementation plan: workstreams, milestones, dependencies and the deliverables calendar agreed with the funder.

  • Run the program's operating rhythm: weekly core-team check-ins, monthly consortium updates and quarterly steering reviews.

  • Coordinate the publication pipeline with the Research and Policy Leads: quarterly data refreshes, five semi-annual reports, policy briefs, the annual flagship and the 2029 EU27 report.

  • Keep thorough program documentation: plans, decision logs, risk register and handover notes.

  • Set up quality-assurance steps for outputs (review cycles, sign-off, editorial and brand checks) together with the Communications team.

  • Run the semi-annual tracking cycle and the reporting calendar for the five P0 markets and five sub-regional clusters, so national and EU27 outputs land together.

Monitoring and evaluation

  • Define and track program KPIs and grant deliverables; spot slippage early and agree corrective action with the leads.

  • Collect and compile performance data across workstreams and partners, and report it to your manager and the funder in a structured, actionable way.

  • Coordinate the program's evaluation framework so the team can show what the evidence changed in policy and practice.

Budget and resources

  • Own the program budget and cost sheet, including consortium partner budgets and the research consolidation budget held by the Research Lead.

  • Manage timelines and scope so the program delivers within the grant's budget and rules; prepare budget forecasts and reallocation requests.

  • Ensure grant compliance: eligible costs, audit trail, data protection (GDPR) and the funder's reporting requirements, working with Finance and Legal.

Manage the consortium and partners 

  • Run the operational side of partner onboarding with the Research Lead: due diligence, contracts, scopes of work, payment schedules and data-sharing agreements.

  • Track the delivery of 8 to 15 national partners against their contracts, and manage underperformance or replacement when needed.

  • Organise consortium working groups, review cycles and annual convenings, and keep communication flowing across countries and time zones.

  • Run the secretariat for the sub-recipient advisory committee (INCO staff, funder representatives and independent experts): schedule meetings, prepare selection materials, record recommendations and keep the process transparent, with final selection resting with INCO.

  • Manage subrecipient compliance: flow-down of grant terms, financial and narrative reporting from partners, and checks before each payment.

Manage the funder and stakeholders

  • Act as the primary operational liaison with the grant funder, keeping expectations aligned and surfacing risks early.

  • Prepare and present progress, financial and impact reports to the funder and other key stakeholders.

  • Work with the Head of Partnerships on funder conversations, renewals and any extension of the partnership.

  • Support the Policy Lead and with the logistics of policymaker convenings, events and launches.

  • Coordinate, with the Policy Lead, the expanded public-engagement activity in Poland and the CEE region, and the logistics of rapid, fact-based responses when AI labour market stories break.

Coordinate the team

  • Set clear responsibilities, timelines and objectives across the core team, and track progress against them.

  • Act as the connecting point between the Research Lead, the Policy Lead, data engineers and INCO's support teams (Communications, Finance, Legal, HR).

  • Identify staffing needs as the program grows (for example research assistants, data roles or a program officer), write job descriptions, interview and onboard new team members, and manage any program staff assigned to you.

Support growth 

  • Work with leadership to standardise how INCO runs grant-funded research programs, so lessons from this one carry over.

  • Identify follow-on funding and adjacent opportunities, for example linking findings to INCO Academy skilling programs.

  • Build relationships across the European research and policy ecosystem.



Essential

  • At least five years managing complex, multi-partner programs, ideally grant-funded research, policy or public-interest programs in Europe.

  • Proven track record managing funders or institutional partners, including donor reporting, budgets and grant compliance.

  • Experience coordinating consortia or networks of external partners, including contracts, scopes of work and partner payments.

  • At least four years leading teams and working cross-functionally, including with senior experts you do not line manage.

  • Strong budget and financial management skills, with ownership of program cost sheets and forecasts.

  • High digital collaboration literacy (Slack, Monday.com, Notion, G-Suite or similar) and comfort running remote work across many countries.

  • Professional English, written and spoken.

  • Strong attention to detail and organisational skills, with excellent communication, versatility and integrity.

Desirable

  • Experience with EU-funded or foundation-funded research programs (for example Horizon Europe, Erasmus+ or major philanthropic grants).

  • Familiarity with research operations: publication cycles, data protection (GDPR), research ethics and data-sharing agreements.

  • Interest in AI, the labour market, skills or the future of work; familiarity with EU institutions such as Cedefop, Eurostat, Eurofound or the JRC.

  • A second EU language, especially German, French, Spanish, Italian or Polish.

  • A recognised project management certification (for example PMP or PRINCE2).

  • Experience managing sub-grants or sub-recipients, including selection processes and flow-down compliance.

title: Senior Projectmanager
descriptionHtml:
Jouw Missie bij CCS

Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam.

Voordelen voor de sollicitant

Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar).

Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks.

En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch?


Een voorbeeld van je werkdag

Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen.

Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan.

Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant.

Wie jij bent

De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten:

· Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten;

· Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope;

· Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat;

· Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig;

· Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift;

· Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch;

· Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties;

· Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij:

· Salaris: We bieden je een salaris tussen € 5.590 en € 7.958 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis;

· Middelen: Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon;

· Werkdagen: Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar, al heeft 5 dagen onze voorkeur;

· Vergoeding voor thuiswerken: Je kunt gedeeltelijk thuiswerken en krijgt een onkostenvergoeding van € 2,40 per thuiswerkdag. Ook krijg je een budget van € 750,- om thuis een ergonomische werkplek in te richten;

· Workation: Je kunt tot 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar vanuit het buitenland werken;

· Leuke teamactiviteiten: Leer je collega’s beter kennen door deel te nemen aan maandelijkse evenementen georganiseerd door ons energieke Fun-team, zoals een pubquiz, Zomer BBQ, wine & beer tastings en movie night;

· Vakantiedagen: Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om maximaal 20 extra dagen bij te kopen;

· Groei en ontwikkeling: De mogelijkheid om je vaardigheden en verantwoordelijkheden te ontwikkelen binnen de functie, middels opleidingen en Linkedin learning, of door te stromen naar een van de andere functies binnen CCS;

· Vakantiegeld: Jaarlijks 8,33%;

· Voordelen: Je krijgt een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling met een lage eigen bijdrage en kunt gebruikmaken van collectieve verzekeringen met korting. Ook is er een bedrijfsfitnessregeling voor een gezonde levensstijl en een fietsregeling voor duurzaam vervoer.

Waarom CCS?

Omdat wij geloven dat werk meer is dan een baan. Het is een plek waar je jezelf kunt zijn, impact kunt maken en kunt groeien. Het is een omgeving waar je wordt geïnspireerd om het beste uit jezelf te halen en samen te werken aan een duurzame toekomst. Kom bij ons en ontdek wat er mogelijk is als je een carrière bouwt vol passie, plezier en betekenis. Jij bent de ontbrekende schakel in ons team. Word onderdeel van ons verhaal. 🚀

We’re looking for a hands-on Senior QA Manager to join our talented and passionate team. You’ll play a key role in ensuring every release meets the highest quality standards, from early concept to global launch.

As the quality owner for one of our largest mobile puzzle games, you’ll drive release quality, establish scalable QA processes, push test automation forward, and work closely with developers, product managers, and external QA partners to deliver a world-class player experience.

*Qualified Candidates are expected to complete an Assignment

*For this position the candidate should be based in European Union

Your Role:

  • Ensure high-quality releases through effective test planning, execution, regression testing, and staged rollout support

  • Define practical QA coverage for devices, OS versions, store builds, SDKs, ads, IAPs, analytics, and remote config

  • Identify, prioritize, and document issues with clear, actionable bug reports

  • Drive QA automation and continuously improve testing efficiency and coverage

  • Collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and external QA partners

  • Provide clear release readiness assessments and go/no-go recommendations

  • Maintain test documentation, release reports, and changelogs in Jira & Confluence

  • Champion a quality-first mindset across the team

  • Hands-on experience with IAP flows, ad mediation, ATT/consent frameworks, and attribution SDKs

  • Experience with QA automation, Unity games, and modern QA tools and workflows

  • Experience with crash reporting and monitoring tools (e.g. Firebase, Crashlytics, DataDog), and strong understanding of mobile stability issues: crashes, ANRs, and freezes

  • Proven experience building or owning a mobile QA automation framework (e.g. Appium, Unity Test Framework)

  • Strong understanding of mobile game telemetry, analytics validation, and event tracking

  • Experience working with external QA vendors or distributed QA teams

  • Proficient with Jira, Confluence, and modern AI tools to improve testing, documentation, and QA efficiency

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and English communication skills

  • Highly organized, proactive, and passionate about delivering exceptional player experiences
